local function geniter(f, s, c)
	if type(f) ~= "function" then
		local mt = getmetatable(f)

		if type(mt) == "table" and mt.__iter then
			f, s, c = mt.__iter(f)
		elseif type(f) == "table" then
			f, s, c = next, f, nil
		end
	end

	return function()
		local r = table.pack(f(s, c))

		if r[1] == nil then
			return false
		end

		c = r[1]

		return true, table.unpack(r, 1, r.n)
	end
end

	end
end

	end
end

BringEnemy = (function()
	local lastBring = 0
	local broughtMobs = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	local function MobAlive(m)
		if not m or not m.Parent then
			return false
		end
		local h = m:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
		return h ~= nil and h.Health > 0 and m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") ~= nil and not m:GetAttribute("LocalEnemy")
	end

	local function IsRaidMob(mob)
		local n = mob.Name:lower()
		if n:find("raid") or n:find("microchip") or n:find("island") then
			return true
		end
		if mob:GetAttribute("IsRaid") or mob:GetAttribute("RaidMob") or mob:GetAttribute("IsBoss") then
			return true
		end
		local hum = mob:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
		if hum and hum.WalkSpeed == 0 then
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			if _B then
				pcall(function()
					sethiddenproperty(plr, "SimulationRadius", math.huge)
				end)
			end
			task.wait(1.5)
		end
	end)

	return function(target)
		if not _B or not PosMon then
			return
		end
		local now = tick()
		if now - lastBring < 0.2 then
			return
		end
		local hrp = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then
			return
		end
		if (hrp.Position - PosMon).Magnitude > 80 then
			return
		end
		lastBring = now

		local targetName = type(target) == "string" and target or (typeof(target) == "Instance" and target.Name) or nil
		if not targetName then
			local nearest = math.huge
			for _, mob in ipairs(workspace.Enemies:GetChildren()) do
				if MobAlive(mob) then
					local d = (mob.HumanoidRootPart.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
					if d < nearest then
						nearest = d
						targetName = mob.Name
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local maxMobs, range = 4, 300
		local picked = {}
		for _, mob in ipairs(workspace.Enemies:GetChildren()) do
			if (not targetName or mob.Name == targetName) and MobAlive(mob) then
				local root = mob.HumanoidRootPart
				local dist = (root.Position - PosMon).Magnitude
				if dist <= range and (#picked < maxMobs or dist < picked[#picked].d) then
					if broughtMobs[mob] or not IsRaidMob(mob) then
						local pos = #picked + 1
						for i = 1, #picked do
							if dist < picked[i].d then
								pos = i
								break
							end
						end
						table.insert(picked, pos, { m = mob, hum = mob.Humanoid, root = root, d = dist })
						if #picked > maxMobs then
							table.remove(picked)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		for _, p in ipairs(picked) do
			local root, hum = p.root, p.hum
			broughtMobs[p.m] = true
			pcall(function()
				if not root:FindFirstChild("BodyVelocity") then
					local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
					bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
					bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
					bv.Parent = root
				end
				if hum.WalkSpeed ~= 0 then
					hum.WalkSpeed = 0
					hum.JumpPower = 0
				end
				if root.CanCollide then
					root.CanCollide = false
				end
				if p.d > 4 and (type(isnetworkowner) ~= "function" or isnetworkowner(root)) then
					root.CFrame = CFrame.new(PosMon)
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end)()

do
	local function v47(p27, p28)
		local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
		local Name
		local v50, v51, v52 = pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetChildren())
		local v53 = geniter(v50, v51, v52)

		while true do
			local v54 = table.pack(v53())

			if not v54[1] then
				break
			end

			local v55 = v54[3]

			if v55:IsA("Tool") and v55.ToolTip == p27 then
				Name = v55.Name

				break
			end
		end

		if not Name then
			local v56, v57, v58 = pairs(LocalPlayer.Backpack:GetChildren())

			for _, v1 in v56, v57, v58 do
				if v1:IsA("Tool") then
					if v1.ToolTip == p27 then
						Name = v1.Name

						break
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if Name then
			if LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Main") then
				if LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Main:FindFirstChild("Skills") then
					local v61 = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Main.Skills:FindFirstChild(Name)

					if v61 then
						local v62 = v61:FindFirstChild(p28)

						if not v62 then
							return false
						end

						local Title = v62:FindFirstChild("Title")

						if Title and Title:IsA("TextLabel") and Title.TextColor3.R < 0.5 then
							return false
						end

						local Cooldown = v62:FindFirstChild("Cooldown")

						if Cooldown and (Cooldown.Size.X.Scale > 0 or Cooldown.AbsoluteSize.X > 0) then
							return false
						end

						return true
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	Useskills = function(p29, p30)
		if p29 == "Melee" then
			weaponSc("Melee")

			if not v47(p29, p30) then
				return
			end

			if p30 == "Z" then
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "Z", false, game)
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "Z", false, game)
			elseif p30 == "X" then
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "X", false, game)
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "X", false, game)
			elseif p30 == "C" then
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "C", false, game)
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "C", false, game)
			elseif p30 == "V" then
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "V", false, game)
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "V", false, game)
			elseif p30 == "F" then
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "F", false, game)
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "F", false, game)
			elseif p30 == "Y" then
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "Y", false, game)
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "Y", false, game)
			end
		elseif p29 == "Sword" then
			weaponSc("Sword")

			if not v47(p29, p30) then
				return
			end

			if p30 == "Z" then
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "Z", false, game)
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "Z", false, game)
			elseif p30 == "X" then
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "X", false, game)
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "X", false, game)
			elseif p30 == "C" then
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "C", false, game)
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "C", false, game)
			elseif p30 == "V" then
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "V", false, game)
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "V", false, game)
			elseif p30 == "F" then
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "F", false, game)
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "F", false, game)
			elseif p30 == "Y" then
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(true, "Y", false, game)
				vim1:SendKeyEvent(false, "Y", false, game)

		if getdis(CFrame.new(28310.0234, 14895.1123, 109.456741)) > 1500 then
			ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.CommF_:InvokeServer("requestEntrance", Vector3.new(28310.0234, 14895.1123, 109.456741))
			wait(0.3)
		end

		local cFrame3 = CFrame.new(28607.5352, 14896.5449, 106.011726)

		_tp(cFrame3)

		repeat
			wait()
		until getdis(cFrame3) <= 5

		wait(0.5)

		for i = 1, 4 do
			ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.CommF_:InvokeServer("RaceV4Progress", "TeleportBack")
		end
	end
	requestentrance = function(p52)
		local Position = p52

		if typeof(p52) == "CFrame" then
			Position = p52.Position
		end

		local t12

		if sea1 then
			t12 = {
				Sky3 = Vector3.new(-7894, 5547, -380),
				Sky3Exit = Vector3.new(-4607, 874, -1667),
				UnderWater = Vector3.new(61163, 11, 1819),
				["Underwater City"] = Vector3.new(61165.19140625, 0.18704631924629211, 1897.379150390625),
				["Pirate Village"] = Vector3.new(-1242.4625244140625, 4.7870597839355469, 3901.282958984375),
				UnderwaterExit = Vector3.new(4050, -1, -1814)
			}
		elseif sea2 then
			t12 = {
				["Swan Mansion"] = Vector3.new(-390, 332, 673),
				["Swan Room"] = Vector3.new(2285, 15, 905),
				["Cursed Ship"] = Vector3.new(923, 126, 32852),
				["Zombie Island"] = Vector3.new(-6509, 83, -133)
			}
		else
			t12 = {
				["Hydra Island"] = Vector3.new(5657.88623046875, 1013.0790405273438, -335.4996337890625),
				Mansion = Vector3.new(-12462, 375, -7552),
				Castle = Vector3.new(-5036, 315, -3179),
				["Temple of Time"] = Vector3.new(28286, 14897, 103),
				["Greate Tree"] = Vector3.new(3024.1709, 2280.69434, -7325.12793)
			}

			if not checkinventory("Valkyrie Helm") then
				return
			end
		end

		local v194
		local huge = math.huge

		for _, v1 in pairs(t12) do
			local Magnitude = typeof(v1) == "Vector3" and (v1 - Position).Magnitude or (v1.Position - Position).Magnitude

			if Magnitude < huge then
				huge = Magnitude
				v194 = v1
			end
		end

		if v194 and huge and huge < getdis(p52) then
			pcall(function()
				if _G.TweenCache then
					_G.TweenCache:Cancel()
				end
			end)

			local ok = not (typeof(v194) == "Vector3" and v194.X == 3024.1709 and v194.Y == 2280.69434 and v194.Z == -7325.12793)

			if not ok then
				ok = not (ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.CommF_:InvokeServer("RaceV4Progress", "Check") >= 2)
			end

			if ok then
				if huge < getdis(p52) then
					ReplicatedStorage.Remotes.CommF_:InvokeServer("requestEntrance", typeof(v194) == "Vector3" and v194 or v194.Position)
					wait(1)
				end
			else
				totopofgreattree()
				wait(1)
			end
		end
	end
	_tp = function(p53)
		local cFrame3

		if typeof(p53) == "Vector3" then
			cFrame3 = CFrame.new(p53)
		elseif typeof(p53) == "CFrame" then
			cFrame3 = p53
		else
			cFrame3 = p53 and p53.CFrame
		end

		if not cFrame3 then
			return
		end

		if not plr.Character or not plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			return
		end

		local HumanoidRootPart = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart

		getgenv().OnFarm = false
		pcall(function()
			if CanBypassTeleport(cFrame3) then
				BypassTP(cFrame3)
				task.wait(0.5)
			end
		end)
		pcall(function()
			requestentrance(p53)
		end)

		if sea3 then
			if getdis(cFrame3.Position, cFrame.Position) < 2000 then
				local HumanoidRootPart2 = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart

				if math.abs(cFrame.Position.Y - HumanoidRootPart2.CFrame.Y) > 1000 then
					repeat
						task.wait()
						old_tp(cFrame2)

						if getdis(cFrame2) < 10 then
							local Net = ReplicatedStorage.Modules.Net

							Net["RF/SubmarineWorkerSpeak"]:InvokeServer("AskKilledTikiBoss")
							task.wait(0.5)
							Net["RF/SubmarineWorkerSpeak"]:InvokeServer("TravelToSubmergedIsland")
						end
					until getdis(cFrame3.Position) < 2000

					task.wait(0.6)
					pcall(function()
						if HumanoidRootPart2:FindFirstChild("BodyClip") then
							HumanoidRootPart2.BodyClip:Destroy()
						end
					end)
				end
			end
		end

		local hrp = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hrp then
			return
		end
		if hrp.Anchored then
			hrp.Anchored = false
		end
		local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum and hum.Sit then
			hum.Sit = false
		end

		local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
		local farSpeed = getgenv().TweenSpeedFar or 150
		local nearSpeed = getgenv().NearMobSpeed or 400
		local nearRange = getgenv().NearMobRange or 100

		local function nearMob(pos)
			local enemies = workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
			if not enemies then
				return false
			end
			for _, e in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
				local root = e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local h = e:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
				if root and h and h.Health > 0 and (root.Position - pos).Magnitude <= nearRange then
					return true
				end
			end
			return false
		end
		local function speedAt(pos)
			return nearMob(pos) and nearSpeed or farSpeed
		end
		local function alive()
			local c = plr.Character
			local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			return h ~= nil and h.Health > 0 and hrp.Parent ~= nil
		end

		if QX_ActiveFlight then
			pcall(function()
				QX_ActiveFlight:Cancel()
			end)
		end

		local done = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
		local proxy = { Completed = done.Event, PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Playing }
		local cancelled, finished, active = false, false, nil

		function proxy:Cancel()
			cancelled = true
			if active then
				pcall(function()
					active:Cancel()
				end)
			end
		end

		local dist = (hrp.Position - cFrame3.Position).Magnitude
		if dist < 6 then
			hrp.CFrame = cFrame3
			Part.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
			getgenv().OnFarm = true
			proxy.PlaybackState = Enum.PlaybackState.Completed
			task.defer(function()
				done:Fire(proxy.PlaybackState)
			end)
			return proxy
		end

		local speed = speedAt(hrp.Position)
		local function play()
			local left = (hrp.Position - cFrame3.Position).Magnitude
			active = TweenService:Create(hrp, TweenInfo.new(left / speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { CFrame = cFrame3 })
			active:Play()
		end
		play()
		QX_ActiveFlight = proxy

		task.spawn(function()
			local lastCheck = tick()
			while not cancelled do
				local state = active.PlaybackState
				if state ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Playing and state ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Delayed then
					finished = state == Enum.PlaybackState.Completed
					break
				end
				task.wait(0.05)
				if not shouldTween or not alive() then
					proxy:Cancel()
					break
				end
				if tick() - lastCheck >= 0.25 then
					lastCheck = tick()
					local sp = speedAt(hrp.Position)
					if sp ~= speed then
						speed = sp
						pcall(function()
							active:Cancel()
						end)
						if (hrp.Position - cFrame3.Position).Magnitude < 6 then
							hrp.CFrame = cFrame3
							finished = true
							break
						end
						play()
					end
				end
			end

			proxy.PlaybackState = finished and Enum.PlaybackState.Completed or Enum.PlaybackState.Cancelled
			if hrp.Parent then
				Part.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
			end
			if QX_ActiveFlight == proxy then
				QX_ActiveFlight = nil
			end
			getgenv().OnFarm = true
			done:Fire(proxy.PlaybackState)
		end)

		return proxy
	end
end

do
	BTP = function(p57)
		local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
		local HumanoidRootPart = LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart
		local Humanoid = LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid
		local Main = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Main
		local Position = HumanoidRootPart.Position

		repeat
			Humanoid.Health = 0
			HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = p57
			Main.Quest.Visible = false

			if (HumanoidRootPart.Position - Position).Magnitude > 1 then
				Position = HumanoidRootPart.Position
				HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = p57
			end

			task.wait(0.5)
		until (p57.Position - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude <= 2000
	end
end

do
	local Quests = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Quests"))
	local GuideModule = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("GuideModule"))
	local t13 = {
		"MarineQuest",
		"BartiloQuest",
		"CitizenQuest",
		"Trainees"
	}

	CheckSea = function(p58)
		if (game.PlaceId == 2753915549 or game.PlaceId == 85211729168715) and p58 == 1 then
			return true
		end

		if (game.PlaceId == 4442272183 or game.PlaceId == 79091703265657) and p58 == 2 then
			return true
		end

		if (game.PlaceId == 7449423635 or game.PlaceId == 100117331123089) and p58 == 3 then
			return true
		end

		return false
	end
	GetQuestPointFromNPC = function(p59)
		for _, child in pairs(workspace.NPCs:GetChildren()) do
			if child.Name == p59 and child:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				return child.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
			end
		end

		for _, child in pairs(replicated.NPCs:GetChildren()) do
			if child.Name == p59 and child:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				return child.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
			end
		end

		return nil
	end
	GetQuests = function()
		local Value = plr.Data.Level.Value
		local n1 = 0
		local t14 = {}

		if Value >= 700 and CheckSea(1) then
			t14.Mob = "Galley Captain"
			t14.NameQuest = "FountainQuest"
			t14.ID = 2
			t14.LevelReq = 700
		elseif Value >= 1500 and CheckSea(2) then
			t14.Mob = "Water Fighter"
			t14.NameQuest = "ForgottenQuest"
			t14.ID = 2
			t14.LevelReq = 1450
		else
			for k, Quest in pairs(Quests) do
				for k2, v1 in pairs(Quest) do
					local LevelReq = v1.LevelReq

					for k3 in pairs(v1.Task) do
						if LevelReq <= Value and n1 <= LevelReq and v1.Task[k3] > 1 then
							if not table.find(t13, k) then
								n1 = LevelReq
								t14.Mob = k3
								t14.NameQuest = k
								t14.ID = k2
								t14.LevelReq = LevelReq
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return t14
	end
	GetQuestPoint = function()
		if GuideModule and GuideModule.Data then
			if GuideModule.Data.LastClosestNPC then
				return GetQuestPointFromNPC(GuideModule.Data.LastClosestNPC)
			end
		end

		return nil
	end
end

	local FALLBACK = "rbxassetid://132023049848714"
	local function decode(s)
		local chars = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
		local map = {}
		for i = 1, 64 do map[chars:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
		local out, acc, cnt = {}, 0, 0
		for i = 1, #s do
			local v = map[s:byte(i)]
			if v then
				acc = acc * 64 + v
				cnt = cnt + 1
				if cnt == 4 then
					out[#out + 1] = string.char(math.floor(acc / 65536) % 256, math.floor(acc / 256) % 256, acc % 256)
					acc, cnt = 0, 0
				end
			end
		end
		if cnt == 3 then
			out[#out + 1] = string.char(math.floor(acc / 1024) % 256, math.floor(acc / 4) % 256)
		elseif cnt == 2 then
			out[#out + 1] = string.char(math.floor(acc / 16) % 256)
		end
		return table.concat(out)
	end
	Env.__AcademyLogoAsset = function()
		if Env.__AcademyLogoCached then return Env.__AcademyLogoCached end
		local ok, res = pcall(function()
			local gca = getcustomasset or getsynasset
			if not (gca and writefile and isfolder and makefolder) then error("custom assets not supported") end
			local folder = "Academy Hub"
			if not isfolder(folder) then makefolder(folder) end
			local path = folder .. "/logo_ay_v2.png"
			if not (isfile and isfile(path)) then writefile(path, decode(B64)) end
			local a = gca(path)
			if type(a) ~= "string" or a == "" then error("bad asset") end
			return a
		end)
		Env.__AcademyLogoCached = (ok and res) or FALLBACK
		return Env.__AcademyLogoCached
	end
end

    local function sectionIcon(title, fallback)
        local s = string.lower(tostring(title or ""))
        for _, p in ipairs(SectionIcons) do
            if s:find(p[1], 1, true) then return p[2] end
        end
        return fallback
    end

    local function safe(fn, ...)
        pcall(function() if setthreadidentity then setthreadidentity(8) end end)
        local ok, err = pcall(fn, ...)
        if not ok then warn("[" .. tostring(Lib.Name or "Academy Hub") .. "] " .. tostring(err)) end
    end
    local function connect(sig, fn)
        local c = sig:Connect(fn)
        table.insert(Lib.Conns, c)
        return c
    end
    local function inst(class, props, parent)
        local o = Instance.new(class)
        for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
        if parent then o.Parent = parent end
        return o
    end
    local function round(o, r)
        return inst("UICorner", { CornerRadius = r and UDim.new(0, r) or UDim.new(1, 0) }, o)
    end
    local function stroke(o, tr, col)
        return inst("UIStroke", { Color = col or C.Line, Transparency = tr or 0.92, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border }, o)
    end
    local function pad(o, l, r, t, b)
        return inst("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, l), PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, r), PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, t), PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, b) }, o)
    end
    local function list(o, dir, gap, ha, va)
        return inst("UIListLayout", {
            FillDirection = dir or Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
            Padding = UDim.new(0, gap or 0),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            HorizontalAlignment = ha or Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left,
            VerticalAlignment = va or Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top,
        }, o)
    end
    local function text(props, parent)
        local t = inst("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = C.Text,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center, Text = "",
        }, nil)
        for k, v in pairs(props) do t[k] = v end
        t.Parent = parent
        return t
    end
    local function fitText(t, max, min)
        t.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None
        t.TextWrapped = true
        t.TextScaled = true
        inst("UITextSizeConstraint", { MaxTextSize = max, MinTextSize = min }, t)
        return t
    end
    local function preload(imgs)
        local list = {}
        for _, v in pairs(type(imgs) == "table" and imgs or {}) do
            if v ~= nil and tostring(v) ~= "" then list[#list + 1] = tostring(v) end
        end
        if #list > 0 then task.spawn(pcall, ContentProvider.PreloadAsync, ContentProvider, list) end
    end
    local function icon(name, size, parent, col)
        return inst("ImageLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = Icons[name] or "", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(size, size),
            ImageColor3 = col or C.Text, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
        }, parent)
    end
    local function tw(o, t, props)
        local x = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
        x:Play()
        return x
    end
    local function isPress(i)
        return i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end
    local function isMove(i)
        return i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    end
    local function viewport()
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
        return cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
    end
    local function textWidth(s, size)
        local ok, v = pcall(function() return TextService:GetTextSize(tostring(s), size, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, Vector2.new(2000, 100)).X end)
        return ok and v or (#tostring(s) * 8)
    end
    local accentHooks = {}
    local function accent() return Accents[Lib.AccentName] or Accents.Blue end
    local function onAccent(fn)
        table.insert(accentHooks, fn)
        pcall(fn, accent())
    end
    local function noLoc(o) pcall(function() o.AutoLocalize = false end) end

    Lib.FX = true
    Lib._spin = {}
    Lib._glows = {}
    local inset = Vector2.new(0, 0)
    pcall(function() inset = game:GetService("GuiService"):GetGuiInset() end)
    local function ease(o, t, props, style, dir)
        local x = TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
        x:Play()
        return x
    end
    local function ripple(b, pos)
        if not Lib.FX or not b.Parent then return end
        local ap, as = b.AbsolutePosition, b.AbsoluteSize
        local px, py = pos.X + inset.X, pos.Y + inset.Y
        local r = inst("Frame", {
            Name = "Ripple", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = b.ZIndex + 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp((px - ap.X) / math.max(as.X, 1), 0, 1), math.clamp((py - ap.Y) / math.max(as.Y, 1), 0, 1)),
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.72,
        }, b)
        round(r)
        inst("UIAspectRatioConstraint", { AspectRatio = 1, DominantAxis = Enum.DominantAxis.Width }, r)
        b.ClipsDescendants = true
        ease(r, 0.5, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(2.4, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
        task.delay(0.52, function() pcall(function() r:Destroy() end) end)
    end
    local function press(b)
        local sc = inst("UIScale", {}, b)
        connect(b.InputBegan, function(i)
            if not isPress(i) or not Lib.FX then return end
            ease(sc, 0.1, { Scale = 0.96 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
            ripple(b, i.Position)
        end)
        connect(b.InputEnded, function(i)
            if isPress(i) then ease(sc, 0.3, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end
        end)
        connect(b.MouseLeave, function()
            if sc.Scale < 1 then ease(sc, 0.2, { Scale = 1 }) end
        end)
        return sc
    end
    local function glow(st, base)
        local g = inst("UIGradient", {
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.85), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.42, 0.6),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.58, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.85),
            }),
        }, st)
        local e = { st = st, g = g, base = base }
        function e.paint()
            if Lib.FX then
                st.Color = accent()
                st.Transparency = 0
                g.Enabled = true
            else
                st.Color = C.Line
                st.Transparency = base
                g.Enabled = false
            end
        end
        table.insert(Lib._glows, e)
        table.insert(Lib._spin, g)
        onAccent(e.paint)
        return e
    end
    connect(game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat, function(dt)
        if not Lib.FX then return end
        Lib._spinA = ((Lib._spinA or 0) + dt * 50) % 360
        for _, g in ipairs(Lib._spin) do g.Rotation = Lib._spinA end
        if Lib._fxStep then Lib._fxStep(dt) end
        if Lib._tabStep then Lib._tabStep(dt) end
    end)
    Lib.SoundOn = true
    Lib.Volume = 0.5
    local BUBBLE = "rbxassetid://6895079853"
    local SFX = {
        click = { BUBBLE, 1.12 }, tab = { BUBBLE, 1.28 }, on = { BUBBLE, 1.45 }, off = { BUBBLE, 0.86 },
        tick = { BUBBLE, 1.7, 0.45 }, open = { BUBBLE, 1.0 }, select = { BUBBLE, 1.2 }, alert = { BUBBLE, 0.72, 1.2 },
        copy = { BUBBLE, 1.55 }, notify = { BUBBLE, 1.3 }, notify2 = { BUBBLE, 1.62 },
        uiOpen = { BUBBLE, 0.95 }, uiOpen2 = { BUBBLE, 1.42 }, uiClose = { BUBBLE, 1.3 }, uiClose2 = { BUBBLE, 0.78 },
        whoosh = { "rbxassetid://15675024286", 1.15, 0.35 },
    }
    local sfxCache, sfxLast = {}, {}
    local sfxFolder
    pcall(function()
        sfxFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
        sfxFolder.Name = "AcademyHubSounds"
        sfxFolder.Parent = game:GetService("SoundService")
    end)
    local function sfx(key, vol)
        if not Lib.SoundOn or Lib.Unloaded then return end
        local def = SFX[key]
        if not def then return end
        local now = os.clock()
        if sfxLast[key] and now - sfxLast[key] < 0.05 then return end
        sfxLast[key] = now
        pcall(function()
            local snd = sfxCache[key]
            if not snd then
                snd = Instance.new("Sound")
                snd.Name = key
                snd.SoundId = def[1]
                snd.PlaybackSpeed = def[2] or 1
                snd.Parent = sfxFolder or game:GetService("SoundService")
                sfxCache[key] = snd
            end
            snd.Volume = math.clamp((tonumber(Lib.Volume) or 0.5) * (vol or 1) * (def[3] or 1) * 1.6, 0, 3)
            game:GetService("SoundService"):PlayLocalSound(snd)
        end)
    end
    Lib.PlaySound = function(_, key, vol) sfx(key, vol) end
    function Lib:SetSounds(on) Lib.SoundOn = on and true or false end
    function Lib:SetVolume(v) Lib.Volume = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 0.5, 0, 2) end
    function Lib:SetEffects(on)
        Lib.FX = on and true or false
        for _, e in ipairs(Lib._glows) do pcall(e.paint) end
        if Lib._fxLayer then Lib._fxLayer.Visible = Lib.FX end
    end

    local gui = inst("ScreenGui", { Name = "AcademyXUI", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 1000000, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling })
    local top = inst("ScreenGui", { Name = "ZX_Toggle", ResetOnSpawn = false, IgnoreGuiInset = true, DisplayOrder = 1000001, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling })
    for _, sg in ipairs({ gui, top }) do
        noLoc(sg)
        connect(sg.DescendantAdded, noLoc)
        pcall(function() sg.OnTopOfCoreBlur = true end)
        if not pcall(function() sg.Parent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui") end) then
            sg.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
        end
    end
    Lib.GUI = gui
    Lib.ToggleGui = top

    local toasts = inst("Frame", {
        Name = "Toasts", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 500),
    }, top)
    list(toasts, nil, 8, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom)

    local overlay = inst("Frame", { Name = "Overlay", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 50, Visible = false }, gui)
    local catcher = inst("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 50 }, overlay)
    local Pop = {}
    local tipF = inst("Frame", {
        Name = "Tooltip", BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24), BorderSizePixel = 0, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), Visible = false, ZIndex = 60,
    }, gui)
    round(tipF, 10)
    local tipLine = stroke(tipF, 0.4)
    pad(tipF, 12, 12, 8, 9)
    local tipText = text({
        Text = "", FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 13, TextWrapped = true, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), ZIndex = 61,
    }, tipF)
    inst("UISizeConstraint", { MaxSize = Vector2.new(260, 400) }, tipText)
    local tipScale = inst("UIScale", {}, tipF)
    local Tip = {}
    local function hideTip()
        Tip.owner = nil
        Tip.tok = (Tip.tok or 0) + 1
        tipF.Visible = false
    end
    local function showTip(anchor, str)
        if str == nil or str == "" then return end
        Tip.owner = anchor
        Tip.at = os.clock()
        Tip.tok = (Tip.tok or 0) + 1
        local my = Tip.tok
        tipText.Text = str
        tipLine.Color = accent()
        local sc = Lib._fit and Lib._fit.Scale or 1
        tipScale.Scale = sc
        local function place()
            local vp = viewport()
            local ap, as = anchor.AbsolutePosition - overlay.AbsolutePosition, anchor.AbsoluteSize
            local half = tipF.AbsoluteSize.X / 2
            local x = math.clamp(ap.X + as.X / 2, half + 8, math.max(half + 8, vp.X - half - 8))
            if ap.Y - tipF.AbsoluteSize.Y - 10 < 4 then
                tipF.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
                tipF.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, ap.Y + as.Y + 6)
            else
                tipF.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
                tipF.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, ap.Y - 6)
            end
        end
        tipF.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
        place()
        tipF.Visible = true
        if Lib.FX then
            tipScale.Scale = sc * 0.85
            ease(tipScale, 0.22, { Scale = sc }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
        end
        task.spawn(function()
            for _ = 1, 20 do
                if Tip.tok ~= my then return end
                pcall(place)
                task.wait()
            end
        end)
        task.delay(5, function() if Tip.tok == my then hideTip() end end)
    end
    Lib._hideTip = hideTip
    connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(i)
        if isPress(i) and tipF.Visible and os.clock() - (Tip.at or 0) > 0.25 then hideTip() end
    end)
    local function closePopup()
        local f, cb = Pop.frame, Pop.onClose
        Pop.frame, Pop.onClose = nil, nil
        if Pop.follow then
            pcall(function() Pop.follow:Disconnect() end)
            Pop.follow = nil
        end
        overlay.Visible = false
        if f then pcall(function() f:Destroy() end) end
        if cb then pcall(cb) end
    end
    connect(catcher.MouseButton1Click, closePopup)
    local function openPopup(anchor, w, h)
        closePopup()
        local s = Lib._fit and Lib._fit.Scale or 1
        local vp = viewport()
        local f = inst("Frame", {
            Name = "Popup", BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 22), BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), ZIndex = 51, Active = true,
        }, nil)
        if anchor then
            local ap, as = anchor.AbsolutePosition - overlay.AbsolutePosition, anchor.AbsoluteSize
            local clip = anchor:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame")
            local down = vp.Y - 10 - (ap.Y + as.Y + 6)
            h = math.min(h, math.max(down / s, 60))
            w = math.min(w, (vp.X - 16) / s)
            f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
            f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
            local function place()
                local p, sz = anchor.AbsolutePosition - overlay.AbsolutePosition, anchor.AbsoluteSize
                local x = math.clamp(p.X + sz.X, w * s + 8, math.max(w * s + 8, vp.X - 8))
                f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, p.Y + sz.Y + 6)
            end
            place()
            Pop.follow = game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                if Pop.frame ~= f or not anchor.Parent then return end
                if clip then
                    local cp, cs = clip.AbsolutePosition, clip.AbsoluteSize
                    local mid = anchor.AbsolutePosition.Y + anchor.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2
                    if mid < cp.Y or mid > cp.Y + cs.Y or not anchor.Visible then
                        closePopup()
                        return
                    end
                end
                place()
            end)
        else
            f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        end
        round(f, 16)
        stroke(f, 0.88)
        local pscale = inst("UIScale", { Scale = s }, f)
        f.Parent = overlay
        Pop.frame = f
        overlay.Visible = true
        if Lib.FX then
            pscale.Scale = s * 0.88
            ease(pscale, 0.25, { Scale = s }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
        end
        return f
    end

    local function makeSwitch(parent, on, changed)
        local hit = inst("TextButton", { Name = "Switch", Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 36) }, parent)
        local trk = inst("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 26),
            BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, hit)
        round(trk)
        local tline = stroke(trk, 0.85)
        local tgrad = inst("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)), Rotation = 0, Enabled = false }, trk)
        local knob = inst("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
            BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 132), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2,
        }, trk)
        round(knob)
        local kc = icon("check", 10, knob, accent())
        kc.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        kc.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        kc.ZIndex = 3
        local sw = { Value = on and true or false }
        local function paint(anim)
            local pos = sw.Value and UDim2.new(1, -22, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, 0)
            local col = sw.Value and accent() or C.Raise
            local kcol = sw.Value and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 132)
            tgrad.Enabled = sw.Value
            kc.ImageColor3 = accent()
            if anim then
                if Lib.FX then knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 18) end
                ease(knob, 0.35, { Position = pos, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), BackgroundColor3 = kcol }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                tw(trk, 0.2, { BackgroundColor3 = col })
                tw(tline, 0.2, { Color = sw.Value and accent() or C.Line, Transparency = sw.Value and 0.4 or 0.85 })
                kc.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
                kc.Visible = sw.Value
                if sw.Value then ease(kc, 0.3, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end
            else
                knob.Position = pos
                knob.BackgroundColor3 = kcol
                trk.BackgroundColor3 = col
                tline.Color = sw.Value and accent() or C.Line
                tline.Transparency = sw.Value and 0.4 or 0.85
                kc.Visible = sw.Value
                kc.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
            end
        end
        function sw.set(v)
            v = v and true or false
            if v == sw.Value then return end
            sw.Value = v
            paint(true)
        end
        onAccent(function() paint(false) end)
        connect(hit.MouseButton1Click, function()
            sw.Value = not sw.Value
            sfx(sw.Value and "on" or "off")
            paint(true)
            if sw.Value and Lib.FX then
                local ring = inst("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 3,
                }, trk)
                round(ring)
                local rs = inst("UIStroke", { Color = accent(), Thickness = 2 }, ring)
                ease(ring, 0.45, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 46) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                ease(rs, 0.45, { Transparency = 1, Thickness = 0.5 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                task.delay(0.47, function() pcall(function() ring:Destroy() end) end)
            end
            changed(sw.Value)
        end)
        return sw
    end

    local function makeButton(parent, label, pressed, col)
        local base = col or C.Raise
        local b = inst("TextButton", {
            Name = "Button", AutoButtonColor = false, Text = tostring(label), FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = C.Text,
            BackgroundColor3 = base, BorderSizePixel = 0, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 34),
        }, parent)
        round(b)
        pad(b, 16, 16, 0, 0)
        connect(b.MouseEnter, function() tw(b, 0.12, { BackgroundColor3 = base:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.1) }) end)
        connect(b.MouseLeave, function() tw(b, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = base }) end)
        connect(b.MouseButton1Click, function()
            sfx("click")
            pressed()
        end)
        press(b)
        return b
    end
    local function buttonWidth(label) return math.max(textWidth(label, 14) + 36, 60) end

    local function iconButton(name, parent)
        local b = inst("TextButton", {
            Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36),
        }, parent)
        round(b, 10)
        local ic = icon(name, 19, b, C.Sub)
        ic.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        ic.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        connect(b.MouseEnter, function()
            tw(b, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 })
            tw(ic, 0.12, { ImageColor3 = C.Text, Rotation = Lib.FX and 8 or 0 })
        end)
        connect(b.MouseLeave, function()
            tw(b, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
            tw(ic, 0.15, { ImageColor3 = C.Sub, Rotation = 0 })
        end)
        press(b)
        return b
    end

    function Lib:Confirm(c)
        sfx("alert")
        if not gui.Enabled then Lib:ToggleUI() end
        local f = openPopup(nil, 380, 236)
        f.ClipsDescendants = true
        local danger = c.Danger ~= false
        local col = danger and Color3.fromRGB(200, 30, 44) or accent()
        local topBar = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 3), ZIndex = 52 }, f)
        inst("UIGradient", {
            Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
        }, topBar)
        local tile = inst("Frame", {
            BackgroundColor3 = col:Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.75), BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 22), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52), ZIndex = 52,
        }, f)
        round(tile)
        local tl = stroke(tile, 0)
        tl.Color = col
        local ic = icon(c.Icon or (danger and "power" or "info"), 24, tile, col:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.2))
        ic.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        ic.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
        ic.ZIndex = 53
        local ring = inst("Frame", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52), ZIndex = 52,
        }, tile)
        round(ring)
        local rs = inst("UIStroke", { Color = col, Thickness = 2 }, ring)
        text({
            Text = tostring(c.Title or "Are you sure?"), FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 18, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 86), Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 24), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 52,
        }, f)
        text({
            Text = tostring(c.Content or ""), FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = C.Sub, TextWrapped = true,
            TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
            Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 114), Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 40), ZIndex = 52,
        }, f)
        local row = inst("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -18), Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 38), ZIndex = 52 }, f)
        list(row, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 10, nil, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
        local cb = makeButton(row, tostring(c.CancelText or "Cancel"), closePopup)
        local ob = makeButton(row, tostring(c.Button or "OK"), function()
            closePopup()
            if c.Callback then task.spawn(safe, c.Callback) end
        end, col)
        for k, bt in ipairs({ cb, ob }) do
            bt.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
            bt.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -5, 0, 38)
            bt.LayoutOrder = k
            bt.ZIndex = 52
        end
        local shine = inst("UIGradient", {
            Color = ColorSequence.new({
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)),
                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)),
            }),
            Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0), Rotation = 20,
        }, ob)
        if Lib.FX then
            local full = f.Size
            f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(full.X.Offset, 0)
            ease(f, 0.4, { Size = full })
            tile.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
            task.delay(0.12, function() ease(tile, 0.45, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
            ic.Rotation = -120
            task.delay(0.12, function() ease(ic, 0.5, { Rotation = 0 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
            task.spawn(function()
                while f.Parent do
                    ring.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(52, 52)
                    rs.Transparency = 0.1
                    ease(ring, 1.1, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(84, 84) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                    ease(rs, 1.1, { Transparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                    shine.Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0)
                    ease(shine, 0.9, { Offset = Vector2.new(1, 0) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
                    task.wait(1.4)
                end
            end)
        else
            rs.Transparency = 1
        end
    end

    Lib._toggles = {}
    Lib.StatusOn = false
    Lib.StatusIgnore = {}
    Lib.StatusScale = 1
    function Lib:SetStatusScale(s)
        Lib.StatusScale = tonumber(s) or 1
        if Lib._statusTick then pcall(Lib._statusTick) end
    end
    function Lib:SetStatusBar(on)
        Lib.StatusOn = on and true or false
        if Lib._statusTick then pcall(Lib._statusTick) end
    end

    local function newCard(tab, title, iconName)
        local f = inst("Frame", {
            Name = "Card", BackgroundColor3 = C.Card, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0),
        }, nil)
        surface(f, 0.35, 0)
        round(f, 14)
        local cst = stroke(f, 0.92)
        pad(f, 18, 18, 6, 6)
        list(f)
        local card = { frame = f, rows = {}, n = 0, search = string.lower(tostring(title or "")), titleText = title and tostring(title) or nil, stroke = cst }
        card.scale = inst("UIScale", {}, f)
        connect(f.MouseEnter, function()
            if Lib.FX then tw(cst, 0.2, { Color = accent(), Transparency = 0.55 }) end
        end)
        connect(f.MouseLeave, function() tw(cst, 0.25, { Color = C.Line, Transparency = 0.92 }) end)
        if not (UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.MouseEnabled) then
            f.ClipsDescendants = true
            local spotAnchor = inst("Frame", { Name = "SpotAnchor", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), LayoutOrder = -100 }, f)
            local spot = inst("Frame", {
                Name = "Spot", BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 260), ZIndex = 0,
            }, spotAnchor)
            round(spot)
            inst("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) }, spot)
            onAccent(function(c) spot.BackgroundColor3 = c end)
            connect(f.MouseMoved, function()
                if not Lib.FX then return end
                local m = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
                local org = overlay.AbsolutePosition
                local rel = m - (spotAnchor.AbsolutePosition - org)
                local sc = math.max(Lib._fit and Lib._fit.Scale or 1, 0.01)
                spot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(rel.X / sc, rel.Y / sc)
                if spot.BackgroundTransparency > 0.95 then tw(spot, 0.25, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.9 }) end
            end)
            connect(f.MouseLeave, function() tw(spot, 0.3, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end)
        end
        if title then
            local h = inst("Frame", { Name = "Header", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50), LayoutOrder = 0 }, f)
            local ic = icon(iconName, 18, h, C.Text)
            ic.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
            ic.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
            onAccent(function(c) ic.ImageColor3 = c:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.25) end)
            text({
                Text = tostring(title), FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 17, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 22), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            }, h)
        else
            card.headless = true
        end
        table.insert(tab.cards, card)
        if tab.queue then tab.queue() end
        return card
    end

    local function newRow(card, title, desc, ctlW, tip)
        card.n = card.n + 1
        local r = inst("Frame", {
            Name = "Row", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), LayoutOrder = card.n,
        }, card.frame)
        list(r)
        if not (card.headless and card.n == 1) then
            inst("Frame", { Name = "Line", BackgroundColor3 = C.Line, BackgroundTransparency = 0.93, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1), LayoutOrder = 0 }, r)
        end
        local body = inst("Frame", { Name = "Body", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), LayoutOrder = 1 }, r)
        local bpad = pad(body, 0, 0, 12, 12)
        list(body, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 12, nil, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
        local left = inst("Frame", {
            Name = "Left", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -(ctlW > 0 and ctlW + 12 or 0), 0, 0), LayoutOrder = 1,
        }, body)
        list(left, nil, 5)
        local t = text({
            Name = "Title", Text = tostring(title or ""), FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 15, TextWrapped = true,
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), LayoutOrder = 1,
        }, left)
        local d = text({
            Name = "Subtitle", Text = tostring(desc or ""), FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = C.Sub, TextWrapped = true,
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), LayoutOrder = 2,
            Visible = desc ~= nil and tostring(desc) ~= "",
        }, left)
        local right
        if ctlW > 0 then
            right = inst("Frame", { Name = "Right", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ctlW, 40), LayoutOrder = 2 }, body)
            list(right, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 0, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
        end
        local row = { frame = r, body = body, bpad = bpad, right = right, title = t, desc = d }
        function row.update() row.search = string.lower(t.Text .. " " .. d.Text) end
        function row.setTitle(s)
            t.Text = tostring(s or "")
            row.update()
        end
        function row.setDesc(s)
            local str = tostring(s or "")
            d.Text = str
            if row.tip then
                row.tipText = str
                if row.qb then row.qb.Visible = str ~= "" end
            else
                d.Visible = str ~= ""
            end
            row.update()
        end
        if tip then
            row.tip = true
            row.tipText = tostring(desc or "")
            d.Visible = false
            local qb = inst("TextButton", {
                Name = "Help", Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), ZIndex = 3,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(textWidth(t.Text, 15) + 6, 0), Visible = row.tipText ~= "",
            }, t)
            local qi = icon("help", 15, qb, C.Dim)
            qi.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            qi.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            qi.ZIndex = 3
            local qsc = inst("UIScale", {}, qi)
            row.qb = qb
            task.spawn(function()
                local ok, b = pcall(function()
                    local prm = Instance.new("GetTextBoundsParams")
                    prm.Text = t.Text
                    prm.Font = F.Semi
                    prm.Size = 15
                    prm.Width = 2000
                    return TextService:GetTextBoundsAsync(prm)
                end)
                if ok and b then qb.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(b.X) + 5, 0) end
            end)
            local touch = UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.MouseEnabled
            connect(qb.MouseEnter, function()
                tw(qi, 0.12, { ImageColor3 = accent() })
                ease(qsc, 0.25, { Scale = 1.2 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                if not touch then showTip(qb, row.tipText) end
            end)
            connect(qb.MouseLeave, function()
                tw(qi, 0.15, { ImageColor3 = C.Dim })
                ease(qsc, 0.2, { Scale = 1 })
                if not touch and Tip.owner == qb then hideTip() end
            end)
            connect(qb.MouseButton1Click, function()
                if Tip.owner == qb and tipF.Visible and not touch then return end
                showTip(qb, row.tipText)
            end)
        end
        function row.below(h)
            bpad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4)
            return inst("Frame", { Name = "Below", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), LayoutOrder = 2 }, r)
        end
        row.update()
        table.insert(card.rows, row)
        return row
    end

    local function makeOption(id, kind, cfg)
        local opt = { Type = kind, Value = nil, _cbs = {}, Title = cfg.Title }
        function opt:OnChanged(fn) table.insert(self._cbs, fn) end
        function opt:_fire()
            if cfg.Callback then task.spawn(safe, cfg.Callback, self.Value) end
            for _, fn in ipairs(self._cbs) do task.spawn(safe, fn, self.Value) end
            if not self.NoSave and Lib.QueueSave then Lib:QueueSave() end
        end
        if id then Lib.Options[id] = opt end
        return opt
    end

    function Lib:GetAccent() return Lib.AccentName end
    function Lib:SetTheme(name, instant)
        local th = Themes[name]
        if not th then return end
        local function key(c) return math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5) .. "," .. math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5) .. "," .. math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5) end
        local map = {}
        for _, k in ipairs({ "Bg", "Card", "Raise", "Hover", "Track", "Text", "Sub", "Dim" }) do
            local v = th[k]
            local nc = Color3.fromRGB(v[1], v[2], v[3])
            map[key(C[k])] = nc
            C[k] = nc
        end
        local props = { "BackgroundColor3", "TextColor3", "ImageColor3", "Color", "PlaceholderColor3", "ScrollBarImageColor3" }
        local anim = Lib.FX and not instant
        for _, root in ipairs({ gui, top }) do
            for _, d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
                for _, pr in ipairs(props) do
                    local ok, v = pcall(function() return d[pr] end)
                    if ok and typeof(v) == "Color3" then
                        local nc = map[key(v)]
                        if nc then
                            if anim then pcall(function() tw(d, 0.5, { [pr] = nc }) end) else pcall(function() d[pr] = nc end) end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        Lib.ThemeName = name
        Lib:SetAccent(name)
        if Lib._themeHooks then for _, fn in ipairs(Lib._themeHooks) do pcall(fn, name) end end
    end
    function Lib:SetAccent(name)
        if not Accents[name] then return end
        Lib.AccentName = name
        for _, fn in ipairs(accentHooks) do pcall(fn, Accents[name]) end
        if Lib.QueueSave then Lib:QueueSave() end
    end
    function Lib:SetGlass(on)
        Lib.Glass = on and true or false
        for _, s in ipairs(Lib._surfaces) do
            pcall(function() s[1].BackgroundTransparency = Lib.Glass and s[2] or s[3] end)
        end
        if Lib.QueueSave then Lib:QueueSave() end
    end
    function Lib:ToggleUI()
        if Lib._folding then return end
        if gui.Enabled then
            closePopup()
            hideTip()
            if Lib.FX and Lib._fold then
                Lib._fold(false, function()
                    gui.Enabled = false
                    if Lib.OnToggle then pcall(Lib.OnToggle) end
                end)
                return
            end
            gui.Enabled = false
        else
            gui.Enabled = true
            if Lib.FX and Lib._fold then Lib._fold(true) end
        end
        if Lib.OnToggle then pcall(Lib.OnToggle) end
    end

    Lib.Folder = "Academy Hub"
    Lib.Name = "Academy Hub"
    Lib.Version = "5.0"
    Lib.Author = "Academy Hub"
    Lib.Copyright = "Academy Hub UI - Copyright (c) 2026 Academy Hub. MIT License."
    Lib.Source = "https://github.com/ZeroHubX2/TEST1"
    Lib.AutoSave = false
    local function fsOk() return writefile and readfile and isfile end
    function Lib:EnsureFolder(path)
        path = path or Lib.Folder
        if not (makefolder and isfolder) then return end
        local acc = ""
        for part in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do
            acc = acc == "" and part or (acc .. "/" .. part)
            if not isfolder(acc) then pcall(makefolder, acc) end
        end
    end
    function Lib:Path(file) return Lib.Folder .. "/" .. file end

    local function collect()
        local data = { __theme = Lib.AccentName, __autosave = Lib.AutoSave, __themeName = Lib.ThemeName }
        if Lib.WinState then
            data.__size, data.__pos, data.__btn = Lib.WinState.size, Lib.WinState.pos, Lib.WinState.btn
        end
        data.__status = Lib.StatusPos
        for id, opt in pairs(Lib.Options) do
            if not opt.NoSave then
                if opt.Type == "Color" and typeof(opt.Value) == "Color3" then
                    data[id] = string.format("#%02x%02x%02x", math.floor(opt.Value.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(opt.Value.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(opt.Value.B * 255 + 0.5))
                elseif opt.Type == "Dropdown" and opt.Multi then
                    local arr = {}
                    for k, v in pairs(opt.Value) do if v then table.insert(arr, k) end end
                    data[id] = arr
                elseif opt.Type ~= "Button" then
                    data[id] = opt.Value
                end
            end
        end
        return data
    end
    function Lib:SaveConfig(name)
        if not fsOk() then return false, "executor has no file API" end
        Lib:EnsureFolder()
        local ok, err = pcall(writefile, Lib:Path((name or "config") .. ".json"), HttpService:JSONEncode(collect()))
        return ok, err
    end
    function Lib:ReadConfig(name, path)
        if not fsOk() then return nil, "executor has no file API" end
        path = path or Lib:Path((name or "config") .. ".json")
        if not isfile(path) then return nil, "no saved config" end
        local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(path)) end)
        if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" then return nil, "config is corrupt" end
        return data
    end
    function Lib:ApplyConfig(data)
        Lib._loading = true
        if data.__themeName and Themes[data.__themeName] and data.__themeName ~= Lib.ThemeName then
            Lib:SetTheme(data.__themeName, true)
        end
        if data.__theme then
            Lib:SetAccent(data.__theme)
            local a = Lib.Options.Accent
            if a then a:SetValue(data.__theme) end
        end
        if Lib.ApplyWindowState then
            pcall(Lib.ApplyWindowState, data)
        else
            Lib._pendingWin = data
        end
        if type(data.__status) == "table" and tonumber(data.__status[1]) and tonumber(data.__status[2]) then
            Lib.StatusPos = { tonumber(data.__status[1]), tonumber(data.__status[2]) }
        end
        for id, v in pairs(data) do
            local opt = Lib.Options[id]
            if opt and not opt.NoSave and opt.SetValue then pcall(opt.SetValue, opt, v) end
        end
        Lib._loading = false
    end
    function Lib:LoadConfig(name, path)
        local data, err = Lib:ReadConfig(name, path)
        if not data then return false, err end
        Lib:ApplyConfig(data)
        return true
    end

    local saveToken = 0
    function Lib:QueueSave()
        if not Lib.AutoSave or Lib._loading or Lib.Unloaded then return end
        saveToken = saveToken + 1
        local my = saveToken
        task.delay(1, function()
            if my == saveToken and Lib.AutoSave and not Lib.Unloaded then Lib:SaveConfig("config") end
        end)
    end

    function Lib:CreateWindow(cfg)
        local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
        if cfg.ConfigFolder then Lib.Folder = cfg.ConfigFolder end
        if cfg.Wordmark == nil then cfg.Wordmark = false end
        if cfg.Wordmark == false then cfg.Wordmark = nil end
        if cfg.Title then Lib.Name = tostring(cfg.Title) end
        if cfg.Logo then LOGO_ID = cfg.Logo end
        Lib.ToggleKey = cfg.ToggleKey or Enum.KeyCode.RightControl
        local baseSub = cfg.SubTitle or ""
        local W = { order = 0 }

        local saved = Lib:ReadConfig("config") or {}
        if type(saved.__themeName) == "string" and Themes[saved.__themeName] then pcall(function() Lib:SetTheme(saved.__themeName, true) end) end
        local vp0 = viewport()
        local isMobile = UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled
        local defW, defH = cfg.Width or 1000, cfg.Height or 660
        if isMobile then defW, defH = math.max(vp0.X - 24, 420), math.max(vp0.Y - 70, 280) end
        local winSize = UDim2.fromOffset(defW, defH)
        if type(saved.__size) == "table" and tonumber(saved.__size[1]) and tonumber(saved.__size[2]) then
            local sw, sh = tonumber(saved.__size[1]), tonumber(saved.__size[2])
            if not ((sw == 640 and sh == 440) or (sw == 580 and sh == 380)) then
                winSize = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(sw, 420), math.max(sh, 280))
            end
        end
        local winPos = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, isMobile and 22 or 0)
        if type(saved.__pos) == "table" then
            local a = saved.__pos
            winPos = UDim2.new(tonumber(a[1]) or 0.5, tonumber(a[2]) or 0, tonumber(a[3]) or 0.5, tonumber(a[4]) or 0)
        end

        local body = inst("Frame", {
            Name = "Window", AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = winPos, Size = winSize,
            BackgroundColor3 = C.Bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true,
        }, gui)
        surface(body, 0.3, 0)
        round(body, 18)
        glow(stroke(body, 0.9), 0.9)
        local fit = inst("UIScale", { Name = "ZX_Fit" }, body)
        do
            local layer = inst("Frame", { Name = "FX", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 0, ClipsDescendants = true }, body)
            Lib._fxLayer = layer
            local parts = {}
            for i = 1, 18 do
                local sz = math.random(2, 3)
                local q = { x = math.random(), y = math.random(), v = 0.008 + math.random() * 0.02, ph = math.random() * 6.28, tint = i % 4 == 0 }
                q.f = inst("Frame", {
                    BackgroundColor3 = q.tint and accent() or Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.7 + math.random() * 0.2,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz), Position = UDim2.fromScale(q.x, q.y), ZIndex = 0,
                }, layer)
                round(q.f)
                parts[i] = q
            end
            local ribbons = {}
            for i = 1, 2 do
                local rb = inst("Frame", {
                    BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.fromScale(i == 1 and 0.3 or 0.75, i == 1 and 0.75 or 0.35), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.5, 0.42), Rotation = i == 1 and -14 or 18, ZIndex = 0,
                }, layer)
                inst("UIGradient", {
                    Rotation = 90,
                    Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, i == 1 and 0.88 or 0.92), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
                }, rb)
                ribbons[i] = { f = rb, t = math.random() * 10, base = rb.Rotation }
            end
            onAccent(function(c)
                for _, q in ipairs(parts) do if q.tint then q.f.BackgroundColor3 = c end end
                ribbons[1].f.BackgroundColor3 = c
                ribbons[2].f.BackgroundColor3 = c:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.25)
            end)
            Lib._fxStep = function(dt)
                if not gui.Enabled then return end
                for i, r in ipairs(ribbons) do
                    r.t = r.t + dt * (i == 1 and 0.18 or 0.13)
                    r.f.Rotation = r.base + math.sin(r.t) * 9
                    r.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale((i == 1 and 0.3 or 0.72) + math.sin(r.t * 0.7) * 0.12, (i == 1 and 0.72 or 0.34) + math.cos(r.t * 0.9) * 0.08)
                end
                for _, q in ipairs(parts) do
                    q.y = q.y - q.v * dt
                    if q.y < -0.04 then
                        q.y = 1.04
                        q.x = math.random()
                    end
                    q.ph = q.ph + dt * 0.8
                    q.f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(q.x + math.sin(q.ph) * 0.012, q.y)
                end
            end
        end

        do
            local dim = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 158)
            local function shineOn(o)
                local g = inst("UIGradient", {
                    Color = ColorSequence.new({
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, dim), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.38, dim), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.62, dim), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, dim),
                    }),
                    Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0), Rotation = 18,
                }, o)
                local sc = inst("UIScale", {}, o)
                return g, sc
            end
            local targets = { { wordText, shineOn(wordText) } }
            if wm then
                local g, sc = shineOn(wm)
                targets[2] = { wm, g, sc }
            end
            local function play(glitch)
                for _, tg in ipairs(targets) do
                    local o, g, sc = tg[1], tg[2], tg[3]
                    if o.Visible then
                        g.Offset = Vector2.new(-1, 0)
                        ease(g, 1.1, { Offset = Vector2.new(1, 0) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
                        sc.Scale = 1
                        ease(sc, 0.18, { Scale = 1.05 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                        task.delay(0.18, function() ease(sc, 0.4, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
                        if glitch then
                            local col = accent()
                            task.spawn(function()
                                for k = 1, 3 do
                                    if o:IsA("ImageLabel") then o.ImageColor3 = col else o.TextColor3 = col end
                                    sc.Scale = 1 + (k % 2 == 0 and -0.03 or 0.04)
                                    task.wait(0.05)
                                    if o:IsA("ImageLabel") then o.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) else o.TextColor3 = C.Text end
                                    sc.Scale = 1
                                    task.wait(0.05)
                                end
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

        end
        function W.indTarget(tab)
            local s2 = math.max(fit.Scale, 0.01)
            return (tab.pill.AbsolutePosition.X - tabsRow.AbsolutePosition.X) / s2, tab.pill.AbsoluteSize.X / s2
        end
        function W.moveIndicator(tab, anim)
            if not tab or not tab.pill then return end
            local x, w = W.indTarget(tab)
            if not (anim and Lib.FX) or not W.ix then
                W.ix, W.iw, W.vx, W.vw = x, w, 0, 0
                ind.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0.5, 0)
                ind.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 38)
            end
        end
        Lib._tabStep = function(dt)
            local tab = W.active
            if not (tab and tab.pill and W.ix and gui.Enabled) then return end
            dt = math.min(dt, 1 / 30)
            local x, w = W.indTarget(tab)
            W.vx = W.vx + ((x - W.ix) * 420 - W.vx * 41) * dt
            W.vw = W.vw + ((w - W.iw) * 420 - W.vw * 41) * dt
            W.ix = W.ix + W.vx * dt
            W.iw = W.iw + W.vw * dt
            ind.Position = UDim2.new(0, W.ix, 0.5, 0)
            ind.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(W.iw, 0), 38)
        end
        function W.fitTabs()
            local s2 = math.max(fit.Scale, 0.01)
            local avail = tabsBar.AbsoluteSize.X / s2 - 6
            local pills, other, natural = {}, 0, 0
            for _, ch in ipairs(tabsRow:GetChildren()) do
                if ch:IsA("TextButton") and ch.Name == "Tab" then
                    pills[#pills + 1] = ch
                    local lb = ch:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TextLabel")
                    natural = natural + 13 + 17 + 7 + (lb and textWidth(lb.Text, 15) or 60) + 15
                elseif ch:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    other = other + ch.Size.X.Offset
                end
            end
            local n = #pills
            if n == 0 then return end
            local items = n + (#tabsRow:GetChildren() - n - 1)
            local gaps = math.max(items - 1, 0) * 4
            local fill = natural + other + gaps <= avail
            local pw = math.floor((avail - other - gaps) / n)
            if fill and pills[1].AutomaticSize == Enum.AutomaticSize.None and math.abs(pills[1].Size.X.Offset - pw) <= 1 then
                pw = pills[1].Size.X.Offset
            end
            for _, pl in ipairs(pills) do
                if fill then
                    pl.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
                    pl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(pw, 38)
                else
                    pl.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
                    pl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 38)
                end
            end
        end
        function W.queueFit()
            if W.fitQ then return end
            W.fitQ = true
            task.defer(function()

                if Lib._animWin then return end
                pcall(W.fitTabs)
            end)
        end

            W.arrows[1].Visible = over and tabsBar.CanvasPosition.X > 2
            W.arrows[2].Visible = over and tabsBar.CanvasPosition.X < maxX - 2
        end

        local function layoutHeader()
            local w = body.Size.X.Offset
            local compact = body.Size.Y.Offset < 480
            badge.Visible = baseSub ~= "" and w >= 560
            made.Visible = w >= 520
            bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, compact and 54 or 64)
            tabsWrap.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, compact and 52 or 64)
            tabsWrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, compact and 44 or 48)
            head.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, compact and 100 or 120)
            head.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, compact and 44 or 64)
            titleL.TextSize = compact and 20 or 26
            titleL.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, compact and 4 or 8)
            titleL.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, compact and 24 or 32)
            descL.Visible = not compact
            local top0 = compact and 146 or 188
            local footH = compact and 36 or 44
            foot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, footH)
            pages.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, top0)
            pages.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -(top0 + footH + 2))
        end

        local function colCount()
            local w = body.Size.X.Offset - 36
            if w >= 560 then return 2 end
            return 1
        end
        local function relayout(tab)
            if not tab then return end
            local n = colCount()
            for _, g in ipairs(tab.grids or {}) do
                local k = (body.Size.X.Offset - 48 >= 560) and 4 or 2
                g.CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / k, -math.floor(10 * (k - 1) / k + 0.5), 0, 80)
            end
            if tab.ncols ~= n then
                local old = tab.cols or {}
                tab.cols = {}
                for i = 1, n do
                    local col = inst("Frame", {
                        Name = "Column" .. i, BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1 / n, -math.floor(12 * (n - 1) / n + 0.5), 0, 0), LayoutOrder = i,
                    }, tab.holder)
                    list(col, nil, 12)
                    tab.cols[i] = col
                end
                for _, card in ipairs(tab.cards) do card.frame.Parent = tab.cols[1] end
                for _, col in ipairs(old) do col:Destroy() end
                tab.ncols = n
            end
            local heights = {}
            for i = 1, n do heights[i] = 0 end
            local s = math.max(fit.Scale, 0.01)
            for idx, card in ipairs(tab.cards) do
                local k = 1
                if card.frame.Visible then
                    for i = 2, n do if heights[i] < heights[k] - 1 then k = i end end
                    local h = card.frame.AbsoluteSize.Y / s
                    if h < 10 then h = 90 + #card.rows * 64 end
                    heights[k] = heights[k] + h + 12
                end
                card.frame.LayoutOrder = idx
                if card.frame.Parent ~= tab.cols[k] then card.frame.Parent = tab.cols[k] end
            end
        end
        local function queue(tab)
            if tab._q then return end
            tab._q = true
            task.defer(function()
                tab._q = false
                if not Lib.Unloaded then relayout(tab) end
            end)
        end

        local function applySearch(tab)
            local q = string.lower(W.query or "")
            for _, card in ipairs(tab.cards) do
                local cardHit = q ~= "" and card.search:find(q, 1, true) ~= nil
                local any = false
                for _, r in ipairs(card.rows) do
                    local m = q == "" or cardHit or r.search:find(q, 1, true) ~= nil
                    r.frame.Visible = m
                    if m then any = true end
                end
                card.frame.Visible = q == "" or any or cardHit
            end
            relayout(tab)
        end

        local function select(tab)
            if W.active == tab then return end
            if W.active then
                W.active.page.Visible = false
                W.active.paint(false)
            end
            if W.active then sfx("tab") end
            Lib._activeTab = tostring(tab.Title or "")
            W.active = tab
            tab.page.Visible = true
            tab.paint(true)
            task.defer(function()
                W.moveIndicator(tab, W.indReady)
                if W.indReady then task.delay(0.3, W.shine) end
                W.indReady = true
            end)
            if Lib.FX then
                tab.stack.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 44)
                tab.stackScale.Scale = 0.95
                ease(tab.stack, 0.55, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 0) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                ease(tab.stackScale, 0.55, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                for i, card in ipairs(tab.cards) do
                    if i > 10 then break end
                    card.scale.Scale = 0.92
                    card.frame.Rotation = (i % 2 == 0) and 1.6 or -1.6
                    task.delay((i - 1) * 0.05, function()
                        ease(card.scale, 0.5, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                        ease(card.frame, 0.5, { Rotation = 0 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                    end)
                end
                local ty, dy = titleL.Position.Y.Offset, descL.Position.Y.Offset
                titleL.TextTransparency, descL.TextTransparency = 1, 1
                titleL.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(42, ty)
                descL.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(42, dy)
                ease(titleL, 0.35, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, ty), TextTransparency = 0 })
                task.delay(0.06, function() ease(descL, 0.35, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24, dy), TextTransparency = 0 }) end)
            end
            if tab.greeting then
                local hr = tonumber(os.date("%H")) or 12
                local g = hr < 5 and "Good night" or hr < 12 and "Good morning" or hr < 18 and "Good afternoon" or "Good evening"
                titleL.Text = g .. ", " .. tostring(LP.DisplayName)
            else
                titleL.Text = tostring(tab.Title or "")
            end
            descL.Text = tostring(tab.Desc or "")
            if Lib.FX then
                W.typeTok = (W.typeTok or 0) + 1
                local my = W.typeTok
                local full = utf8.len(titleL.Text) or #titleL.Text
                titleL.MaxVisibleGraphemes = 0
                titleL.TextColor3 = accent()
                task.spawn(function()
                    local steps = math.clamp(full, 1, 40)
                    for i2 = 1, steps do
                        if W.typeTok ~= my then return end
                        titleL.MaxVisibleGraphemes = math.ceil(full * i2 / steps)
                        task.wait(0.014)
                    end
                    if W.typeTok ~= my then return end
                    titleL.MaxVisibleGraphemes = -1
                    tw(titleL, 0.35, { TextColor3 = C.Text })
                end)
            else
                titleL.MaxVisibleGraphemes = -1
                titleL.TextColor3 = C.Text
            end
            closePopup()
            hideTip()
            applySearch(tab)
            task.defer(function()
                local s = math.max(fit.Scale, 0.01)
                local cx = tabsBar.CanvasPosition.X
                local left = (tab.pill.AbsolutePosition.X - tabsBar.AbsolutePosition.X) / s + cx
                local pw = tab.pill.AbsoluteSize.X / s
                local view = tabsBar.AbsoluteWindowSize.X / s
                if left < cx + 8 or left + pw > cx + view - 8 then
                    W.scrollTabs(left + pw / 2 - view / 2, true)
                end
            end)
            task.delay(0.2, function()
                if W.active == tab and not Lib.Unloaded then relayout(tab) end
            end)
        end

        function W.jumpTo(e)
            select(e.tab)
            task.delay(0.35, function()
                local page = e.tab.page
                local s2 = math.max(fit.Scale, 0.01)
                local y = (e.row.frame.AbsolutePosition.Y - page.AbsolutePosition.Y) / s2 + page.CanvasPosition.Y - 24
                tw(page, 0.35, { CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(y, 0)) })
                local cs = e.card.stroke
                if cs then
                    cs.Color = accent()
                    cs.Transparency = 0
                    task.delay(1, function() tw(cs, 0.6, { Color = C.Line, Transparency = 0.92 }) end)
                end
                local t = e.row.title
                t.TextColor3 = accent()
                task.delay(1, function() tw(t, 0.6, { TextColor3 = C.Text }) end)
            end)
        end
        local function valueOf(r)
            local o = r.opt
            if not o then return nil end
            if r.kind == "Toggle" then return o.Value and "On" or "Off", o.Value end
            if r.kind == "Slider" then return tostring(o.Value) .. (r.unit and r.unit ~= "" and (" " .. r.unit) or "") end
            if r.kind == "Dropdown" then
                if o.Multi then
                    local k = 0
                    for _, x in pairs(o.Value or {}) do if x then k = k + 1 end end
                    return k .. " selected"
                end
                return tostring(o.Value or "-")
            end
            if r.kind == "Input" then return tostring(o.Value or "") end
            return nil
        end
        function W.openPalette()
            sfx("open")
            local f = openPopup(nil, 540, 430)
            f.ClipsDescendants = true
            if Lib.FX then
                local full = f.Size
                f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(full.X.Offset, 0)
                ease(f, 0.4, { Size = full })
            end
            local head = inst("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 16), Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 34), ZIndex = 52 }, f)
            local tile = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = accent():Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.75), BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34), ZIndex = 52 }, head)
            round(tile, 10)
            stroke(tile, 0.3).Color = accent()
            local ti = icon("search", 16, tile, accent():Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.3))
            ti.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            ti.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            ti.ZIndex = 53
