            text({ Text = "Search", FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 17, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(46, -1), Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, 20), ZIndex = 52 }, head)
            text({ Text = "Find any setting in every tab", FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.Sub, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(46, 18), Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 0, 16), ZIndex = 52 }, head)
            local key = text({
                Text = (UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled) and "Tap a result" or "Ctrl + F", FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 11,
                TextColor3 = C.Sub, BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BackgroundTransparency = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22),
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 52,
            }, head)
            round(key, 6)
            pad(key, 8, 8, 0, 0)
            stroke(key, 0.85)
            local qbox = inst("TextBox", {
                BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 62), Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 44),
                FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = C.Text, PlaceholderText = "Type a setting, like height or auto farm",
                PlaceholderColor3 = C.Dim, Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 52,
            }, f)
            round(qbox, 11)
            pad(qbox, 16, 16, 0, 0)
            local qs = stroke(qbox, 0.85)
            connect(qbox.Focused, function() tw(qs, 0.2, { Color = accent(), Transparency = 0.2 }) end)
            connect(qbox.FocusLost, function() tw(qs, 0.2, { Color = C.Line, Transparency = 0.85 }) end)
            local label = text({
                Text = "JUMP TO", FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = C.Dim, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 118),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 14), ZIndex = 52,
            }, f)
            local chips = inst("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 138), Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ZIndex = 52 }, f)
            local cg = inst("UIGridLayout", { CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), CellSize = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -6, 0, 46), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, chips)
            for i, tb in ipairs(Window.Tabs) do
                local cbtn = inst("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = 52 }, chips)
                round(cbtn, 11)
                local cl = stroke(cbtn, 0.9)
                local ci = icon(tb.icon, 16, cbtn, C.Sub)
                ci.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
                ci.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, 0)
                ci.ZIndex = 53
                text({
                    Text = tostring(tb.Title or ""), FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 13, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -46, 1, 0),
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 53,
                }, cbtn)
                if Lib.FX then
                    local sc0 = inst("UIScale", { Scale = 0.6 }, cbtn)
                    task.delay(0.1 + (i - 1) * 0.04, function() ease(sc0, 0.4, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
                end
                cbtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                    tw(cl, 0.15, { Color = accent(), Transparency = 0.3 })
                    tw(ci, 0.15, { ImageColor3 = accent() })
                end)
                cbtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                    tw(cl, 0.2, { Color = C.Line, Transparency = 0.9 })
                    tw(ci, 0.2, { ImageColor3 = C.Sub })
                end)
                cbtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    closePopup()
                    select(tb)
                end)
            end
            local res = inst("ScrollingFrame", {
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 138), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -150),
                CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
                ScrollBarThickness = 3, ScrollBarImageColor3 = C.Dim, Visible = false, ZIndex = 52,
            }, f)
            list(res, nil, 4)
            local empty = text({
                Text = "", FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = C.Dim, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 60),
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, LayoutOrder = 0, ZIndex = 52,
            }, res)
            local index = {}
            for _, tb in ipairs(Window.Tabs) do
                for _, cd in ipairs(tb.cards) do
                    for _, r in ipairs(cd.rows) do
                        if r.title and r.search and r.title.Text ~= "" then
                            index[#index + 1] = { tab = tb, card = cd, row = r }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            local function render(q)
                for _, ch in ipairs(res:GetChildren()) do
                    if ch:IsA("TextButton") then ch:Destroy() end
                end
                q = string.lower(q or "")
                local searching = q ~= ""
                chips.Visible = not searching
                res.Visible = searching
                label.Text = searching and "RESULTS" or "JUMP TO"
                if not searching then return end
                local n = 0
                for _, e in ipairs(index) do
                    if n >= 40 then break end
                    local hay = e.row.search .. " " .. string.lower(tostring(e.tab.Title or "")) .. " " .. (e.card.search or "")
                    if hay:find(q, 1, true) then
                        n = n + 1
                        local b = inst("TextButton", {
                            Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                            Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 54), LayoutOrder = n, ZIndex = 52,
                        }, res)
                        round(b, 11)
                        local tile2 = inst("Frame", {
                            BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, 0),
                            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36), ZIndex = 53,
                        }, b)
                        round(tile2, 10)
                        local i2 = icon(e.tab.icon, 16, tile2, accent():Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.25))
                        i2.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                        i2.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
                        i2.ZIndex = 54
                        text({
                            Text = e.row.title.Text, FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 14, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 9),
                            Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 18), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 53,
                        }, b)
                        text({
                            Text = tostring(e.tab.Title or "") .. (e.card.titleText and ("  ›  " .. e.card.titleText) or ""),
                            FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.Sub, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 28),
                            Size = UDim2.new(1, -170, 0, 16), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 53,
                        }, b)
                        local v, on = valueOf(e.row)
                        if v then
                            local vc = text({
                                Text = v, FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = (on == true) and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or C.Sub,
                                BackgroundColor3 = (on == true) and accent() or C.Raise, BackgroundTransparency = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                                Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 24),
                                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 53,
                            }, b)
                            round(vc, 7)
                            pad(vc, 9, 9, 0, 0)
                            inst("UISizeConstraint", { MaxSize = Vector2.new(120, 24) }, vc)
                            vc.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
                        end
                        if Lib.FX and n <= 10 then
                            local sc1 = inst("UIScale", { Scale = 0.9 }, b)
                            task.delay((n - 1) * 0.03, function() ease(sc1, 0.3, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
                        end
                        b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tw(b, 0.12, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }) end)
                        b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tw(b, 0.15, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }) end)
                        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                            closePopup()
                            sfx("select")
                            W.jumpTo(e)
                        end)
                    end
                end
                empty.Visible = n == 0
                empty.Text = n == 0 and ('Nothing matches "' .. q .. '"') or ""
            end
            render("")
            qbox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function() render(qbox.Text) end)
            task.defer(function() pcall(function() qbox:CaptureFocus() end) end)
        end
        connect(findBtn.MouseButton1Click, function() W.openPalette() end)
        connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(i, gp)
            if gp or not gui.Enabled then return end
            if i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F and (UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightControl)) then
                W.openPalette()
            end
        end)

        function Window:AddSection(title)
            if #Window.Tabs == 0 then return end
            W.order = W.order + 1
            inst("Frame", {
                Name = "Divider", BackgroundColor3 = C.Line, BackgroundTransparency = 0.86, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 24), LayoutOrder = W.order,
            }, tabsRow)
        end
        function Window:SetProfile(line)
            if line == W.lastProfile then return end
            W.lastProfile = line
            paintProfile()
        end

        function Window:AddTab(tcfg)
            W.order = W.order + 1
            local tab = { Title = tcfg.Title, Desc = tcfg.Description, icon = tcfg.Icon, cards = {}, greeting = tcfg.Greeting, grids = {} }
            local pill = inst("TextButton", {
                Name = "Tab", Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 38), LayoutOrder = W.order,
            }, tabsRow)
            round(pill, 10)
            tab.pill = pill
            if W.queueFit then W.queueFit() end
            pad(pill, 13, 15, 0, 0)
            list(pill, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 7, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
            local pic = icon(tcfg.Icon, 17, pill, C.Sub)
            pic.LayoutOrder = 1
            local plb = text({
                Text = tostring(tcfg.Title or ""), FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = C.Sub,
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 38), LayoutOrder = 2,
            }, pill)
            function tab.paint(on)
                tab.on = on
                pill.BackgroundColor3 = accent()
                pill.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                tw(pic, 0.2, { ImageColor3 = on and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or C.Sub })
                tw(plb, 0.2, { TextColor3 = on and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or C.Sub })
            end
            onAccent(function() tab.paint(tab.on) end)
            connect(pill.MouseButton1Click, function() select(tab) end)

            local page = inst("ScrollingFrame", {
                Name = "Page", Visible = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
                CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
                ScrollBarThickness = 3, ScrollBarImageColor3 = C.Dim, ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.3,
            }, pages)
            pad(page, 0, 0, 2, 16)
            local stack = inst("Frame", {
                Name = "Stack", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 0),
            }, page)
            list(stack, nil, 12)
            tab.stackScale = inst("UIScale", {}, stack)
            local wide = inst("Frame", { Name = "Wide", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), LayoutOrder = 1 }, stack)
            list(wide, nil, 12)
            local holder = inst("Frame", {
                Name = "Columns", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), LayoutOrder = 2,
            }, stack)
            list(holder, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 12)
            tab.page, tab.holder, tab.stack, tab.wide = page, holder, stack, wide
            tab.queue = function() queue(tab) end
            table.insert(Window.Tabs, tab)

            local function cur()
                if not tab.card then tab.card = newCard(tab, nil) end
                return tab.card
            end

            function tab:AddSection(title)
                tab.card = newCard(tab, title, sectionIcon(title, tab.icon))
            end

            function tab:AddParagraph(pcfg)
                local r = newRow(cur(), pcfg.Title, tostring(pcfg.Content or ""), 0)
                local p = { Instance = r.frame, Title = pcfg.Title }
                function p:SetDesc(txt) r.setDesc(txt) end
                function p:SetTitle(txt)
                    r.setTitle(txt)
                    p.Title = tostring(txt or "")
                end
                return p
            end

            function tab:AddButton(bcfg)
                local label = bcfg.ButtonText or "Run"
                local r = newRow(cur(), bcfg.Title, bcfg.Description, buttonWidth(label), true)
                makeButton(r.right, label, function()
                    if bcfg.Callback then task.spawn(safe, bcfg.Callback) end
                end)
                return { SetTitle = function(_, s) r.setTitle(s) end, SetDesc = function(_, s) r.setDesc(s) end }
            end

            function tab:AddToggle(id, ocfg)
                local r = newRow(cur(), ocfg.Title, ocfg.Description, 56, true)
                local opt = makeOption(id, "Toggle", ocfg)
                r.opt, r.kind = opt, "Toggle"
                opt.Value = ocfg.Default and true or false
                if id then table.insert(Lib._toggles, { id = id, opt = opt }) end
                opt.Pin = ocfg.Pin
                local sw = makeSwitch(r.right, opt.Value, function(v)
                    if v == opt.Value then return end
                    opt.Value = v
                    opt:_fire()
                end)
                function opt:SetValue(v)
                    v = v and true or false
                    if v == self.Value then return end
                    self.Value = v
                    sw.set(v)
                    self:_fire()
                end
                return opt
            end

            function tab:AddSlider(id, ocfg)
                local min, max, dec = ocfg.Min, ocfg.Max, ocfg.Rounding or 0
                local title = tostring(ocfg.Title or "")
                local name, unit = title:match("^(.-)%s*%((.-)%)%s*$")
                if not name or name == "" then name, unit = title, nil end
                local r = newRow(cur(), name, ocfg.Description, 130, true)
                local opt = makeOption(id, "Slider", ocfg)
                r.opt, r.kind, r.unit = opt, "Slider", unit
                local function rnd(v)
                    local m = 10 ^ dec
                    return math.floor(v * m + 0.5) / m
                end
                local function fmt(v) return (dec > 0) and string.format("%." .. dec .. "f", v) or tostring(math.floor(v + 0.5)) end
                opt.Value = math.clamp(rnd(tonumber(ocfg.Default) or min), min, max)
                local vb = inst("TextButton", {
                    Name = "Value", Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 36),
                }, r.right)
                round(vb, 12)
                pad(vb, 14, 14, 0, 0)
                list(vb, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 5, nil, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
                local vbLine = stroke(vb, 1)
                local box = inst("TextBox", {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1, FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = C.Text, Text = "",
                    ClearTextOnFocus = false, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 36), LayoutOrder = 1,
                }, vb)
                inst("UISizeConstraint", { MinSize = Vector2.new(28, 0) }, box)
                connect(vb.MouseButton1Click, function() box:CaptureFocus() end)
                connect(box.Focused, function()
                    vbLine.Color = accent()
                    vbLine.Transparency = 0
                    pcall(function()
                        box.CursorPosition = #box.Text + 1
                        box.SelectionStart = 1
                    end)
                end)
                if unit and unit ~= "" then
                    text({ Text = unit, FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = C.Sub, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 36), LayoutOrder = 2 }, vb)
                end
                local area = r.below(36)
                local hit = inst("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(42, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -84, 0, 32) }, area)
                local trk = inst("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 6),
                    BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                }, hit)
                round(trk)
                stroke(trk, 0.9)
                local fill = inst("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BorderSizePixel = 0 }, trk)
                round(fill)
                inst("UIGradient", { Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)) }, fill)
                local knob = inst("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20),
                    BackgroundColor3 = C.Bg, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2,
                }, trk)
                round(knob)
                local kring = inst("UIStroke", { Color = accent(), Thickness = 3 }, knob)
                local kdot = inst("Frame", {
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3,
                }, knob)
                round(kdot)
                local bubble = text({
                    Text = "", FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BackgroundTransparency = 0,
                    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -8), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 4, Visible = false,
                }, knob)
                round(bubble, 6)
                pad(bubble, 7, 7, 0, 0)
                local bscale = inst("UIScale", { Scale = 0 }, bubble)
                onAccent(function(c)
                    fill.BackgroundColor3 = c
                    kring.Color = c
                    bubble.BackgroundColor3 = c
                end)
                local tws = {}
                local function render(v, anim)
                    local a = (max > min) and math.clamp((v - min) / (max - min), 0, 1) or 0
                    for _, x in ipairs(tws) do x:Cancel() end
                    table.clear(tws)
                    if anim and Lib.FX then
                        tws[1] = ease(fill, 0.3, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(a, 1) })
                        tws[2] = ease(knob, 0.3, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(a, 0.5) })
                    else
                        fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(a, 1)
                        knob.Position = UDim2.fromScale(a, 0.5)
                    end
                    if not box:IsFocused() then box.Text = fmt(v) end
                    bubble.Text = fmt(v) .. (unit and unit ~= "" and (" " .. unit) or "")
                end
                local function commit(v, anim)
                    if v == nil then render(opt.Value, anim) return end
                    v = math.clamp(rnd(v), min, max)
                    render(v, anim)
                    if v == opt.Value then return end
                    opt.Value = v
                    opt:_fire()
                end
                local function fromX(x)
                    local a = math.clamp((x - trk.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(trk.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
                    return min + a * (max - min)
                end
                local step = dec > 0 and 10 ^ -dec or 1
                local held = { n = 0 }
                for _, dir in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
                    local sb = inst("TextButton", {
                        Name = dir < 0 and "Minus" or "Plus", Text = dir < 0 and "-" or "+", FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 20,
                        TextColor3 = C.Text, AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
                        BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(dir < 0 and 0 or 1, 0.5),
                        Position = UDim2.new(dir < 0 and 0 or 1, 0, 0.5, -2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34),
                    }, area)
                    round(sb)
                    connect(sb.InputBegan, function(i)
                        if not isPress(i) then return end
                        held.n = held.n + 1
                        local my = held.n
                        sb.BackgroundColor3 = C.Hover
                        commit(opt.Value + dir * step, true)
                        sfx("tick", 0.8)
                        task.delay(0.4, function()
                            while held.n == my and not Lib.Unloaded do
                                commit(opt.Value + dir * step)
                                task.wait(0.07)
                            end
                        end)
                    end)
                    connect(sb.InputEnded, function(i)
                        if not isPress(i) then return end
                        held.n = held.n + 1
                        sb.BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise
                    end)
                    connect(sb.MouseLeave, function()
                        held.n = held.n + 1
                        sb.BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise
                    end)
                end
                local dragging = false
                connect(hit.InputBegan, function(i)
                    if not isPress(i) then return end
                    dragging = true
                    if Lib.FX then
                        ease(knob, 0.2, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                        bubble.Visible = true
                        ease(bscale, 0.25, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                    end
                    commit(fromX(i.Position.X), Lib.FX)
                end)
                connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(i)
                    if dragging and isMove(i) then
                        local before = opt.Value
                        commit(fromX(i.Position.X))
                        if opt.Value ~= before then sfx("tick", 0.6) end
                    end
                end)
                connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(i)
                    if dragging and isPress(i) then
                        dragging = false
                        ease(knob, 0.25, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                        ease(bscale, 0.15, { Scale = 0 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                        task.delay(0.16, function() if not dragging then bubble.Visible = false end end)
                    end
                end)
                connect(box.FocusLost, function()
                    vbLine.Transparency = 1
                    commit(tonumber((box.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]", ""))), true)
                end)
                render(opt.Value)
                function opt:SetValue(v)
                    v = math.clamp(rnd(tonumber(v) or self.Value or min), min, max)
                    render(v, true)
                    if v == self.Value then return end
                    self.Value = v
                    self:_fire()
                end
                return opt
            end

            function tab:AddInput(id, ocfg)
                local r = newRow(cur(), ocfg.Title, ocfg.Description, 160, true)
                local opt = makeOption(id, "Input", ocfg)
                r.opt, r.kind = opt, "Input"
                local function norm(v)
                    if ocfg.Numeric then
                        local n = tonumber(v)
                        if not n then return nil end
                        if ocfg.Min then n = math.max(ocfg.Min, n) end
                        if ocfg.Max then n = math.min(ocfg.Max, n) end
                        return math.floor(n)
                    end
                    return tostring(v or "")
                end
                opt.Value = norm(ocfg.Default)
                local field = inst("TextBox", {
                    BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(160, 40),
                    FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = C.Text, PlaceholderText = ocfg.Placeholder or "", PlaceholderColor3 = C.Dim,
                    Text = opt.Value ~= nil and tostring(opt.Value) or "", ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                }, r.right)
                round(field, 12)
                pad(field, 12, 12, 0, 0)
                local fs = stroke(field, 1)
                connect(field.Focused, function()
                    fs.Color = accent()
                    fs.Transparency = 0
                end)
                connect(field.FocusLost, function()
                    fs.Transparency = 1
                    local nv = norm(field.Text)
                    if nv == nil then nv = opt.Value end
                    field.Text = nv ~= nil and tostring(nv) or ""
                    if nv == opt.Value then return end
                    opt.Value = nv
                    opt:_fire()
                end)
                function opt:SetValue(v)
                    local nv = norm(v)
                    if nv == nil then nv = self.Value end
                    field.Text = nv ~= nil and tostring(nv) or ""
                    if nv == self.Value then return end
                    self.Value = nv
                    self:_fire()
                end
                return opt
            end

            function tab:AddDropdown(id, ocfg)
                local opt = makeOption(id, "Dropdown", ocfg)
                local multi = ocfg.Multi and true or false
                opt.Multi, opt.Values = multi, ocfg.Values or {}
                opt.Images = ocfg.Images or {}
                preload(opt.Images)
                local r = newRow(cur(), ocfg.Title, ocfg.Description, 170, true)
                r.opt, r.kind = opt, "Dropdown"
                local btn = inst("TextButton", {
                    Name = "Dropdown", Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BackgroundTransparency = 0,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 40),
                }, r.right)
                round(btn, 11)
                local bline = stroke(btn, 0.88)
                local bar = inst("Frame", {
                    BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 16),
                }, btn)
                round(bar)
                local lbl = text({
                    Text = "", FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 14, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(19, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -54, 1, 0),
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                }, btn)
                fitText(lbl, 14, 9)
                local bimg = inst("ImageLabel", {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 17, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Visible = false,
                }, btn)
                local cbg = inst("Frame", {
                    BackgroundColor3 = C.Hover, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0.5, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24),
                }, btn)
                round(cbg, 7)
                local chev = icon("chevron", 12, cbg, C.Text)
                chev.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                chev.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
                onAccent(function(c) bar.BackgroundColor3 = c end)
                press(btn)
                connect(btn.MouseEnter, function()
                    tw(btn, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = C.Hover })
                    tw(bline, 0.15, { Color = accent(), Transparency = 0.5 })
                    tw(bar, 0.15, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 22) })
                end)
                connect(btn.MouseLeave, function()
                    tw(btn, 0.2, { BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise })
                    if not W.ddOpen or W.ddOpen ~= btn then tw(bline, 0.2, { Color = C.Line, Transparency = 0.88 }) end
                    tw(bar, 0.2, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 16) })
                end)

                local function has(v)
                    for _, x in ipairs(opt.Values) do if x == v then return true end end
                    return false
                end
                local function toSet(v)
                    local s = {}
                    if type(v) == "table" then
                        for k, x in pairs(v) do
                            if type(k) == "number" then s[x] = true elseif x then s[k] = true end
                        end
                    end
                    return s
                end
                local function normalize(v)
                    if type(v) == "number" then return opt.Values[v] end
                    return v
                end
                local function refresh()
                    if multi then
                        local picked = {}
                        for _, x in ipairs(opt.Values) do if opt.Value[x] then picked[#picked + 1] = tostring(x) end end
                        if #picked == 0 then lbl.Text = "None"
                        elseif #picked == 1 then lbl.Text = picked[1]
                        else lbl.Text = picked[1] .. ", +" .. (#picked - 1) end
                    else
                        lbl.Text = opt.Value ~= nil and tostring(opt.Value) or "-"
                    end
                    local im = not multi and opt.Value ~= nil and opt.Images[opt.Value]
                    bimg.Image = im and tostring(im) or ""
                    bimg.Visible = im and true or false
                    lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(im and 49 or 19, 0)
                    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, im and -84 or -54, 1, 0)
                end
                if multi then
                    opt.Value = toSet(ocfg.Default)
                else
                    opt.Value = normalize(ocfg.Default)
                    if not has(opt.Value) then opt.Value = opt.Values[1] end
                end
                refresh()

                local menuOpen = false
                local function openMenu()
                    local vals = opt.Values
                    local n = #vals
                    local hasImg = next(opt.Images) ~= nil
                    local itemH = hasImg and 48 or 40
                    local lx = hasImg and 82 or 42
                    local filter = n > 6
                    local headH = 50
                    local h = headH + (filter and 46 or 0) + math.min(math.max(n, 1), 6) * (itemH + 3) + 10
                    local s = math.max(fit.Scale, 0.01)
                    local w = math.max(btn.AbsoluteSize.X / s, hasImg and 340 or 240)
                    local f = openPopup(btn, w, h)
                    local fullH = f.Size.Y.Offset
                    f.ClipsDescendants = true
                    if Lib.FX then
                        f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(f.Size.X.Offset, 0)
                        ease(f, 0.35, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(f.Size.X.Offset, fullH) })
                    end
                    menuOpen = true
                    sfx("open")
                    W.ddOpen = btn
                    ease(chev, 0.3, { Rotation = 180 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                    tw(cbg, 0.2, { BackgroundColor3 = accent() })
                    tw(bline, 0.2, { Color = accent(), Transparency = 0.2 })
                    Pop.onClose = function()
                        menuOpen = false
                        if W.ddOpen == btn then W.ddOpen = nil end
                        ease(chev, 0.3, { Rotation = 0 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                        tw(cbg, 0.2, { BackgroundColor3 = C.Hover })
                        tw(bline, 0.25, { Color = C.Line, Transparency = 0.88 })
                        if opt._pendingValues then
                            local pv = opt._pendingValues
                            opt._pendingValues = nil
                            task.defer(function() opt:SetValues(pv) end)
                        end
                    end
                    local head = inst("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, headH), ZIndex = 52 }, f)
                    local hbar = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 15), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 20), ZIndex = 52 }, head)
                    round(hbar)
                    text({
                        Text = tostring(ocfg.Title or "Select"), FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 14, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(25, 9),
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 18), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 52,
                    }, head)
                    local cnt = text({
                        Text = "", FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.Sub, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(25, 27),
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 15), ZIndex = 52,
                    }, head)
                    inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = C.Line, BackgroundTransparency = 0.92, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -1), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 1), ZIndex = 52 }, head)
                    local items = {}
                    local paintItems
                    local function count()
                        if multi then
                            local k = 0
                            for _, x in ipairs(opt.Values) do if opt.Value[x] then k = k + 1 end end
                            cnt.Text = k .. " of " .. n .. " selected"
                        else
                            cnt.Text = n .. (n == 1 and " option" or " options")
                        end
                    end
                    if multi then
                        local hb = inst("Frame", {
                            BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0),
                            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26), ZIndex = 52,
                        }, head)
                        list(hb, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 6, nil, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
                        for k, lab in ipairs({ "All", "Clear" }) do
                            local qb = inst("TextButton", {
                                Text = lab, FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.Text, AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise,
                                BorderSizePixel = 0, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26), LayoutOrder = k, ZIndex = 52,
                            }, hb)
                            round(qb, 8)
                            pad(qb, 10, 10, 0, 0)
                            qb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                                for _, x in ipairs(opt.Values) do opt.Value[x] = (k == 1) or nil end
                                refresh()
                                paintItems(true)
                                count()
                                opt:_fire()
                            end)
                        end
                    end
                    local q
                    if filter then
                        q = inst("TextBox", {
                            BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, headH + 6),
                            Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 34), FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = C.Text, PlaceholderText = "Filter",
                            PlaceholderColor3 = C.Sub, Text = "", ClearTextOnFocus = false, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = 52,
                        }, f)
                        round(q, 9)
                        pad(q, 30, 10, 0, 0)
                        local qi = icon("search", 13, q, C.Sub)
                        qi.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
                        qi.Position = UDim2.new(0, -20, 0.5, 0)
                        qi.ZIndex = 52
                    end
                    local top0 = headH + (filter and 46 or 0) + 4
                    local hl = inst("Frame", {
                        BackgroundColor3 = C.Hover, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, itemH), Visible = false, ZIndex = 51,
                    }, f)
                    round(hl, 10)
                    local sc = inst("ScrollingFrame", {
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, top0),
                        Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -(top0 + 6)), CanvasSize = UDim2.new(), AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                        ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y, ScrollBarThickness = 3, ScrollBarImageColor3 = C.Dim, ZIndex = 52,
                    }, f)
                    list(sc, nil, 3)
                    local function moveHl(b)
                        local ps = math.max(f.AbsoluteSize.X / math.max(f.Size.X.Offset, 1), 0.01)
                        local rel = (b.AbsolutePosition - f.AbsolutePosition) / ps
                        local goal = { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(rel.X, rel.Y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(b.AbsoluteSize.X / ps, itemH) }
                        if not hl.Visible or not Lib.FX then
                            hl.Position, hl.Size = goal.Position, goal.Size
                            hl.Visible = true
                        else
                            ease(hl, 0.2, goal)
                        end
                    end
                    sc.MouseLeave:Connect(function() hl.Visible = false end)
                    paintItems = function(anim)
                        for _, it in ipairs(items) do
                            local on
                            if multi then on = opt.Value[it.v] and true or false else on = opt.Value == it.v end
                            it.on = on
                            local t = anim and 0.18 or 0.01
                            tw(it.box, t, { BackgroundColor3 = on and accent() or C.Raise })
                            tw(it.boxLine, t, { Color = on and accent() or C.Line, Transparency = on and 0 or 0.8 })
                            tw(it.lbl, t, { TextColor3 = on and C.Text or C.Sub })
                            tw(it.b, t, { BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.7 or 1 })
                            it.bar.Visible = on
                            it.check.Visible = on
                            if on and anim then
                                it.check.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
                                ease(it.check, 0.3, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(11, 11) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                            else
                                it.check.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(11, 11)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    for i, v in ipairs(vals) do
                        local b = inst("TextButton", {
                            Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                            Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, itemH), LayoutOrder = i, ZIndex = 52,
                        }, sc)
                        round(b, 10)
                        inst("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 0.95) }, b)
                        local bar = inst("Frame", {
                            BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0),
                            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 22), Visible = false, ZIndex = 53,
                        }, b)
                        round(bar)
                        local box = inst("Frame", {
                            BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, 0),
                            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), ZIndex = 53,
                        }, b)
                        round(box, multi and 5 or 9)
                        local boxLine = stroke(box, 0.8)
                        local ck = icon("check", 11, box, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
                        ck.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
                        ck.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
                        ck.ZIndex = 54
                        local l = text({
                            Text = tostring(v), FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 14, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lx, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -(lx + 38), 1, 0),
                            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 53,
                        }, b)
                        fitText(l, 14, 9)
                        if opt.Images[v] then
                            inst("ImageLabel", {
                                BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0.5, 0),
                                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, Image = tostring(opt.Images[v]), ZIndex = 53,
                            }, b)
                        end
                        local num = text({
                            Text = string.format("%02d", i), FontFace = F.Mono, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = C.Dim, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
                            Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 16), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = 53,
                        }, b)
                        local it = { v = v, b = b, lbl = l, check = ck, box = box, boxLine = boxLine, bar = bar, key = string.lower(tostring(v)) }
                        items[#items + 1] = it
                        if Lib.FX and i <= 12 then
                            l.TextTransparency = 1
                            num.TextTransparency = 1
                            l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lx + 18, 0)
                            box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
                            task.delay(0.08 + (i - 1) * 0.035, function()
                                ease(l, 0.4, { TextTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lx, 0) })
                                ease(num, 0.4, { TextTransparency = 0 })
                                ease(box, 0.4, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                            end)
                        end
                        b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                            moveHl(b)
                            tw(l, 0.15, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lx + 4, 0) })
                            tw(num, 0.15, { TextColor3 = accent() })
                        end)
                        b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                            tw(l, 0.15, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lx, 0) })
                            tw(num, 0.15, { TextColor3 = C.Dim })
                        end)
                        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                            if multi then
                                opt.Value[v] = (not opt.Value[v]) or nil
                                sfx(opt.Value[v] and "on" or "off")
                                refresh()
                                paintItems(true)
                                count()
                                opt:_fire()
                            else
                                paintItems(true)
                                sfx("select")
                                if v ~= opt.Value then
                                    opt.Value = v
                                    refresh()
                                    paintItems(true)
                                    opt:_fire()
                                end
                                task.delay(0.12, closePopup)
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                    if q then
                        q:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                            local s2 = string.lower(q.Text)
                            hl.Visible = false
                            for _, it in ipairs(items) do it.b.Visible = s2 == "" or it.key:find(s2, 1, true) ~= nil end
                        end)
                    end
                    count()
                    paintItems()
                end
                connect(btn.MouseButton1Click, function()
                    if menuOpen then closePopup() else openMenu() end
                end)
                opt._closeMenu = function() if menuOpen then closePopup() end end
                function opt:SetImages(t)
                    self.Images = type(t) == "table" and t or {}
                    preload(self.Images)
                    refresh()
                end

                if multi then
                    function opt:SetValue(v)
                        self.Value = toSet(v)
                        refresh()
                        self:_fire()
                    end
                    function opt:SetValues(newValues)
                        if type(newValues) ~= "table" then return end
                        if menuOpen then
                            self._pendingValues = newValues
                            return
                        end
                        self.Values = newValues
                        refresh()
                    end
                    return opt
                end

                function opt:SetValue(v)
                    self.Value = normalize(v)
                    refresh()
                    self:_fire()
                end

                function opt:SetValues(newValues)
                    if type(newValues) ~= "table" or #newValues == 0 then return end
                    local cur2 = self.Values
                    local same = (cur2 and #cur2 == #newValues)
                    if same then
                        for i = 1, #newValues do
                            if cur2[i] ~= newValues[i] then same = false break end
                        end
                    end
                    if same then return end
                    if menuOpen then
                        self._pendingValues = newValues
                        return
                    end
                    self.Values = newValues
                    local matched = nil
                    if self.Value then
                        local curStr = tostring(self.Value)
                        local curLower = curStr:lower()
                        if curLower:find("equipped") or curLower:find("active") or curLower:find("first") then
                            for _, o in ipairs(newValues) do
                                if o:lower():find("equipped") or o:lower():find("active") or o:lower():find("first") then matched = o break end
                            end
                        end
                        if not matched then
                            local sNum = curStr:match("^Slot%s*(%d+):")
                            if sNum then
                                for _, o in ipairs(newValues) do
                                    if o:find("^Slot%s*" .. sNum .. ":") then matched = o break end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if not matched then
                            local cid = curStr:match("%(([%w_]+)%)")
                            if cid then
                                for _, o in ipairs(newValues) do
                                    if o:find("%(" .. cid .. "%)") then matched = o break end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if not matched then
                            for _, o in ipairs(newValues) do
                                if o == curStr then matched = o break end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    self.Value = matched or newValues[1]
                    refresh()
                end
                return opt
            end

            function tab:AddSegment(id, scfg)
                local opt = makeOption(id, "Segment", scfg)
                local vals = scfg.Values or {}
                opt.Values = vals
                local r = newRow(cur(), scfg.Title, scfg.Description, 0, true)
                r.opt, r.kind = opt, "Dropdown"
                local def = scfg.Default
                if type(def) == "number" then def = vals[def] end
                opt.Value = def or vals[1]
                local area = r.below(40)
                local bg = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34) }, area)
                round(bg, 10)
                stroke(bg, 0.9)
                local indS = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), Size = UDim2.new(1 / math.max(#vals, 1), -6, 1, -6), ZIndex = 1 }, bg)
                round(indS, 8)
                onAccent(function(c) indS.BackgroundColor3 = c end)
                local labels = {}
                for i, v in ipairs(vals) do
                    local b = inst("TextButton", {
                        Text = tostring(v), FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = C.Sub, AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) / #vals, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1 / #vals, 0, 1, 0), ZIndex = 2, TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                    }, bg)
                    labels[i] = b
                    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        if opt.Value == v then return end
                        sfx("select")
                        opt:SetValue(v)
                    end)
                end
                local function paint(anim)
                    local idx = 1
                    for i, v in ipairs(vals) do if v == opt.Value then idx = i end end
                    local goal = { Position = UDim2.new((idx - 1) / math.max(#vals, 1), 3, 0, 3) }
                    if anim and Lib.FX then ease(indS, 0.35, goal, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) else indS.Position = goal.Position end
                    for i, b in ipairs(labels) do tw(b, 0.2, { TextColor3 = i == idx and Color3.new(1, 1, 1) or C.Sub }) end
                end
                paint(false)
                function opt:SetValue(v)
                    if type(v) == "number" then v = vals[v] end
                    local ok = false
                    for _, x in ipairs(vals) do if x == v then ok = true end end
                    if not ok or v == self.Value then return end
                    self.Value = v
                    paint(true)
                    self:_fire()
                end
                return opt
            end

            function tab:AddColorPicker(id, ccfg)
                local opt = makeOption(id, "Color", ccfg)
                local function toColor(v)
                    if typeof(v) == "Color3" then return v end
                    if type(v) == "string" then
                        local hx = v:gsub("#", "")
                        if #hx == 6 then
                            local rr, gg, bb = tonumber(hx:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(hx:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(hx:sub(5, 6), 16)
                            if rr and gg and bb then return Color3.fromRGB(rr, gg, bb) end
                        end
                    end
                    return nil
                end
                local function hexOf(c3) return string.format("#%02X%02X%02X", math.floor(c3.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c3.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(c3.B * 255 + 0.5)) end
                opt.Value = toColor(ccfg.Default) or accent()
                local r = newRow(cur(), ccfg.Title, ccfg.Description, 110, true)
                r.opt, r.kind = opt, "Color"
                local sw = inst("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(110, 34) }, r.right)
                round(sw, 10)
                stroke(sw, 0.88)
                local chip = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = opt.Value, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 22) }, sw)
                round(chip, 7)
                stroke(chip, 0.7)
                local hexL = text({ Text = hexOf(opt.Value), FontFace = F.Mono, TextSize = 12, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 1, 0) }, sw)
                press(sw)
                local function paint()
                    chip.BackgroundColor3 = opt.Value
                    hexL.Text = hexOf(opt.Value)
                end
                function opt:SetValue(v)
                    local c3 = toColor(v)
                    if not c3 then return end
                    self.Value = c3
                    paint()
                    self:_fire()
                end
                sw.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    sfx("open")
                    local f = openPopup(sw, 280, 250)
                    local h0, s0, v0 = opt.Value:ToHSV()
                    local conns = {}
                    Pop.onClose = function() for _, cn in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() cn:Disconnect() end) end end
                    local svBox = inst("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(h0, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 170), ZIndex = 52 }, f)
                    round(svBox, 10)
                    local wO = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 52 }, svBox)
                    round(wO, 10)
                    inst("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1) }, wO)
                    local bO = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 53 }, svBox)
                    round(bO, 10)
                    inst("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1, 0) }, bO)
                    local cur2 = inst("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14), ZIndex = 55 }, svBox)
                    round(cur2)
                    inst("UIStroke", { Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Thickness = 2 }, cur2)
                    local hue = inst("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(216, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 170), ZIndex = 52 }, f)
                    round(hue, 9)
                    local ks = {}
                    for k = 0, 6 do ks[#ks + 1] = ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(k / 6, Color3.fromHSV((k / 6) % 1, 1, 1)) end
                    inst("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(ks) }, hue)
                    local hk = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, h0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 6, 0, 4), ZIndex = 53 }, hue)
                    round(hk)
                    local prev = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = opt.Value, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(242, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 170), ZIndex = 52 }, f)
                    round(prev, 9)
                    local hexBox = inst("TextBox", {
                        BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 196), Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 38), FontFace = F.Mono, TextSize = 14,
                        TextColor3 = C.Text, Text = hexOf(opt.Value), ClearTextOnFocus = false, ZIndex = 52,
                    }, f)
                    round(hexBox, 10)
                    local hh, ss, vv = h0, s0, v0
                    local function apply(fire)
                        local c3 = Color3.fromHSV(hh, ss, vv)
                        svBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(hh, 1, 1)
                        cur2.Position = UDim2.fromScale(ss, 1 - vv)
                        hk.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, hh, 0)
                        prev.BackgroundColor3 = c3
                        if not hexBox:IsFocused() then hexBox.Text = hexOf(c3) end
                        if fire then opt:SetValue(c3) end
                    end
                    apply(false)
                    local mode
                    local function rel(gobj)
                        local m = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
                        local org = overlay.AbsolutePosition
                        local ap, as = gobj.AbsolutePosition - org, gobj.AbsoluteSize
                        return math.clamp((m.X - ap.X) / math.max(as.X, 1), 0, 1), math.clamp((m.Y - ap.Y) / math.max(as.Y, 1), 0, 1)
                    end
                    local function update()
                        if mode == "sv" then
                            local x, y = rel(svBox)
                            ss, vv = x, 1 - y
                        elseif mode == "h" then
                            local _, y = rel(hue)
                            hh = math.min(y, 0.999)
                        end
                        apply(true)
                    end
                    svBox.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if isPress(i) then mode = "sv" update() end end)
                    hue.InputBegan:Connect(function(i) if isPress(i) then mode = "h" update() end end)
                    conns[#conns + 1] = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i) if mode and isMove(i) then update() end end)
                    conns[#conns + 1] = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if isPress(i) then mode = nil end end)
                    hexBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
                        local c3 = toColor(hexBox.Text)
                        if c3 then
                            hh, ss, vv = c3:ToHSV()
                            apply(true)
                        else
                            hexBox.Text = hexOf(opt.Value)
                        end
                    end)
                end)
                return opt
            end

            function tab:AddThemePicker(tcfg2)
                tcfg2 = tcfg2 or {}
                local card = newCard(tab, tcfg2.Title or "Themes", "palette")
                tab.card = card
                card.n = card.n + 1
                local wrapT = inst("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), LayoutOrder = card.n }, card.frame)
                pad(wrapT, 0, 0, 4, 14)
                local grid = inst("UIGridLayout", { CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), CellSize = UDim2.new(0.5, -5, 0, 66), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, wrapT)
                local cards2 = {}
                for i, name in ipairs(Lib.ThemeOrder) do
                    local th = Themes[name]
                    local function c3(t) return Color3.fromRGB(t[1], t[2], t[3]) end
                    local b = inst("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = c3(th.Bg), BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i }, wrapT)
                    round(b, 12)
                    local bs = stroke(b, 0.85)
                    local strip = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = c3(th.Accent), BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -4), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4) }, b)
                    inst("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 0.6) }, strip)
                    local dotsT = inst("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, 16) }, b)
                    list(dotsT, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 4, nil, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
                    for k, key in ipairs({ "Card", "Raise", "Accent", "Text" }) do
                        local d = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = c3(th[key]), BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(key == "Accent" and 28 or 14, 14), LayoutOrder = k }, dotsT)
                        round(d)
                    end
                    text({ Text = name, FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = c3(th.Text), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 34), Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 18) }, b)
                    local ck = icon("check", 14, b, c3(th.Accent))
                    ck.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
                    ck.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 12)
                    press(b)
                    cards2[name] = { b = b, s = bs, ck = ck, acc = c3(th.Accent) }
                    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        if Lib.ThemeName == name then return end
                        sfx("select")
                        Lib:SetTheme(name)
                    end)
                end
                local function paintSel()
                    for name, it in pairs(cards2) do
                        local on = Lib.ThemeName == name
                        it.ck.Visible = on
                        it.s.Color = on and it.acc or C.Line
                        it.s.Transparency = on and 0 or 0.85
                        it.s.Thickness = on and 2 or 1
                    end
                end
                paintSel()
                Lib._themeHooks = Lib._themeHooks or {}
                table.insert(Lib._themeHooks, paintSel)
                table.insert(card.rows, { frame = wrapT, search = "theme themes color colour crimson midnight neon cyber gold royal sakura toxic mono" })
                queue(tab)
            end

            function tab:AddConfigManager(mcfg)
                mcfg = mcfg or {}
                tab:AddSection(mcfg.Title or "Profiles")
                local function listProfiles()
                    local out = {}
                    pcall(function()
                        for _, f in ipairs(listfiles(Lib.Folder)) do
                            local nm = tostring(f):match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")
                            if nm and nm ~= "config" then out[#out + 1] = nm end
                        end
                    end)
                    table.sort(out)
                    if #out == 0 then out = { "(none)" } end
                    return out
                end
                local nameOpt = tab:AddInput("__profileName", { Title = "Profile name", Description = "Type a name, then Save", Placeholder = "farm-night", Default = "" })
                nameOpt.NoSave = true
                local pickOpt = tab:AddDropdown("__profilePick", { Title = "Saved profiles", Values = listProfiles(), Default = 1 })
                pickOpt.NoSave = true
                local function refresh() pcall(function() pickOpt:SetValues(listProfiles()) end) end
                tab:AddButton({ Title = "Save profile", Description = "Saves every setting under the name above", ButtonText = "Save", Callback = function()
                    local nm = tostring(nameOpt.Value or ""):gsub("[^%w%-_ ]", "")
                    if nm == "" then Lib:Notify({ Title = "Profiles", Content = "Type a profile name first", Icon = "folder", Group = "Profiles" }) return end
                    local ok = Lib:SaveConfig(nm)
                    refresh()
                    Lib:Notify({ Title = ok and "Profile saved" or "Could not save", Content = nm, Icon = "folder", Group = "Profiles" })
                end })
                tab:AddButton({ Title = "Load profile", Description = "Applies the profile picked above", ButtonText = "Load", Callback = function()
                    local nm = tostring(pickOpt.Value or "")
                    if nm == "" or nm == "(none)" then return end
                    local ok, err = Lib:LoadConfig(nm)
                    Lib:Notify({ Title = ok and "Profile loaded" or "Could not load", Content = ok and nm or tostring(err), Icon = "folder", Group = "Profiles" })
                end })
                tab:AddButton({ Title = "Delete profile", Description = "Removes the profile picked above", ButtonText = "Delete", Callback = function()
                    local nm = tostring(pickOpt.Value or "")
                    if nm == "" or nm == "(none)" then return end
                    Lib:Confirm({ Title = "Delete " .. nm .. "?", Content = "This profile file will be removed.", Button = "Delete", Callback = function()
                        pcall(function() delfile(Lib:Path(nm .. ".json")) end)
                        refresh()
                        Lib:Notify({ Title = "Profile deleted", Content = nm, Icon = "folder", Group = "Profiles" })
                    end })
                end })
            end

            function tab:AddKeybind(kcfg)
                local r = newRow(cur(), kcfg.Title, kcfg.Description, 150, true)
                Lib.ToggleKey = kcfg.Default or Lib.ToggleKey
                local b
                b = makeButton(r.right, Lib.ToggleKey.Name, function()
                    if Lib._binding then return end
                    Lib._binding = true
                    b.Text = "Press a key"
                    local c
                    c = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
                        if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then return end
                        c:Disconnect()
                        if i.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Escape then Lib.ToggleKey = i.KeyCode end
                        b.Text = Lib.ToggleKey.Name
                        if W.paintKey then W.paintKey() end
                        task.delay(0.1, function() Lib._binding = false end)
                    end)
                end)
            end

            function tab:AddStatTiles(scfg)
                scfg = scfg or {}
                local grid = inst("Frame", { Name = "Tiles", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0) }, tab.wide)
                local gl = inst("UIGridLayout", {
                    CellPadding = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10), CellSize = UDim2.new(0.25, -8, 0, 80), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
                }, grid)
                table.insert(tab.grids, gl)
                local items = scfg.Items or { { "time", "Playtime", "clock" }, { "players", "Players", "people" }, { "fps", "FPS", "cpu" }, { "ping", "Ping (ms)", "chart" } }
                local vals = {}
                for i, it in ipairs(items) do
                    local t = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = C.Card, BorderSizePixel = 0, LayoutOrder = i }, grid)
                    round(t, 12)
                    stroke(t, 0.92)
                    local top2 = inst("Frame", {
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 14),
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16),
                    }, t)
                    list(top2, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 5, nil, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
                    icon(it[3], 14, top2, C.Sub).LayoutOrder = 1
                    text({ Text = it[2], FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = C.Sub, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 16), LayoutOrder = 2 }, top2)
                    vals[it[1]] = text({
                        Text = "-", FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 24, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 36), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30),
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                    }, t)
                end
                local h = {}
                local shown = {}
                function h:Set(key, value, col)
                    local v = vals[key]
                    if not v then return end
                    local num = type(value) == "number" and value or nil
                    if num and Lib.FX then
                        local cur = shown[key] or 0
                        cur = math.abs(num - cur) < 1 and num or (cur + (num - cur) * 0.35)
                        shown[key] = cur
                        value = math.floor(cur + 0.5)
                    end
                    v.Text = tostring(value)
                    v.TextColor3 = col or C.Text
                end
                if scfg.Auto ~= false then
                    local Plr = game:GetService("Players")
                    task.spawn(function()
                        while not Lib.Unloaded do
                            if gui.Enabled and tab.page.Visible then
                                local e = os.clock() - (Lib.StartedAt or os.clock())
                                h:Set("time", string.format("%02d:%02d:%04.1f", math.floor(e / 3600), math.floor(e / 60) % 60, e % 60))
                                h:Set("players", #Plr:GetPlayers() .. " / " .. Plr.MaxPlayers)
                                local fps, ping = Lib.FPS or 0, Lib.Ping or 0
                                h:Set("fps", fps, fps >= 55 and C.Text or (fps >= 30 and C.Warn or C.Bad))
                                h:Set("ping", ping, ping < 120 and C.Good or (ping < 250 and C.Warn or C.Bad))
                            end
                            task.wait(0.1)
                        end
                    end)
                end
                queue(tab)
                return h
            end

            function tab:AddGameCard(gcfg)

                card.n = card.n + 1

                round(banner, 12)

                }, banner)

                inst("UIGradient", {
