                }, fadeL)
                local fadeB = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = C.Card, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 2 }, artBox)
                inst("UIGradient", {
                    Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.2) }),
                }, fadeB)
                local tint = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 2 }, artBox)
                inst("UIGradient", {
                    Rotation = 180, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.7), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }),
                }, tint)
                local scan = inst("Frame", {
                    BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, -0.1), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2), ZIndex = 3,
                }, artBox)
                inst("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.2), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.4) }) }, scan)
                local glowScan = inst("Frame", {
                    BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22), ZIndex = 3,
                }, scan)
                inst("UIGradient", { Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1, 0.75) }, glowScan)
                onAccent(function(c)
                    scan.BackgroundColor3 = c
                    glowScan.BackgroundColor3 = c
                    tint.BackgroundColor3 = c
                end)

                local info = inst("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 16), Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 1, -32), ZIndex = 5 }, banner)
                local nameL = text({
                    Text = "Loading...", FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 20, TextWrapped = true, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 4), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 5,
                }, info)
                local byL = text({
                    Text = "", FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.Sub, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 60), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16),
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 5,
                }, info)
                local srv = inst("TextButton", {
                    Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1),
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), ZIndex = 5,
                }, info)
                local cpi = icon("copy", 12, srv, C.Dim)
                cpi.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
                cpi.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
                cpi.ZIndex = 5
                local srvL = text({
                    Text = "", FontFace = F.Mono, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = C.Dim, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -18, 1, 0),
                    TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd, ZIndex = 5,
                }, srv)
                connect(srv.MouseEnter, function()
                    tw(srvL, 0.15, { TextColor3 = C.Text })
                    tw(cpi, 0.15, { ImageColor3 = accent() })
                end)
                connect(srv.MouseLeave, function()
                    tw(srvL, 0.2, { TextColor3 = C.Dim })
                    tw(cpi, 0.2, { ImageColor3 = C.Dim })
                end)
                local jid = string.sub(tostring(game.JobId), 1, 8)
                local srvText = "SRV " .. (jid ~= "" and string.upper(jid) or "STUDIO") .. "  /  " .. tostring(game.PlaceId)
                srvL.Text = srvText
                connect(srv.MouseButton1Click, function()
                    local ok = pcall(function() (setclipboard or toclipboard)(tostring(game.JobId)) end)
                    sfx("copy")
                    srvL.Text = ok and "JOB ID COPIED" or "NO CLIPBOARD"
                    srvL.TextColor3 = ok and C.Good or C.Bad
                    task.delay(1.4, function()
                        srvL.Text = srvText
                        srvL.TextColor3 = C.Dim
                    end)
                end)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local ok, data = pcall(function()
                        return HttpService:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet("https://games.roblox.com/v2/games/" .. tostring(game.GameId) .. "/media"))
                    end)
                    if ok and type(data) == "table" and type(data.data) == "table" then
                        for _, m in ipairs(data.data) do
                            if m.assetType == "Image" and m.imageId and m.approved ~= false then
                                art.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(m.imageId)
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)

                local tele = inst("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 62), LayoutOrder = 2 }, wrap)
                list(tele, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 8, nil, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
                local function meter(order, label, ic)
                    local m = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1 / 3, -6, 1, 0), LayoutOrder = order }, tele)
                    round(m, 10)
                    stroke(m, 0.92)
                    local mi = icon(ic, 12, m, C.Dim)
                    mi.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
                    text({ Text = label, FontFace = F.Mono, TextSize = 10, TextColor3 = C.Dim, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(27, 8), Size = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0, 14) }, m)
                    local v = text({ Text = "-", FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 16, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 24), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20) }, m)
                    local trackM = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = C.Track, BorderSizePixel = 0, Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -11), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 3) }, m)
                    round(trackM)
                    local fillM = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1) }, trackM)
                    round(fillM)
                    return v, fillM
                end
                local plV, plF = meter(1, "PLAYERS", "people")
                local pgV, pgF = meter(2, "PING", "bars")
                local upV, upF = meter(3, "UPTIME", "clock")
                onAccent(function(c)
                    plF.BackgroundColor3 = c
                    upF.BackgroundColor3 = c
                end)

                local btns = inst("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38), LayoutOrder = 3 }, wrap)
                list(btns, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 8, nil, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
                local list2 = gcfg.Buttons or {}
                local nb = math.max(#list2, 1)
                for i, b in ipairs(list2) do
                    local low = string.lower(tostring(b.Title or ""))
                    local ic = b.Icon or (low:find("rejoin") and "refresh") or (low:find("hop") and "shuffle") or (low:find("leave") and "exit") or nil
                    local danger = b.Danger and true or false
                    local base = danger and C.Bg or C.Raise
                    local bt = inst("TextButton", {
                        Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = base, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        Size = UDim2.new(1 / nb, -math.floor(8 * (nb - 1) / nb + 0.5), 0, 38), LayoutOrder = i,
                    }, btns)
                    round(bt, 10)
                    local bl = stroke(bt, danger and 0.3 or 0.9)
                    local red = Color3.fromRGB(225, 40, 54)
                    if danger then bl.Color = red end
                    local inner = inst("Frame", {
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20),
                    }, bt)
                    list(inner, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 7, nil, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
                    local bi
                    if ic then
                        bi = icon(ic, 14, inner, danger and red or C.Sub)
                        bi.LayoutOrder = 1
                    end
                    local bl2 = text({
                        Text = tostring(b.Title or ""), FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = danger and red or C.Text,
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20), LayoutOrder = 2,
                    }, inner)
                    press(bt)
                    connect(bt.MouseEnter, function()
                        if danger then
                            tw(bt, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = red })
                            tw(bl2, 0.15, { TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) })
                            if bi then tw(bi, 0.15, { ImageColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) }) end
                        else
                            tw(bt, 0.15, { BackgroundColor3 = C.Hover })
                            tw(bl, 0.15, { Color = accent(), Transparency = 0.5 })
                            if bi then tw(bi, 0.15, { ImageColor3 = accent(), Rotation = Lib.FX and 180 or 0 }) end
                        end
                    end)
                    connect(bt.MouseLeave, function()
                        tw(bt, 0.2, { BackgroundColor3 = base })
                        if danger then
                            tw(bl2, 0.2, { TextColor3 = red })
                            if bi then tw(bi, 0.2, { ImageColor3 = red }) end
                        else
                            tw(bl, 0.2, { Color = C.Line, Transparency = 0.9 })
                            if bi then tw(bi, 0.3, { ImageColor3 = C.Sub, Rotation = 0 }) end
                        end
                    end)
                    if danger then
                        local fillH = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = red, BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), ZIndex = 0 }, bt)
                        round(fillH, 10)
                        bt.ClipsDescendants = true
                        local holding, htw
                        local function cancel()
                            if not holding then return end
                            holding = false
                            if htw then htw:Cancel() end
                            tw(fillH, 0.25, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1) })
                            bl2.Text = tostring(b.Title or "")
                        end
                        connect(bt.InputBegan, function(i)
                            if not isPress(i) then return end
                            holding = true
                            sfx("click")
                            bl2.Text = "Hold to confirm"
                            htw = TweenService:Create(fillH, TweenInfo.new(0.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) })
                            htw:Play()
                            htw.Completed:Connect(function(st)
                                if st ~= Enum.PlaybackState.Completed or not holding then return end
                                holding = false
                                sfx("alert")
                                bl2.Text = tostring(b.Title or "")
                                fillH.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
                                if b.Callback then task.spawn(safe, b.Callback) end
                            end)
                        end)
                        connect(bt.InputEnded, function(i) if isPress(i) then cancel() end end)
                        connect(bt.MouseLeave, cancel)
                    else
                        connect(bt.MouseButton1Click, function()
                            sfx("click")
                            if b.Callback then task.spawn(safe, b.Callback) end
                        end)
                    end
                end

                local entry = { frame = wrap, search = "game server rejoin hop leave" }
                table.insert(card.rows, entry)
                task.spawn(function()
                    local ok, pinfo = pcall(function() return game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(game.PlaceId) end)
                    if ok and type(pinfo) == "table" then
                        nameL.Text = tostring(pinfo.Name or ("Place " .. game.PlaceId))
                        local cr = type(pinfo.Creator) == "table" and pinfo.Creator.Name
                        byL.Text = cr and ("by " .. tostring(cr)) or ""
                    else
                        nameL.Text = "Place " .. tostring(game.PlaceId)
                    end
                    entry.search = string.lower("game server rejoin hop leave " .. nameL.Text .. " " .. byL.Text)
                end)

                local h = {}
                function h:Set(st)
                    if st.players then plV.Text = tostring(st.players) end
                    if st.ping then
                        pgV.Text = tostring(st.ping) .. " ms"
                        pgV.TextColor3 = st.pingColor or C.Text
                        pgF.BackgroundColor3 = st.pingColor or C.Good
                        tw(pgF, 0.4, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp((tonumber(st.ping) or 0) / 300, 0.03, 1), 1) })
                    end
                end
                local function tick()
                    local ping = Lib.Ping or 0
                    local cur, mx = #Plr:GetPlayers(), math.max(Plr.MaxPlayers, 1)
                    h:Set({ players = cur .. " / " .. mx, ping = ping, pingColor = ping < 120 and C.Good or (ping < 250 and C.Warn or C.Bad) })
                    tw(plF, 0.4, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(cur / mx, 0.03, 1), 1) })
                    local t = math.floor(workspace.DistributedGameTime)
                    local hh, mm = math.floor(t / 3600), math.floor(t / 60) % 60
                    upV.Text = hh > 0 and string.format("%dh %02dm", hh, mm) or string.format("%dm %02ds", mm, t % 60)
                    tw(upF, 0.4, { Size = UDim2.fromScale((t % 3600) / 3600 + 0.02, 1) })
                end
                tick()
                task.spawn(function()
                    local n = 0
                    while not Lib.Unloaded do
                        task.wait(0.5)
                        n = n + 1
                        if gui.Enabled and tab.page.Visible then
                            pcall(tick)
                            if Lib.FX then
                                if n % 6 == 1 then
                                    scan.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, -0.1)
                                    ease(scan, 1.6, { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1.25) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
                                end
                                if n % 16 == 1 then
                                    ease(artScale, 8, { Scale = artScale.Scale > 1.1 and 1.06 or 1.16 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                return h
            end

            function tab:AddHero(hcfg)
                tab.card = newCard(tab, hcfg.Title or "Overview", sectionIcon(hcfg.Title, "play"))
                local r = newRow(tab.card, "-", "", 120)
                r.title.FontFace = F.Bold
                r.title.TextSize = 19
                local badge = text({
                    Text = "IDLE", FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C.Dim, BackgroundColor3 = C.Dim, BackgroundTransparency = 0.85,
                    AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 28), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                }, r.right)
                round(badge)
                pad(badge, 12, 12, 0, 0)
                local bars = {}
                for i = 1, 2 do
                    local br = newRow(tab.card, "", nil, 70)
                    local val = text({
                        Text = "", FontFace = F.Mono, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = C.Sub, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 20),
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
                    }, br.right)
                    local area = br.below(22)
                    local trk = inst("Frame", {
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -3), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 8),
                        BackgroundColor3 = C.Track, BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    }, area)
                    round(trk)
                    local fill = inst("Frame", { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = C.Sub, BorderSizePixel = 0 }, trk)
                    round(fill)
                    bars[i] = { row = br, val = val, fill = fill }
                end
                local hero = {}
                function hero:Set(s)
                    if s.main then r.setTitle(s.main) end
                    if s.sub then r.setDesc(s.sub) end
                    if s.badge then
                        local col = s.badgeColor or C.Dim
                        badge.Text = tostring(s.badge)
                        badge.TextColor3 = col
                        badge.BackgroundColor3 = col
                    end
                end
                function hero:SetBar(i, name, pct, col)
                    local b = bars[i]
                    if not b then return end
                    pct = tonumber(pct) or 0
                    b.row.setTitle(name)
                    b.val.Text = string.format("%d%%", math.floor(pct + 0.5))
                    if Lib.FX then
                        ease(b.fill, 0.5, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(pct / 100, 0, 1), 1) })
                    else
                        b.fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.clamp(pct / 100, 0, 1), 1)
                    end
                    b.fill.BackgroundColor3 = col or C.Sub
                end
                return hero
            end

            function tab:AddStats(items)
                tab.card = newCard(tab, "Stats", "chart")
                local cells = {}
                for _, it in ipairs(items) do
                    local r = newRow(tab.card, it[2], nil, 120)
                    local v = text({
                        Text = "-", FontFace = F.Mono, TextSize = 15, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 22),
                        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
                    }, r.right)
                    cells[it[1]] = { r = r, v = v }
                end
                local s = {}
                function s:Set(key, value, hint, hintColor)
                    local c = cells[key]
                    if not c then return end
                    c.v.Text = tostring(value)
                    c.v.TextColor3 = hintColor or C.Text
                    c.r.setDesc(hint or "")
                end
                return s
            end

            function tab:AddGraph(gcfg)
                local N = math.min(gcfg.Points or 32, 40)
                local r = newRow(cur(), gcfg.Title or "Graph", nil, 120)
                local right = text({
                    Text = "", FontFace = F.Mono, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = C.Sub, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 20),
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
                }, r.right)
                local area = r.below(60)
                pad(area, 0, 0, 0, 12)
                local bars, vals = {}, {}
                for i = 1, N do
                    vals[i] = 0
                    local b = inst("Frame", {
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) / N, 1, 1, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1 / N, -2, 0.04, 0),
                        BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    }, area)
                    round(b, 2)
                    bars[i] = b
                end
                onAccent(function(c) for _, b in ipairs(bars) do b.BackgroundColor3 = c end end)
                local ema
                local g = {}
                function g:Push(v, txt)
                    v = tonumber(v) or 0
                    ema = ema and (ema + (v - ema) * (gcfg.Ease or 0.45)) or v
                    table.remove(vals, 1)
                    table.insert(vals, ema)
                    local peak = gcfg.Max or 60
                    for _, x in ipairs(vals) do if x > peak then peak = x end end
                    for i, x in ipairs(vals) do bars[i].Size = UDim2.new(1 / N, -2, math.clamp(x / peak, 0.04, 1), 0) end
                    if txt then right.Text = tostring(txt) end
                end
                return g
            end

            function tab:AddActions(items)
                local handles = {}
                for i, it in ipairs(items) do
                    local label = it.ButtonText or "Go"
                    local r = newRow(cur(), it.Title, it.Description, it.Bind and 56 or buttonWidth(label))
                    if it.Bind then
                        local function desc(on) return on and (it.OnText or "On") or (it.OffText or "Off") end
                        local sw = makeSwitch(r.right, false, function(v)
                            r.setDesc(desc(v))
                            local o = Lib.Options[it.Bind]
                            if o and o.Value ~= v then task.spawn(safe, o.SetValue, o, v) end
                        end)
                        r.setDesc(desc(false))
                        task.spawn(function()
                            local o
                            for _ = 1, 200 do
                                o = Lib.Options[it.Bind]
                                if o or Lib.Unloaded then break end
                                task.wait(0.05)
                            end
                            if not o then return end
                            while not Lib.Unloaded do
                                local v = o.Value and true or false
                                if v ~= sw.Value then
                                    sw.set(v)
                                    r.setDesc(desc(v))
                                end
                                task.wait(0.1)
                            end
                        end)
                    else
                        makeButton(r.right, label, function()
                            if it.Callback then task.spawn(safe, it.Callback) end
                        end)
                    end
                    handles[i] = {
                        SetTitle = function(_, s) r.setTitle(s) end,
                        SetDescription = function(_, s) if not it.Bind then r.setDesc(s) end end,
                        Icon = {},
                    }
                end
                return handles
            end

            if #Window.Tabs == 1 then select(tab) end
            return tab
        end

        Lib.WinState = {}
        local function refit()
            local vp = viewport()
            local w, h = math.max(body.Size.X.Offset, 1), math.max(body.Size.Y.Offset, 1)
            Lib._baseScale = math.clamp(math.min((vp.X - 24) / w, (vp.Y - 24) / h, 1), 0.35, 1)
            if not Lib._animWin then fit.Scale = Lib._baseScale end
        end
        local function clampPos()
            local vp = viewport()
            local p = body.Position
            local cx, cy = p.X.Scale * vp.X + p.X.Offset, p.Y.Scale * vp.Y + p.Y.Offset
            local hw, hh = body.AbsoluteSize.X / 2, body.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2
            local nx = (hw * 2 >= vp.X) and vp.X / 2 or math.clamp(cx, hw, vp.X - hw)
            local ny = (hh * 2 >= vp.Y) and vp.Y / 2 or math.clamp(cy, hh, vp.Y - hh)
            if math.abs(nx - cx) > 0.5 or math.abs(ny - cy) > 0.5 then
                body.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(nx, ny)
            end
        end
        local function snapshot()
            local sz, p = body.Size, body.Position
            Lib.WinState.size = { sz.X.Offset, sz.Y.Offset }
            Lib.WinState.pos = { p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset, p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset }
        end
        task.delay(1.5, function() W.ready = true end)
        local function track()
            if not W.ready or Lib._folding then return end
            snapshot()
            if Lib.QueueSave then Lib:QueueSave() end
        end
        connect(body:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"), function()
            refit()
            layoutHeader()
            if W.active then queue(W.active) end
            track()
        end)
        connect(body:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"), track)
        if workspace.CurrentCamera then
            connect(workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"), function()
                refit()
                task.defer(clampPos)
            end)
        end
        Lib.ApplyWindowState = function(data)
            task.delay(0.1, function()
                if type(data.__size) == "table" then
                    local w, h = tonumber(data.__size[1]), tonumber(data.__size[2])
                    if w and h then body.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(w, 420), math.max(h, 280)) end
                end
                if type(data.__pos) == "table" then
                    local a = data.__pos
                    body.Position = UDim2.new(tonumber(a[1]) or 0.5, tonumber(a[2]) or 0, tonumber(a[3]) or 0.5, tonumber(a[4]) or 0)
                end
                if type(data.__btn) == "table" and Lib.PlaceToggleButton then Lib.PlaceToggleButton(data.__btn) end
                refit()
                task.defer(clampPos)
                snapshot()
            end)
        end

        local function dragFrom(handle)
            connect(handle.InputBegan, function(i)
                if not isPress(i) then return end
                W.drag = { m = i.Position, p = body.Position }
            end)
        end
        dragFrom(head)
        dragFrom(brand)
        dragFrom(bar)
        connect(grip.InputBegan, function(i)
            if not isPress(i) then return end
            W.size = { m = i.Position, w = body.Size.X.Offset, h = body.Size.Y.Offset, p = body.Position }
        end)
        connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(i)
            if not isMove(i) then return end
            if W.drag then
                local d = i.Position - W.drag.m
                local p = W.drag.p
                body.Position = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset + d.X, p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset + d.Y)
            elseif W.size then
                local d = i.Position - W.size.m
                local s = math.max(fit.Scale, 0.01)
                local nw = math.max(W.size.w + d.X / s, 420)
                local nh = math.max(W.size.h + d.Y / s, 280)
                local p = W.size.p
                body.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(nw, nh)
                body.Position = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset + (nw - W.size.w) * s / 2, p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset + (nh - W.size.h) * s / 2)
            end
        end)
        connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(i)
            if not isPress(i) then return end
            if W.drag then
                W.drag = nil
                task.defer(clampPos)
            end
            W.size = nil
        end)

        do
            local mp = inst("Frame", {
                Name = "Mini", BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 15), BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -24), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 48), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Visible = false, Active = true,
            }, top)
            round(mp, 16)
            glow(stroke(mp, 0.7), 0.7)
            pad(mp, 14, 8, 0, 0)
            list(mp, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 8, nil, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
            local mpScale = inst("UIScale", {}, mp)
            text({ Text = string.upper(Lib.Name), FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 13, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 48), LayoutOrder = 1 }, mp)
            inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 0.8, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 20), LayoutOrder = 2 }, mp)
            local chipsF = inst("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 48), LayoutOrder = 3 }, mp)
            list(chipsF, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 6, nil, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
            local expandB = inst("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = accent(), BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34), LayoutOrder = 4 }, mp)
            round(expandB, 11)
            onAccent(function(c) expandB.BackgroundColor3 = c end)
            local ei = icon("expand", 15, expandB, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
            ei.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            ei.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            press(expandB)
            local chips = {}
            local function pinned()
                local out = {}
                for _, t in ipairs(Lib._toggles) do
                    if t.opt.Pin and not Lib.StatusIgnore[t.id] then out[#out + 1] = t end
                end
                if #out == 0 then
                    for _, t in ipairs(Lib._toggles) do
                        if not Lib.StatusIgnore[t.id] then out[#out + 1] = t end
                        if #out >= 4 then break end
                    end
                end
                return out
            end
            local function build()
                for _, ch in ipairs(chipsF:GetChildren()) do if ch:IsA("GuiObject") then ch:Destroy() end end
                table.clear(chips)
                for i, t in ipairs(pinned()) do
                    local cb = inst("TextButton", {
                        Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise, BorderSizePixel = 0, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
                        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 32), LayoutOrder = i,
                    }, chipsF)
                    round(cb, 10)
                    pad(cb, 10, 12, 0, 0)
                    list(cb, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 7, nil, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
                    local dot = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = C.Dim, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), LayoutOrder = 1 }, cb)
                    round(dot)
                    local nm = tostring(t.opt.Title or t.id)
                    if #nm > 16 then nm = nm:sub(1, 15) .. "…" end
                    text({ Text = nm, FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 12, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 32), LayoutOrder = 2 }, cb)
                    press(cb)
                    cb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        sfx(t.opt.Value and "off" or "on")
                        pcall(function() t.opt:SetValue(not t.opt.Value) end)
                    end)
                    chips[#chips + 1] = { t = t, dot = dot, cb = cb }
                end
            end
            local function paintChips()
                for _, ch in ipairs(chips) do
                    local on = ch.t.opt.Value and true or false
                    ch.dot.BackgroundColor3 = on and C.Good or C.Dim
                    ch.cb.BackgroundColor3 = on and accent():Lerp(Color3.new(0, 0, 0), 0.7) or C.Raise
                end
            end
            local dragM
            connect(mp.InputBegan, function(i)
                if isPress(i) then dragM = { m = i.Position, p = mp.Position } end
            end)
            connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(i)
                if not dragM or not isMove(i) then return end
                local d = i.Position - dragM.m
                mp.Position = UDim2.new(dragM.p.X.Scale, dragM.p.X.Offset + d.X, dragM.p.Y.Scale, dragM.p.Y.Offset + d.Y)
            end)
            connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(i) if isPress(i) then dragM = nil end end)
            function Lib:SetMini(on)
                if on then
                    build()
                    paintChips()
                    Lib._mini = true
                    local function showMini()
                        mp.Visible = true
                        if Lib.FX then
                            mpScale.Scale = 0.6
                            ease(mpScale, 0.45, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                        end
                    end
                    if gui.Enabled then
                        if Lib.FX and Lib._fold then
                            Lib._fold(false, function()
                                gui.Enabled = false
                                if Lib.OnToggle then pcall(Lib.OnToggle) end
                                showMini()
                            end)
                        else
                            gui.Enabled = false
                            showMini()
                        end
                    else
                        showMini()
                    end
                else
                    Lib._mini = false
                    if Lib.FX then
                        ease(mpScale, 0.2, { Scale = 0.6 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
                        task.delay(0.2, function() mp.Visible = false end)
                    else
                        mp.Visible = false
                    end
                    if not gui.Enabled then Lib:ToggleUI() end
                end
            end
            expandB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                sfx("click")
                Lib:SetMini(false)
            end)
            connect(miniBtn.MouseButton1Click, function()
                sfx("click")
                Lib:SetMini(true)
            end)
            task.spawn(function()
                while not Lib.Unloaded do
                    if mp.Visible then pcall(paintChips) end
                    task.wait(0.3)
                end
            end)
        end

        connect(saveBtn.MouseButton1Click, function()
            local ok, err = Lib:SaveConfig("config")
            Lib:Notify({ Title = ok and "Config saved" or "Could not save", Content = ok and Lib:Path("config.json") or tostring(err), Duration = 3 })
        end)
        connect(closeBtn.MouseButton1Click, function()
            Lib:Confirm({
                Title = "Close " .. Lib.Name .. "?",
                Content = cfg.CloseNote or "The window closes and every feature stops.",
                Button = "Close",
                Callback = function() Lib:Destroy() end,
            })
        end)

        connect(UIS.InputBegan, function(i, gp)
            if gp or Lib._binding then return end
            if i.KeyCode == Lib.ToggleKey then Lib:ToggleUI() end
        end)

        do
            local SIZE = 54
            local b = inst("ImageButton", {
                Name = "Toggle", AutoButtonColor = false, Image = "", Size = UDim2.fromOffset(SIZE, SIZE),
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(20, math.floor(viewport().Y / 2 - SIZE / 2)),
                BackgroundColor3 = C.Bg, BackgroundTransparency = 0.05, BorderSizePixel = 0,
            }, top)
            round(b)
            glow(stroke(b, 0.3), 0.3)
            press(b)
            local logo = inst("ImageLabel", {
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -8), Image = LOGO_ID, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop,
            }, b)
            round(logo)
            local logoText = text({
                Name = "LogoText", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), FontFace = F.Bold, Text = tostring(cfg.LogoText or string.upper(string.sub(Lib.Name, 1, 2))), TextSize = 18,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, Visible = false,
            }, b)
            task.spawn(function()
                local t = 0
                while not logo.IsLoaded and t < 8 do
                    task.wait(0.25)
                    t = t + 0.25
                end
                if not logo.IsLoaded then
                    logo.Visible = false
                    logoText.Visible = true
                end
            end)
            Lib.OnToggle = function()
                logo.ImageTransparency = gui.Enabled and 0 or 0.45
            end
            local function clampBtn(x, y)
                local vp = viewport()
                return math.clamp(x, 0, math.max(vp.X - SIZE, 0)), math.clamp(y, 0, math.max(vp.Y - SIZE, 0))
            end
            Lib.PlaceToggleButton = function(p)
                local x, y = clampBtn(tonumber(p[1]) or 20, tonumber(p[2]) or 200)
                b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
                Lib.WinState.btn = { x, y }
            end
            local dragging, moved, startMouse, startPos = false, false, nil, nil
            connect(b.InputBegan, function(i)
                if isPress(i) then
                    dragging, moved, startMouse, startPos = true, false, i.Position, Vector2.new(b.Position.X.Offset, b.Position.Y.Offset)
                end
            end)
            connect(UIS.InputChanged, function(i)
                if not dragging or not isMove(i) then return end
                local d = i.Position - startMouse
                if not moved and d.Magnitude > 6 then moved = true end
                if moved then
                    local x, y = clampBtn(startPos.X + d.X, startPos.Y + d.Y)
                    b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
                end
            end)
            connect(UIS.InputEnded, function(i)
                if not dragging or not isPress(i) then return end
                dragging = false
                if moved then
                    Lib.WinState.btn = { b.Position.X.Offset, b.Position.Y.Offset }
                    if Lib.QueueSave then Lib:QueueSave() end
                else
                    Lib:ToggleUI()
                end
            end)
            if type(saved.__btn) == "table" then Lib.PlaceToggleButton(saved.__btn) end
        end

        Lib.FPS, Lib.Ping, Lib.Frames = 0, 0, 0
        local frames, started = 0, os.clock()
        Lib.StartedAt = started
        local stamps = {}
        connect(RunService.RenderStepped, function()
            frames = frames + 1
            Lib.Frames = Lib.Frames + 1
            local now = os.clock()
            stamps[#stamps + 1] = now
            while stamps[1] and stamps[1] < now - 1 do table.remove(stamps, 1) end
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            local pingItem
            pcall(function() pingItem = game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"] end)
            while not Lib.Unloaded do
                task.wait(0.1)
                Lib.FPS = #stamps
                local ok, ping = pcall(function() return pingItem and pingItem:GetValue() or LP:GetNetworkPing() * 1000 end)
                Lib.Ping = ok and math.floor((tonumber(ping) or 0) + 0.5) or 0
            end
        end)
        task.spawn(function()
            while not Lib.Unloaded do
                Window.Minimized = not gui.Enabled
                task.wait(0.2)
            end
        end)

        layoutHeader()
        refit()
        task.defer(clampPos)
        snapshot()
        if Lib._pendingWin then
            local d = Lib._pendingWin
            Lib._pendingWin = nil
            Lib.ApplyWindowState(d)
        end
        Lib._fold = function(open, done)
            Lib._folding = true
            local vp = viewport()
            local sc = Lib._baseScale or fit.Scale
            local w, h = body.Size.X.Offset * sc, body.Size.Y.Offset * sc
            local p = body.Position
            local cx, cy = p.X.Scale * vp.X + p.X.Offset, p.Y.Scale * vp.Y + p.Y.Offset
            local left = cx - w / 2
            local col = accent()
            local coverHold = inst("Frame", {
                Name = "BookCover", BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(left, cy), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), ZIndex = 5, ClipsDescendants = true,
            }, gui)
            local cover = inst("Frame", {
                Name = "Sheet", BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(13, 12, 15), BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), ZIndex = 5, ClipsDescendants = true,
            }, coverHold)
            local rad = math.floor(18 * sc + 0.5)
            round(cover, rad)
            local cl = stroke(cover, 0.35)
            cl.Color = col
            local function layer(z)
                local f2 = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = z }, cover)
                round(f2, rad)
                return f2
            end
            local glowL = layer(5)
            inst("UIGradient", {
                Rotation = 35,
                Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.72), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, 0.97), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.8) }),
            }, glowL)
            local spine = layer(6)
            inst("UIGradient", {
                Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.012, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.03, 0.75),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.08, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                }),
            }, spine)
            local u = math.clamp(h / 600, 0.6, 1.4)
            local function corner(ix, iy)
                local holder = inst("Frame", {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ix, iy), Position = UDim2.new(ix, ix == 1 and -26 * u or 26 * u, iy, iy == 1 and -26 * u or 26 * u),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28 * u, 28 * u), ZIndex = 7,
                }, cover)
                inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ix, iy), Position = UDim2.fromScale(ix, iy), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2), ZIndex = 7 }, holder)
                inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ix, iy), Position = UDim2.fromScale(ix, iy), Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, 0), ZIndex = 7 }, holder)
            end
            corner(0, 0)
            corner(1, 0)
            corner(0, 1)
            corner(1, 1)
            text({
                Text = "Z E R O   H U B   //   I N T E R F A C E", FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = math.floor(11 * u), TextColor3 = C.Dim,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(66 * u, 32 * u), Size = UDim2.new(0.6, 0, 0, 14 * u), ZIndex = 7,
            }, cover)
            text({
                Text = "v" .. tostring(Lib.Version), FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = math.floor(11 * u), TextColor3 = C.Dim, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -66 * u, 0, 32 * u), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80 * u, 14 * u), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, ZIndex = 7,
            }, cover)
            for k = 1, 3 do
                inst("Frame", {
                    BackgroundColor3 = col, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 + k * 0.18, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, -(70 + k * 12) * u, 1, -40 * u), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3 * u, 26 * u), Rotation = 25, ZIndex = 7,
                }, cover)
            end
            local mark
            if cfg.Wordmark then
                mark = inst("ImageLabel", {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = tostring(cfg.Wordmark), ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.42), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(w * 0.55, 520), math.min(w * 0.55, 520) / 3), ZIndex = 7,
                }, cover)
            else
                mark = text({
                    Text = string.upper(Lib.Name), FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = math.floor(44 * u), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
                    Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.42), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w * 0.7, 56 * u), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 7,
                }, cover)
            end
            local capY = 0.42
            local mapBlock = inst("Frame", {
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, capY, 62 * u),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 46 * u), ZIndex = 7,
            }, cover)
            list(mapBlock, nil, 4 * u, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
            text({
                Text = string.upper(tostring(cfg.SubCaption or "NOW FARMING")):gsub(".", "%0 "):sub(1, -2), FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = math.floor(10 * u),
                TextColor3 = col:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.2), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 12 * u),
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, LayoutOrder = 1, ZIndex = 7,
            }, mapBlock)
            local mapRow = inst("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26 * u), LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = 7 }, mapBlock)
            list(mapRow, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 14 * u, nil, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
            local function rule(order, flip)
                local r = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54 * u, 2), LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = 7 }, mapRow)
                inst("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new(flip and 0 or 1, flip and 1 or 0) }, r)
                return r
            end
            local r1 = rule(1, false)
            local mapL = text({
                Text = string.upper(baseSub ~= "" and baseSub or Lib.Name):gsub(".", "%0 "):sub(1, -2), FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = math.floor(20 * u),
                AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 26 * u), LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = 7,
            }, mapRow)
            inst("UIGradient", {
                Color = ColorSequence.new({
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)),
                    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, col:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.3)),
                }),
            }, mapL)
            local r2 = rule(3, true)
            local barTrack = inst("Frame", {
                BackgroundColor3 = C.Track, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.8, 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(0.32, 0, 0, 3), ZIndex = 7,
            }, cover)
            round(barTrack)
            local barFill = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(open and 0 or 1, 1), ZIndex = 7 }, barTrack)
            round(barFill)
            local stat = text({
                Text = open and "L O A D I N G" or "C L O S I N G", FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = math.floor(10 * u), TextColor3 = C.Sub,
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.8, -8 * u), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(200 * u, 12 * u),
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 7,
            }, cover)
            text({
                Text = tostring(cfg.Credit or ("Made by " .. Lib.Name)), FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = math.floor(11 * u), TextColor3 = C.Dim,
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -30 * u), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300 * u, 14 * u),
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, ZIndex = 7,
            }, cover)
            local shade = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 9 }, cover)
            round(shade, rad)
            local edgeShadow = inst("Frame", {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(left + w, cy), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(80, h - rad * 2), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 4,
            }, gui)
            inst("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1) }, edgeShadow)
            Lib._animWin = true
            local finished = false
            local function finish()
                if finished then return end
                finished = true
                pcall(function() coverHold:Destroy() end)
                pcall(function() edgeShadow:Destroy() end)
                Lib._animWin = false
                fit.Scale = Lib._baseScale or sc
                if W and W.queueFit then W.queueFit() end
                Lib._folding = false
                if done then pcall(done) end
            end
            local turn = 0.62
            local function flip(toW, dur, dir)
                ease(coverHold, dur, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(toW, h) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, dir)
                ease(edgeShadow, dur, { Position = UDim2.fromOffset(left + toW, cy) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, dir)
            end
            if open then
                local cs = inst("UIScale", { Scale = 0.92 }, coverHold)
                fit.Scale = sc * 0.96
                ease(cs, 0.3, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                if mark:IsA("ImageLabel") then
                    mark.ImageTransparency = 1
                    ease(mark, 0.3, { ImageTransparency = 0 })
                else
                    mark.TextTransparency = 1
                    ease(mark, 0.3, { TextTransparency = 0 })
                end
                r1.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2)
                r2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 2)
                ease(r1, 0.4, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54 * u, 2) })
                ease(r2, 0.4, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54 * u, 2) })
                ease(barFill, 0.5, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
                task.delay(0.52, function()
                    stat.Text = "R E A D Y"
                    stat.TextColor3 = col:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.3)
                end)
                sfx("uiOpen")
                task.delay(0.1, function() sfx("uiOpen2") end)
                task.delay(0.62, function()
                    sfx("whoosh")
                    flip(0, turn, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
                    ease(shade, turn, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.2 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
                    ease(edgeShadow, turn * 0.5, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                    task.delay(turn * 0.5, function() ease(edgeShadow, turn * 0.5, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad) end)
                    ease(fit, turn + 0.15, { Scale = sc }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                    task.delay(turn + 0.05, finish)
                end)
            else
                coverHold.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, h)
                edgeShadow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(left, cy)
                shade.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
                local d1 = turn * 0.85
                sfx("whoosh")
                sfx("uiClose")
                task.delay(d1 * 0.8, function() sfx("uiClose2") end)
                flip(w, d1, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
                ease(shade, d1, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
                ease(edgeShadow, d1 * 0.5, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                task.delay(d1 * 0.5, function() ease(edgeShadow, d1 * 0.5, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad) end)
                ease(fit, d1, { Scale = sc * 0.96 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                ease(barFill, d1, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
                task.delay(d1 + 0.15, function()
                    local cs = inst("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, coverHold)
                    ease(cs, 0.24, { Scale = 0.9 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
                    ease(cover, 0.24, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
                    for _, d in ipairs(cover:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d:IsA("Frame") then ease(d, 0.2, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 })
                        elseif d:IsA("ImageLabel") then ease(d, 0.2, { ImageTransparency = 1 })
                        elseif d:IsA("TextLabel") then ease(d, 0.2, { TextTransparency = 1 })
                        elseif d:IsA("UIStroke") then ease(d, 0.2, { Transparency = 1 }) end
                    end
                    task.delay(0.06, function() if done then body.Visible = false end end)
                    task.delay(0.26, function()
                        finish()
                        body.Visible = true
                    end)
                end)
            end
            task.delay(3, finish)
        end
        Lib.OnToggle()
        local function welcome(done)
            local col = accent()
            local hr = tonumber(os.date("%H")) or 12
            local greet = hr < 5 and "Good night" or hr < 12 and "Good morning" or hr < 18 and "Good afternoon" or "Good evening"
            local wg = inst("Frame", { Name = "Welcome", BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 80, Active = true }, top)
            local vp = viewport()
            local u = math.clamp(math.min(vp.X / 900, vp.Y / 560), 0.6, 1.2)
            local glow = inst("Frame", {
                BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(700 * u, 700 * u), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 80,
            }, wg)
            round(glow)
            inst("UIGradient", { Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.75), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, 0.95), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) }) , Rotation = 0 }, glow)
            local content = inst("CanvasGroup", {
                BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(560 * u, 420 * u),
                GroupTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 81,
            }, wg)
            local cscale = inst("UIScale", { Scale = 0.92 }, content)
            local ring = inst("Frame", {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 20), BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 10 * u),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(104 * u, 104 * u), ZIndex = 82,
            }, content)
            round(ring)
            local rs = stroke(ring, 0)
            rs.Thickness = 3
            rs.Color = col
            local rg = inst("UIGradient", {
                Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.9), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) }),
            }, rs)

    local NW, CH, PEEK = 340, 70, 9
    local ncenter = inst("Frame", {
        Name = "Notifications", BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(NW, 600),
    }, top)
    list(ncenter, nil, 10, Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Right, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Bottom)
    local groups = {}
    local gOrder = 0
    local function relayoutGroup(g)
        local n = #g.cards
        local shown = math.min(n, 3)
        local gh = 22 + CH + PEEK * math.max(shown - 1, 0)
        if Lib.FX then ease(g.frame, 0.4, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(NW, gh) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint) else g.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(NW, gh) end
        g.countL.Text = n > 1 and (n .. " notifications") or "1 notification"
        for i = n, 1, -1 do
            local c = g.cards[i]
            local d = n - i
            local goal = {
                Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, d * PEEK),
                GroupTransparency = d == 0 and 0 or (d == 1 and 0.45 or (d == 2 and 0.7 or 1)),
            }
            c.frame.ZIndex = 20 - d
            c.frame.Visible = d <= 2
            if Lib.FX then
                ease(c.frame, 0.45, goal, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
                ease(c.scale, 0.45, { Scale = 1 - d * 0.05 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint)
            else
                c.frame.Position = goal.Position
                c.frame.GroupTransparency = goal.GroupTransparency
                c.scale.Scale = 1 - d * 0.05
            end
        end
    end
    local function removeCard(g, c)
        if c.gone then return end
        c.gone = true
        for i, x in ipairs(g.cards) do
            if x == c then table.remove(g.cards, i) break end
        end
        if Lib.FX then
            ease(c.frame, 0.3, { Position = UDim2.new(1.4, 0, 0, c.frame.Position.Y.Offset), GroupTransparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In)
        end
        task.delay(Lib.FX and 0.32 or 0, function() pcall(function() c.frame:Destroy() end) end)
        if #g.cards == 0 then
            groups[g.key] = nil
            if Lib.FX then
                ease(g.head, 0.2, { GroupTransparency = 1 })
                ease(g.frame, 0.35, { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(NW, 0) }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
                task.delay(0.36, function() pcall(function() g.frame:Destroy() end) end)
            else
                pcall(function() g.frame:Destroy() end)
            end
        else
            relayoutGroup(g)
        end
    end
    local function getGroup(key, iconName, col)
        local g = groups[key]
        if g then
            gOrder = gOrder + 1
            g.frame.LayoutOrder = gOrder
            return g, false
        end
        gOrder = gOrder + 1
        g = { key = key, cards = {} }
        g.frame = inst("Frame", { Name = "Group", BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(NW, 0), LayoutOrder = gOrder, ClipsDescendants = false }, ncenter)
        g.head = inst("CanvasGroup", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18), GroupTransparency = Lib.FX and 1 or 0 }, g.frame)
        local hrow = inst("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 0) }, g.head)
        list(hrow, Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal, 6, nil, Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center)
        local hi = icon(iconName or "info", 12, hrow, col)
        hi.LayoutOrder = 1
        text({
            Text = string.upper(key), FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(215, 215, 222),
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18), LayoutOrder = 2,
        }, hrow)
        text({ Text = "·", FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = C.Dim, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18), LayoutOrder = 3 }, hrow)
        g.countL = text({ Text = "", FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = C.Sub, AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18), LayoutOrder = 4 }, hrow)
        local clr = inst("TextButton", {
            Text = "Clear", FontFace = F.Semi, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = C.Sub, AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 33),
            BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -2, 0.5, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18),
        }, g.head)
        round(clr)
        pad(clr, 8, 8, 0, 0)
        clr.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            for i = #g.cards, 1, -1 do removeCard(g, g.cards[i]) end
        end)
        g.stack = inst("Frame", { BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 22), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, CH) }, g.frame)
        groups[key] = g
        if Lib.FX then ease(g.head, 0.3, { GroupTransparency = 0 }) end
        return g, true
    end
    function Lib:Notify(ncfg)
        sfx("notify", 0.9)
        task.delay(0.09, function() sfx("notify2", 0.8) end)
        pcall(function()
            local vp = viewport()
            NW = math.min(340, vp.X - 24)
            ncenter.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(NW, math.max(vp.Y - 120, 200))
            local col = ncfg.Color or accent()
            local key = tostring(ncfg.Group or Lib._activeTab or Lib.Name)
            if key == "" then key = Lib.Name end
            local g = getGroup(key, ncfg.Icon or "info", col)
            local card = inst("CanvasGroup", {
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 27), BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, CH), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, Lib.FX and CH + 40 or 0), GroupTransparency = Lib.FX and 1 or 0, ZIndex = 20,
            }, g.stack)
            round(card, 18)
            local cst = stroke(card, 0.85)
            local cscale = inst("UIScale", { Scale = Lib.FX and 0.9 or 1 }, card)
            local tile = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40) }, card)
            round(tile, 12)
            inst("UIGradient", { Rotation = 45, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)) }, tile)
            local ti = icon(ncfg.Icon or "info", 19, tile, Color3.new(1, 1, 1))
            ti.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            ti.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
            text({
                Text = tostring(ncfg.Title or Lib.Name), FontFace = F.Bold, TextSize = 15, TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 14), Size = UDim2.new(1, -120, 0, 19), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            }, card)
            text({
                Text = "now", FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 11, TextColor3 = C.Dim, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 16),
                Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 14), TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
            }, card)
            text({
                Text = tostring(ncfg.Content or ""), FontFace = F.Med, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(175, 175, 185),
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 36), Size = UDim2.new(1, -82, 0, 17), TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            }, card)
            local bar = inst("Frame", { BackgroundColor3 = col, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 1, -1), Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 2) }, card)
            round(bar)
            local hit = inst("TextButton", { Text = "", AutoButtonColor = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = 5 }, card)
            local c = { frame = card, scale = cscale }
            table.insert(g.cards, c)
            while #g.cards > 6 do removeCard(g, g.cards[1]) end
            local drag
            hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
                if not isPress(i) then return end
                drag = { x = i.Position.X, dx = 0 }
            end)
            local mv = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
                if not drag or not isMove(i) then return end
                drag.dx = i.Position.X - drag.x
                card.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, drag.dx, 0, card.Position.Y.Offset)
                card.GroupTransparency = math.clamp(math.abs(drag.dx) / 260, 0, 0.8)
            end)
            local en
            en = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
                if not drag or not isPress(i) then return end
                local dx = drag.dx
                drag = nil
                if math.abs(dx) > 80 or math.abs(dx) < 6 then
                    if math.abs(dx) > 80 and Lib.FX then
                        ease(card, 0.25, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, dx > 0 and NW or -NW, 0, card.Position.Y.Offset), GroupTransparency = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad)
                    end
                    removeCard(g, c)
                else
                    ease(card, 0.35, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, card.Position.Y.Offset), GroupTransparency = 0 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                end
            end)
            card.Destroying:Connect(function()
                pcall(function() mv:Disconnect() end)
                pcall(function() en:Disconnect() end)
            end)
            hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tw(cst, 0.15, { Color = col, Transparency = 0.4 }) end)
            hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tw(cst, 0.2, { Color = C.Line, Transparency = 0.85 }) end)
            relayoutGroup(g)
            if Lib.FX then
                ease(card, 0.55, { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0), GroupTransparency = 0 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                ease(cscale, 0.55, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
                local ts = inst("UIScale", { Scale = 0.4 }, tile)
                task.delay(0.15, function() ease(ts, 0.45, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
            end
            local dur = tonumber(ncfg.Duration) or 4
            TweenService:Create(bar, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2) }):Play()
            task.delay(dur, function() removeCard(g, c) end)
        end)
    end

    function Lib:Destroy()
        if Lib.Unloaded then return end
        Lib.Unloaded = true
        for _, c in ipairs(Lib.Conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        Lib.Conns = {}
        pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
        pcall(function() top:Destroy() end)
        pcall(function() if sfxFolder then sfxFolder:Destroy() end end)
        if Lib.OnDestroy then pcall(Lib.OnDestroy) end
    end

    return Lib
end)()

				st.Color = stroke
				st.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
				local badge = Instance.new("Frame")
				badge.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
				badge.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, 0)
				badge.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 34)
				badge.BackgroundColor3 = C.Raise
				badge.BorderSizePixel = 0
				badge.Parent = b
				Instance.new("UICorner", badge).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
				local code_ = text({ Text = code, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, FontFace = font(Enum.FontWeight.Bold), TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = C.Sub, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Parent = badge })
				text({ Text = title, FontFace = font(Enum.FontWeight.SemiBold), TextSize = 15, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 9), Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 18), Parent = b })
				text({ Text = sub, TextColor3 = C.Sub, TextSize = 12, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(58, 28), Size = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0, 16), Parent = b })
				local function paint(on)
					TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { BackgroundColor3 = on and C.Hover or C.Card }):Play()
					TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { Color = on and accent or stroke }):Play()
					TweenService:Create(code_, TweenInfo.new(0.18), { TextColor3 = on and accent or C.Sub }):Play()
				end
				b.MouseEnter:Connect(function() paint(true) end)
				b.MouseLeave:Connect(function() paint(false) end)
				b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
					if chosen then return end
					chosen = true
					paint(true)
					Env.AcademyHubLang = code
					if writefile then pcall(writefile, T.File, code) end
					TweenService:Create(Overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
					TweenService:Create(Card, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
					TweenService:Create(Scale, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { Scale = 0.92 }):Play()
					task.wait(0.2)
					ScreenGui:Destroy()
					done:Fire()
				end)
			end
			option(96, "English", "Use the hub in English", "EN")
			option(158, "ภาษาไทย", "ใช้งานเมนูเป็นภาษาไทย", "TH")

			TweenService:Create(Overlay, TweenInfo.new(0.25), { BackgroundTransparency = 0.35 }):Play()
			TweenService:Create(Scale, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
			done.Event:Wait()
		end

		local Prefixes = { { "Auto ", "ออโต้ " }, { "Buy ", "ซื้อ " }, { "Craft ", "คราฟต์ " }, { "Esp ", "ESP " } }
		setmetatable(T, {
			__index = function(_, k)
				if lang ~= "TH" then return k end
				if TH[k] then return TH[k] end
				if type(k) == "string" then
					for _, p in ipairs(Prefixes) do
						if string.sub(k, 1, #p[1]) == p[1] then return p[2] .. string.sub(k, #p[1] + 1) end
					end
				end
				return k
			end,
		})
	end

	local Swaps = {
		{ "🎃 Event arrived yet?  ", "🎃 อีเวนต์มาหรือยัง?  " },
