	local function tr(s)
		s = tostring(s or "")
		if lang ~= "TH" then return s end
		if TH[s] then return TH[s] end
		for _, p in ipairs(Swaps) do
			local a, b = string.find(s, p[1], 1, true)
			if a then s = string.sub(s, 1, a - 1) .. p[2] .. string.sub(s, b + 1) end
		end
		return s
	end

	local MobileUI = game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled and not game:GetService("UserInputService").KeyboardEnabled
	local MobileSize = UDim2.fromOffset(600, 380)

	local Window = UI:CreateWindow({
		Title = "Academy Hub",
		SubTitle = "Blox Fruits",
		Wordmark = false,
		WordmarkHeight = 40,
		LogoText = "AH",
		Logo = (Env.__AcademyLogoAsset and Env.__AcademyLogoAsset()) or "rbxassetid://132023049848714",
		Credit = "Made by Academy Hub",
		ToggleKey = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl,
		ConfigFolder = "Academy Hub Blox Fruits",
		CloseNote = "Auto features stop and the Academy Hub window closes.",
		Size = MobileUI and MobileSize or nil,
	})

	if MobileUI then
		task.spawn(function()
			pcall(function()
				local function windowLike(f)
					if not (f:IsA("Frame") or f:IsA("CanvasGroup")) then return false end
					local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
					local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1000, 1000)
					local s = f.AbsoluteSize
					return f.Visible and s.X >= 250 and s.Y >= 150
						and (s.X < vp.X - 4 or s.Y < vp.Y - 4)
						and not f:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScrollingFrame")
				end
				local function findWindow()
					local gui = UI.GUI
					if not gui then return nil end
					local best, bestArea = nil, 0
					for _, d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
						if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Text == "Academy Hub" then
							local p = d.Parent
							while p and p ~= gui do
								if windowLike(p) then
									local a = p.AbsoluteSize.X * p.AbsoluteSize.Y
									if a > bestArea then best, bestArea = p, a end
								end
								p = p.Parent
							end
						end
					end
					if best then return best end
					for _, d in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
						if windowLike(d) then
							local a = d.AbsoluteSize.X * d.AbsoluteSize.Y
							if a > bestArea then best, bestArea = d, a end
						end
					end
					return best
				end
				local frame
				for _ = 1, 40 do
					frame = findWindow()
					if frame then break end
					task.wait(0.25)
				end
				if not frame then return end
				frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
				local function apply()
					if UI.Unloaded or Window.Minimized or frame.Size == MobileSize then return end
					frame.Size = MobileSize
				end
				apply()
				frame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"):Connect(apply)
			end)
		end)
	end

	Window:AddSection("Overview")
	local Home = Window:AddTab({ Title = "Home", Icon = "home", Description = "Have fun!", Greeting = true })
	do
		local function tp(fn)
			local ok, err = pcall(fn)
			if not ok then UI:Notify({ Title = "Teleport failed", Content = tostring(err), Duration = 4 }) end
		end
		local function rejoin()
			UI:Notify({ Title = "Rejoining", Content = "Joining this server again...", Duration = 3 })
			if #Players:GetPlayers() <= 1 or game.PrivateServerId ~= "" then
				tp(function() TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer) end)
			else
				tp(function() TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, game.JobId, LocalPlayer) end)
			end
		end
		local function hop()
			UI:Notify({ Title = "Server hop", Content = "Looking for another server...", Duration = 3 })
			local picks, cursor = {}, nil
			for _ = 1, 3 do
				local url = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. game.PlaceId .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Desc&limit=100"
				if cursor then url = url .. "&cursor=" .. cursor end
				local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet(url)) end)
				if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.data) ~= "table" then break end
				for _, s in ipairs(data.data) do
					local playing, maxP = tonumber(s.playing), tonumber(s.maxPlayers)
					if s.id ~= game.JobId and playing and maxP and playing < maxP then picks[#picks + 1] = s.id end
				end
				cursor = data.nextPageCursor
				if #picks > 0 or not cursor then break end
			end
			if #picks == 0 then
				UI:Notify({ Title = "No other server found", Content = "Joining a new server instead.", Duration = 3 })
				tp(function() TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, LocalPlayer) end)
				return
			end
			tp(function() TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, picks[math.random(1, #picks)], LocalPlayer) end)
		end
		local function leave()
			UI:Confirm({
				Title = "Leave the game?",
				Content = "Roblox closes this game right away.",
				Button = "Leave",
				Callback = function()
					if not pcall(function() game:Shutdown() end) then LocalPlayer:Kick("You left the game.") end
				end,
			})
		end
		Home:AddGameCard({
			Buttons = {
				{ Title = "Rejoin", Callback = rejoin },
				{ Title = "Server Hop", Callback = hop },
				{ Title = "Leave Game", Callback = leave, Danger = true },
			},
		})
		table.insert(UI.Conns, TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(plr, _, msg)
			if plr == LocalPlayer then UI:Notify({ Title = "Teleport failed", Content = tostring(msg or ""), Duration = 4 }) end
		end))
	end
	Home:AddStatTiles()
	local Hero = Home:AddHero({ Title = T["Current activity"] })
	Hero:Set({ main = T["Idle"], sub = "Blox Fruits", badge = T["READY"], badgeColor = UI.Colors.Good })
	local HomeStats = Home:AddStats({
		{ "level", T["Level"] },
		{ "beli", T["Beli"] },
		{ "frag", T["Fragments"] },
		{ "bounty", T["Bounty / Honor"] },
	})

	local function safe(fn, ...)
		if type(fn) == "function" then
			local ok, err = pcall(fn, ...)
			if not ok then
				warn("[Academy Hub] " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end

	local function opts(a, b)
		if type(a) == "table" then
			return a, nil
		end
		return b or {}, a
	end

	local function uid(id, title, kind)
		if not id then
			id = kind .. "_" .. (string.gsub(tostring(title or ""), "[^%w]+", "_"))
		end
		local base, n = id, 1
		while Options[id] do
			n = n + 1
			id = base .. "_" .. n
		end
		return id
	end

	local function desc(o)
		return o.Tooltip and T[o.Tooltip] or nil
	end

	local rows = 0
	local Group = {}
	Group.__index = Group

	local function use(g)
		rows = rows + 1
		if rows % 40 == 0 then task.wait() end
		g.tab.card = g.card
	end

	function Group:AddLabel(s)
		use(self)
		local p = self.tab:AddParagraph({ Title = tr(s), Content = "" })
		local label = { Value = s }
		function label:SetText(newText)
			label.Value = newText
			p:SetTitle(tr(newText))
		end
		return label
	end

	function Group:AddToggle(id, o)
		o, id = opts(id, o)
		local cb = o.Callback
		local default = o.Default and true or false
		use(self)
		local key = uid(id, o.Text, "Toggle")
		local opt = self.tab:AddToggle(key, {
			Title = T[o.Text or key],
			Description = desc(o),
			Default = default,
			Callback = function(v) safe(cb, v) end,
		})
		if self.owner.quiet or default then UI.StatusIgnore[key] = true end
		if cb then OffCallbacks[#OffCallbacks + 1] = cb end
		if default then safe(cb, true) end
		return opt
	end

	function Group:AddButton(a, b)
		local o = type(a) == "table" and a or { Text = a, Func = b }
		use(self)
		return self.tab:AddButton({
			Title = T[o.Text or "Button"],
			Description = desc(o),
			ButtonText = T["Run"],
			Callback = function() safe(o.Func or o.Callback) end,
		})
	end

	function Group:AddSlider(id, o)
		o, id = opts(id, o)
		local cb = o.Callback
		local min, max = o.Min or 0, o.Max or 100
		local default = o.Default or min
		use(self)
		local opt = self.tab:AddSlider(uid(id, o.Text, "Slider"), {
			Title = T[o.Text or tostring(id)],
			Description = desc(o),
			Min = min,
			Max = max,
			Default = default,
			Rounding = o.Rounding or 0,
			Callback = function(v) safe(cb, v) end,
		})
		safe(cb, default)
		return opt
	end

	function Group:AddDropdown(id, o)
		o, id = opts(id, o)
		local cb = o.Callback
		local values, list, back = o.Values or {}, {}, {}
		for i, v in ipairs(values) do
			list[i] = tostring(v)
			back[list[i]] = v
		end
		if #list == 0 then
			list[1] = "-"
			back["-"] = "-"
		end
		local title = T[o.Text or tostring(id)]
		use(self)
		local key = uid(id, o.Text, "Dropdown")

		if o.Multi then
			local def, selected = {}, {}
			if type(o.Default) == "table" then
				for k, v in pairs(o.Default) do
					local name = (v == true and tostring(k)) or (type(k) == "number" and tostring(v)) or nil
					if name and back[name] ~= nil and not selected[name] then
						selected[name] = true
						def[#def + 1] = name
					end
				end
			end
			local opt = self.tab:AddDropdown(key, {
				Title = title,
				Description = desc(o),
				Values = list,
				Multi = true,
				Default = def,
				Callback = function(v) safe(cb, v) end,
			})
			safe(cb, selected)
			return opt
		end

		local index = 1
		if type(o.Default) == "number" and list[o.Default] ~= nil then
			index = o.Default
		elseif type(o.Default) == "string" then
			index = table.find(list, o.Default) or 1
		end
		local opt = self.tab:AddDropdown(key, {
			Title = title,
			Description = desc(o),
			Values = list,
			Default = list[index],
			Callback = function(v)
				if back[v] ~= nil then v = back[v] end
				safe(cb, v)
			end,
		})
		if list[index] ~= "-" then
			safe(cb, back[list[index]])
		end
		return opt
	end

	function Group:AddInput(id, o)
		o, id = opts(id, o)
		local cb = o.Callback
		use(self)
		local opt = self.tab:AddInput(uid(id, o.Text, "Input"), {
			Title = T[o.Text or tostring(id)],
			Description = desc(o),
			Default = o.Default or "",
			Placeholder = o.Placeholder or "",
			Callback = function(v) safe(cb, v) end,
		})
		opt.NoSave = true
		return opt
	end

	local TabApi = {}
	TabApi.__index = TabApi

	local function newGroup(self, title)
		self.tab:AddSection(T[title])
		return setmetatable({ tab = self.tab, card = self.tab.card, owner = self }, Group)
	end
	function TabApi:AddLeftGroupbox(title)
		return newGroup(self, title)
	end
	function TabApi:AddRightGroupbox(title)
		return newGroup(self, title)
	end

	local SectionOf = {
		["Info And Status"] = "Main", ["Farming"] = "Main", ["Setting"] = "Main", ["Fishing"] = "Main",
		["Event"] = "Event",
		["Quest And Item"] = "Game", ["Sea Event"] = "Game", ["Mirage And Race"] = "Game", ["Volcano Event"] = "Game",
		["Stats And Esp"] = "Player", ["Fruit And Raid"] = "Player", ["Local Player"] = "Player",
		["Teleport"] = "More", ["Shopping"] = "More", ["Miscellaneous"] = "More",
	}
	local TabInfo = {
		["Info And Status"] = { "Status", "info", "Islands, bosses, moon and server status" },
		["Farming"] = { "Farm", "swords", "Level, bosses, mobs, materials and mastery" },
		["Setting"] = { "Farm Settings", "bars", "Weapon, fast attack, bring mobs and safety" },
		["Fishing"] = { "Fishing", "target", "Rods, bait, fishing quests and selling fish" },
		["Event"] = { "Event", "flame", "Halloween event" },
		["Quest And Item"] = { "Quests", "scroll", "Swords, fighting styles, items and quests" },
		["Sea Event"] = { "Sea Event", "flag", "Boats, sea beasts, Kitsune and Leviathan" },
		["Mirage And Race"] = { "Race", "sparkles", "Mirage Island, full moon and race trials" },
		["Volcano Event"] = { "Volcano", "flame", "Prehistoric Island and Drago" },
		["Stats And Esp"] = { "Stats & ESP", "chart", "Stat points, ESP and haki colours" },
		["Fruit And Raid"] = { "Fruit & Raid", "bolt", "Fruits, raids and dungeons" },
		["Local Player"] = { "Player", "user", "Combat, aimbot and movement" },
		["Teleport"] = { "Teleport", "run", "Seas, islands, NPCs and portals" },
		["Shopping"] = { "Shop", "cart", "Weapons, fighting styles, haki and items" },
		["Miscellaneous"] = { "Misc", "gamepad", "Server, graphics and game GUI" },
	}
	local lastSection = "Overview"
	local win = {}
	function win:AddTab(name)
		local sec = SectionOf[name] or "More"
		if sec ~= lastSection then
			Window:AddSection(sec)
			lastSection = sec
		end
		local info = TabInfo[name] or { name, "sparkles", "" }
		local tab = Window:AddTab({ Title = T[info[1]], Icon = info[2], Description = T[info[3]] })
		return setmetatable({ tab = tab, name = name, quiet = name == "Setting" }, TabApi)
	end

	local api = {}
	function api.ToggleUI() end
	function api:Notify(o)
		o = o or {}
		UI:Notify({
			Title = (o.Title == nil or o.Title == "ZeroHub") and "Academy Hub" or tostring(o.Title),
			Content = tr(o.Description or o.Content or ""),
			Duration = o.Duration or 5,
		})
	end

	return api, win, { UI = UI, T = T, tr = tr, Env = Env, Window = Window, Home = Home, Hero = Hero, HomeStats = HomeStats }
end)()

		local v242 = v241 < 12 and "AM"
		local v243 = string.format("%02i:%02i:%02i %s", (v241 - 1) % 12 + 1, v240.min, v240.sec, v242 or "PM")
		local v244 = string.format("%02d/%02d/%04d", v240.day, v240.month, v240.year)
		local LocalizationService = game:GetService("LocalizationService")
		local LocalPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
		local countryRegionCode

		if getgenv().countryRegionCode then
			countryRegionCode = getgenv().countryRegionCode
		else
			local ok

			ok, countryRegionCode = pcall(function()
				return LocalizationService:GetCountryRegionForPlayerAsync(LocalPlayer)
			end)

			if ok then
				getgenv().countryRegionCode = countryRegionCode
			else
				getgenv().countryRegionCode = "Unknown"
			end
		end

		v239:SetText(v244 .. " - " .. v243 .. " [ " .. countryRegionCode .. " ]")
	end

	local function v305()

	local visited = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local skipPumpkin = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local bossDoorNext = 0

	local function getRoot()
		local c = lp.Character
		return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	end

	local hotelCache, hotelCheckAt = nil, 0
	local function getHotel()
		if hotelCache and hotelCache.Parent then return hotelCache end
		hotelCache = nil
		local m = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
		local t = m and m:FindFirstChild("Turtle")
		local i = t and t:FindFirstChild("IslandModel")
		local h = i and i:FindFirstChild("HalloweenHotel")
		if not h then
			-- v5.2: the hotel only exists in Sea 3; the deep search scans 50k+ descendants, so retry rarely in Sea 1/2
			if tick() - hotelCheckAt < (World3 and 5 or 60) then return nil end
			hotelCheckAt = tick()
			h = workspace:FindFirstChild("HalloweenHotel", true)
		end
		hotelCache = h
		return h
	end
	_G.ZH_GetHotel = getHotel

	local function doorPrompt(door)
		local prox = door:FindFirstChild("Proximity")
		return (prox and prox:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)) or door:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
	end

	local function doorPos(door)
		local prox = door:FindFirstChild("Proximity")
		if prox and prox:IsA("BasePart") then return prox.Position end
		return door:GetPivot().Position
	end

	-- ===== v5: Halloween door registry (works in Sea 1 / 2 / 3) =====
	-- Doors are found by name anywhere in workspace and tracked live (StreamingEnabled safe).
	-- Door positions are remembered so the farm can fly back to doors that streamed out.
	local ZHD = {
		doors = {}, known = {}, keyOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), cool = {},
		count = 0, opened = 0, lapOpened = 0, wp = 1, idleUntil = 0, roam = {}, ownOpen = 0, hasCd = false,
	}
	_G.ZH_DoorRegistry = ZHD
	ZHD.busyAt, ZHD.sceneUntil, ZHD.bossDoneAt, ZHD.dropWin, ZHD.exitDoneAt, ZHD.exitTries, ZHD.exitNext = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0

	-- v5.2: in Sea 1 every HalloweenDoor sits in Middle Town (Map.Town.HalloweenDecor, x -1150..-480, z 1360..1830),
	-- so sweep the town (centre / north / west / south) instead of flying to far islands.
	ZHD.roam[1] = {
		{ "Middle Town", Vector3.new(-655, 15, 1578) },
		{ "Town North", Vector3.new(-700, 15, 1790) },
		{ "Town West", Vector3.new(-1040, 15, 1560) },
		{ "Town South", Vector3.new(-680, 15, 1400) },
	}
	ZHD.roam[2] = {
		{ "Kingdom of Rose", Vector3.new(-321, 73, 297) },
		{ "Snow Mountain", Vector3.new(561, 401, -5306) },
		{ "Ice Castle", Vector3.new(6137, 294, -6747) },
		{ "Forgotten Island", Vector3.new(-3043, 238, -10191) },
		{ "Green Zone", Vector3.new(-2447, 73, -3211) },
		{ "Hot and Cold", Vector3.new(-5478, 15, -5240) },
		{ "Graveyard Island", Vector3.new(-9515, 142, 5536) },
	}
	ZHD.roam[3] = {
		{ "Port Town", Vector3.new(-290, 44, 5450) },
		{ "Hydra Island", Vector3.new(5228, 604, 345) },
		{ "Great Tree", Vector3.new(2682, 1682, -7190) },
		{ "Sea of Treats", Vector3.new(-1145, 13, -14450) },
		{ "Tiki Outpost", Vector3.new(-16200, 90, -17300) },
		{ "Floating Turtle", Vector3.new(-12000, 331, -8500) },
		{ "Haunted Castle", Vector3.new(-9515, 142, 5536) },
	}

	function ZHD.isName(n)
		n = tostring(n):lower()
		if n:sub(1, 13) == "halloweendoor" or n:find("trickortreat", 1, true) or n:find("trick_or_treat", 1, true) then
			return true
		end
		return n:find("halloween", 1, true) ~= nil and n:find("door", 1, true) ~= nil
	end

	function ZHD.key(pos)
		return math.floor(pos.X / 4) .. "," .. math.floor(pos.Y / 4) .. "," .. math.floor(pos.Z / 4)
	end

	function ZHD.reg(inst)
		if ZHD.doors[inst] then return end
		if not (inst:IsA("Model") or inst:IsA("BasePart")) then return end
		if not ZHD.isName(inst.Name) then return end
		local p = inst.Parent
		while p and p ~= workspace do
			if ZHD.isName(p.Name) and (p:IsA("Model") or p:IsA("BasePart")) then return end
			p = p.Parent
		end
		local ok, pos = pcall(function() return inst:GetPivot().Position end)
		if not ok or not pos then return end
		local k = ZHD.key(pos)
		ZHD.doors[inst] = true
		ZHD.keyOf[inst] = k
		local info = ZHD.known[k]
		if not info then
			info = { pos = pos, name = inst.Name }
			ZHD.known[k] = info
			ZHD.count = ZHD.count + 1
		end
		info.live = true
		if doorPrompt(inst) then info.hadPrompt = true end
		local c = ZHD.cool[k]
		if c and tick() < c then visited[inst] = c end
	end

	function ZHD.mark(door, secs)
		local k = ZHD.keyOf[door]
		if k then ZHD.cool[k] = tick() + secs end
	end

	function ZHD.now()
		local ok, t = pcall(function() return workspace:GetServerTimeNow() end)
		return ok and t or os.time()
	end

	-- seconds until the server lets this door be used again (0 = usable now).
	-- Doors carry CooldownUntil (server time) / DoorOpen attributes; the prompt stays Enabled during cooldown.
	function ZHD.wait(d)
		local cd = d:GetAttribute("CooldownUntil")
		local w = 0
		if type(cd) == "number" then
			w = cd - ZHD.now()
		elseif d:GetAttribute("DoorOpen") == true then
			w = 3
		end
		return w > 0 and w or 0
	end

	function ZHD.ping()
		local ok, v = pcall(function() return game:GetService("Stats").Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue() end)
		if ok and type(v) == "number" then return math.clamp(v / 1000, 0, 4) end
		return 0
	end

	function ZHD.sea()
		if World1 then return 1 elseif World2 then return 2 elseif World3 then return 3 end
		return tonumber(tostring(workspace:GetAttribute("MAP") or ""):match("Sea(%d)"))
	end

	-- how long to skip a door we just used (server cooldown handles the rest when doors carry CooldownUntil)
	function ZHD.revisit()
		return ZHD.hasCd and (8 + ZHD.ping() * 2) or 30
	end

	-- the server tells every client who opened a door: ("DoorOpened", "HalloweenDoor", playerName, info)
	task.spawn(function()
		local rem = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes", 10)
		local hev = rem and rem:WaitForChild("HalloweenEvent", 10)
		if hev and hev:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			hev.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(kind, _, who)
				if kind == "DoorOpened" and (who == lp.Name or who == lp.DisplayName) then ZHD.ownOpen = tick() ZHD.dropWin = tick() + 30 end
			end)
		end
	end)

	-- v5.3: the game prints "You're still busy with another door!" while a door scene is still open.
	-- Remember when that happens so the farm stops spamming doors and goes for the exit door instead.
	task.spawn(function()
		local pg = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 30)
		if not pg then return end
		local function watch(g)
			if not (g:IsA("TextLabel") or g:IsA("TextButton")) then return end
			local function chk()
				local ok, t = pcall(function() return g.Text:lower() end)
				if ok and t:find("busy with another door", 1, true) then ZHD.busyAt = tick() end
			end
			chk()
			g:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(chk)
		end
		pg.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(g) pcall(watch, g) end)
	end)
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
		if ZHD.isName(d.Name) then
			task.delay(0.3, function()
				if d.Parent then pcall(ZHD.reg, d) end
			end)
		end
	end)
	workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(d)
		if ZHD.doors[d] then
			ZHD.doors[d] = nil
			local info = ZHD.known[ZHD.keyOf[d]]
			if info then info.live = false end
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		pcall(function()
			local n = 0
			for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
				if ZHD.isName(d.Name) then pcall(ZHD.reg, d) end
				n = n + 1
				if n % 4000 == 0 then task.wait() end
			end
		end)
	end)

	-- ===== v5.3 helpers =====
	function ZHD.hasWord(s, list)
		s = tostring(s or ""):lower()
		for _, w in ipairs(list) do
			if s:find(w, 1, true) then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	function ZHD.nameHasExit(s)
		s = tostring(s or ""):lower()
		return s:find("exit", 1, true) ~= nil or s:find("ออก", 1, true) ~= nil or s == "leave" or s == "go out"
	end

	function ZHD.promptPos(pr)
		local p = pr.Parent
		if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then return p.Position end
		if p and p:IsA("Attachment") then return p.WorldPosition end
		if p and p:IsA("Model") then return p:GetPivot().Position end
		return nil
	end

	-- the HalloweenDoor that belongs to a boss / event scene sits next to Boundary / Collapse / PillarTemplates (seen in Dex).
	-- That is the EXIT door, not a trick-or-treat door.
	function ZHD.isArena(d)
		local p = d.Parent
		if not p then return false end
		return p:FindFirstChild("Boundary") ~= nil or p:FindFirstChild("Collapse") ~= nil or p:FindFirstChild("PillarTemplates") ~= nil
	end
	local doorCache, doorCacheAt = {}, 0
	local function scanDoors()
		if #doorCache > 0 and tick() - doorCacheAt < 1.5 then return doorCache end
		doorCacheAt = tick()
		local list = {}
		for d in pairs(ZHD.doors) do
			if d.Parent then
				table.insert(list, d)
				if not ZHD.hasCd and d:GetAttribute("CooldownUntil") ~= nil then ZHD.hasCd = true end
				local v, k = visited[d], ZHD.keyOf[d]
				if v and k and (ZHD.cool[k] or 0) < v then ZHD.cool[k] = v end
				local info = k and ZHD.known[k]
				if info and not info.hadPrompt and doorPrompt(d) then info.hadPrompt = true end
				if info and not info.arena and ZHD.isArena(d) then info.arena = true end
			else
				ZHD.doors[d] = nil
			end
		end
		doorCache = list
		return list
	end

	local function nextDoor(root)
		local best, bd, bp, bpr = nil, math.huge, nil, nil
		local now = tick()
		for _, d in ipairs(scanDoors()) do
			if d.Parent and not (visited[d] and now < visited[d]) and ZHD.wait(d) <= 0 and not ZHD.isArena(d) then
				local pr = doorPrompt(d)
				if pr and pr.Enabled then
					local pos = doorPos(d)
					local dist = (pos - root.Position).Magnitude
					if dist < bd then best, bd, bp, bpr = d, dist, pos, pr end
				end
			end
		end
		return best, bp, bpr
	end

	local function bossDoor(root)
		local hotel = getHotel()
		if not hotel then
			local best, bd = nil, math.huge
			for _, x in ipairs(scanDoors()) do
				if x:FindFirstChild("SceneWindow") and not ZHD.isArena(x) then
					local dist = (doorPos(x) - root.Position).Magnitude
					if dist < bd then best, bd = x, dist end
				end
			end
			return best
		end
		local ch = hotel:GetChildren()
		local d = ch[101]
		if d and d:FindFirstChild("SceneWindow") then return d end
		local best, bd = nil, math.huge
		for _, x in ipairs(ch) do
			if x:FindFirstChild("SceneWindow") then
				local dist = (doorPos(x) - root.Position).Magnitude
				if dist < bd then best, bd = x, dist end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	local function pressE(prompt)
		pcall(function()
			if fireproximityprompt and prompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
		end)
		pcall(function()
			VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.E, false, game)
			task.wait()
			VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.E, false, game)
		end)
	end

	local knockBusy = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local function knockDoor(door)
		if not door or knockBusy[door] then return end
		knockBusy[door] = true
		task.spawn(function()
			pcall(function()
				RS:WaitForChild("Remotes", 3):WaitForChild("HalloweenFunction", 3):InvokeServer(door)
			end)
			task.wait(0.3)
			knockBusy[door] = nil
		end)
	end

	_G.TalkChoice = _G.TalkChoice or "First Option"

	local function dialogueFrame()
		local pg = lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
		local gui = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("DialogueGui")
		if not gui then return nil end
		if gui:IsA("ScreenGui") and not gui.Enabled then return nil end
		for _, f in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
			if f:IsA("GuiObject") and f.Visible and f:FindFirstChild("dialogueText", true) then
				return f
			end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function dialogueOpen()
		local ok, res = pcall(function() return dialogueFrame() ~= nil end)
		return ok and res
	end

	local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")

	local function screenPoint(g)
		local pos, size = g.AbsolutePosition, g.AbsoluteSize
		local cx, cy = pos.X + size.X / 2, pos.Y + size.Y / 2
		local sg = g:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
		if not (sg and sg.IgnoreGuiInset) then
			cy = cy + GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y
		end
		return cx, cy
	end

	local function purchasePromptOpen()
		local ok, res = pcall(function()
			local rp = game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("RobloxPromptGui")
			if not rp then return false end
			if rp:FindFirstChild("PurchasePrompt", true) or rp:FindFirstChild("ProductPurchaseContainer", true) then
				return true
			end
			local ov = rp:FindFirstChild("promptOverlay")
			return ov ~= nil and #ov:GetChildren() > 0
		end)
		return ok and res == true
	end

	local function waitSettled(g)
		local last = g.AbsolutePosition
		local t0 = tick()
		while tick() - t0 < 1.5 do
			task.wait(0.1)
			local now = g.AbsolutePosition
			if (now - last).Magnitude < 1 then return true end
			last = now
		end
		return false
	end

	local function safePoint(g)
		waitSettled(g)
		local x, y = screenPoint(g)
		local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1000, 1000)
		local inset = GuiService:GetGuiInset()
		if x < 0 or y < 0 or x > vp.X or y > vp.Y + inset.Y then return nil end
		return x, y
	end

	local function mouseClick(g)
		pcall(function()
			if purchasePromptOpen() then return end
			local x, y = safePoint(g)
			if not x then return end
			VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true, game, 0)
			task.wait(0.03)
			VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 0)
		end)
	end

	local function touchTap(g)
		pcall(function()
			if purchasePromptOpen() then return end
			local x, y = safePoint(g)
			if not x then return end
			VIM:SendTouchEvent(1, 0, x, y)
			task.wait(0.03)
			VIM:SendTouchEvent(1, 2, x, y)
		end)
	end

	local function signalFire(g)
		if not (firesignal and g:IsA("GuiButton")) then return false end
		local ok = false
		for _, ev in ipairs({ "MouseButton1Down", "MouseButton1Up", "MouseButton1Click", "Activated" }) do
			if pcall(function() firesignal(g[ev]) end) then ok = true end
		end
		return ok
	end

	local function rawGuiText(g)
		local t = ""
		pcall(function()
			if (g:IsA("TextButton") or g:IsA("TextLabel")) and g.Text ~= "" then
				t = g.Text
				return
			end
			local fills, any = {}, nil
			for _, d in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("TextLabel") and d.Text ~= "" then
					any = any or d.Text
					if d.Name == "fill" and d.Visible then table.insert(fills, d) end
				end
			end
			if #fills > 0 then
				table.sort(fills, function(a, b)
					local ay, by = a.AbsolutePosition.Y, b.AbsolutePosition.Y
					if math.abs(ay - by) > 4 then return ay < by end
					return a.AbsolutePosition.X < b.AbsolutePosition.X
				end)
				local parts = {}
				for _, f in ipairs(fills) do table.insert(parts, f.Text) end
				t = table.concat(parts)
			else
				t = any or ""
			end
		end)
		return t
	end

	local function guiText(g)
		return (tostring(rawGuiText(g)):gsub("<[^>]+>", ""))
	end

	local function dialogueSig(frame)
		local tf = frame:FindFirstChild("dialogueTitleFrame", true)
		local tx = frame:FindFirstChild("dialogueText", true)
		return (tf and guiText(tf) or "") .. "|" .. (tx and guiText(tx) or "") .. "|" .. tostring(#frame:GetDescendants())
	end

	local function advanceDialogue(frame)
		local list = frame:FindFirstChild("optionsList", true)
		local before = dialogueSig(frame)
		local txt = frame:FindFirstChild("dialogueText", true)
		local page = frame:FindFirstChild("pageButton", true)

		for _, d in ipairs(frame:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("GuiButton") and not (list and d:IsDescendantOf(list)) then signalFire(d) end
		end
		task.wait(0.25)
		if not dialogueOpen() or dialogueSig(frame) ~= before then return end

		for _, target in ipairs({ txt, page }) do
			if target and target:IsA("GuiObject") then
				mouseClick(target)
				task.wait(0.3)
				if not dialogueOpen() or dialogueSig(frame) ~= before then return end
			end
		end
		for _, target in ipairs({ txt, page }) do
			if target and target:IsA("GuiObject") then
				touchTap(target)
				task.wait(0.3)
				if not dialogueOpen() or dialogueSig(frame) ~= before then return end
			end
		end
	end

	local function pressOption(btn)
		if not signalFire(btn) then
			mouseClick(btn)
			task.wait(0.2)
			if dialogueOpen() then touchTap(btn) end
		end
	end

	local exitWords = { "ไม่เป็นไร", "nevermind", "never mind", "goodbye", "bye", "leave", "no thanks", "cancel", "close" }
	local function isExit(text)
		local t = tostring(text or ""):lower()
		for _, w in ipairs(exitWords) do
			if t:find(w, 1, true) then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local badWords = { "robux", "rbx", "giveaway", "donate", "password", "cookie", "verify", "login", "paypal", "gift card", "โรบัก", "โรบักซ์", "รหัสผ่าน" }

	local trustedNames = { ["citizen"] = true, ["zero"] = true, ["hooded attendant"] = true }
	local trustCache = {}
	local function speakerTrusted(title)
		local t = tostring(title or ""):lower()
		if t == "" then return false end
		if trustedNames[t] then return true end
		local c = trustCache[t]
		if c and tick() - c.at < 5 then return c.ok end
		local ok = false
		pcall(function()
			local npcs = workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
			if npcs then
				for _, m in ipairs(npcs:GetChildren()) do
					local h = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if m.Name:lower() == t or (h and h.DisplayName:lower() == t) then ok = true break end
				end
			end
		end)
		trustCache[t] = { ok = ok, at = tick() }
		return ok
	end

	local function suspiciousDialogue(frame)
		local title = ""
		local tf = frame:FindFirstChild("dialogueTitleFrame", true)
		if tf then title = guiText(tf) end

		local Players = game:GetService("Players")
		if title ~= "" then
			if Players:FindFirstChild(title) then return true, "speaker is a player: " .. title end
			for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if p.DisplayName == title then return true, "speaker is a player: " .. title end
			end
		end

		if not _G.TalkTrustAll and not speakerTrusted(title) then
			return true, "unknown speaker: " .. title
		end

		local all = {}
		local tx = frame:FindFirstChild("dialogueText", true)
		if tx then table.insert(all, guiText(tx)) end
		local list = frame:FindFirstChild("optionsList", true)
		if list then
			for _, d in ipairs(list:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("GuiButton") then table.insert(all, guiText(d)) end
			end
		end
		local blob = table.concat(all, " "):lower()
		for _, w in ipairs(badWords) do
			if blob:find(w, 1, true) then return true, "mentions " .. w end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function closeSuspicious(frame)
		local list = frame:FindFirstChild("optionsList", true)
		if not list then return end
		for _, d in ipairs(list:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d.Visible and isExit(guiText(d)) then
				signalFire(d)
				return
			end
		end
	end

	local function specialPick(opts)
		local graves, firstGrave, nGraves = {}, nil, 0
		local roll, candy
		for _, o in ipairs(opts) do
			local t = guiText(o):lower()
			local n = t:match("^%s*grave%s+([ivx]+)%s*$")
			if n then
				graves[n] = o
				firstGrave = firstGrave or o
				nGraves = nGraves + 1
			elseif t:find("free roll", 1, true) then
				roll = o
			elseif t:find("candy", 1, true) then
				candy = o
			end
		end
		if nGraves > 0 then
			local want = tostring(_G.GraveChoice or "Grave I"):lower()
			if want == "random" then
				local list = {}
				for _, o in pairs(graves) do table.insert(list, o) end
				return list[math.random(#list)]
			end
			return graves[want:match("grave%s+([ivx]+)") or ""] or firstGrave
		end
		if roll then
			if tostring(_G.ZiolesChoice or ""):lower():find("candy", 1, true) and candy then return candy end
			return roll
		end
		return nil
	end

	local rollWatchUntil = 0
	local knownFruit = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	local function fruitTools()
		local list = {}
		local function scan(holder)
			if not holder then return end
			for _, t in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
				if t:IsA("Tool") and t:FindFirstChild("EatRemote", true) then table.insert(list, t) end
			end
		end
		scan(lp:FindFirstChild("Backpack"))
		scan(lp.Character)
		return list
	end

	local function startRollWatch()
		if not _G.StoreRollFruit then return end
		for _, t in ipairs(fruitTools()) do knownFruit[t] = true end
		rollWatchUntil = tick() + 30
	end

	spawn(function()
		local tries = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		while task.wait(0.5) do
			if _G.StoreRollFruit and tick() < rollWatchUntil then
				pcall(function()
					for _, t in ipairs(fruitTools()) do
						if not knownFruit[t] and (tries[t] or 0) < 4 then
							tries[t] = (tries[t] or 0) + 1
							local eat = t:FindFirstChild("EatRemote", true)
							local fname = eat and eat.Parent and eat.Parent:GetAttribute("OriginalName")
							if fname then
								if t.Parent == lp.Character then
									local hum = lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
									if hum then hum:UnequipTools() task.wait(0.2) end
								end
								pcall(function()
									RS.Remotes.CommF_:InvokeServer("StoreFruit", fname, t)
								end)
								task.wait(0.3)
								if not t.Parent then
									rollWatchUntil = 0
									setStatus("Stored fruit: " .. tostring(fname))
									pcall(function()
										lib:Notify({
											Title = "Academy Hub",
											Description = "Stored fruit: " .. tostring(fname),
											Icon = "rbxassetid://75862850530028",
											Duration = 5
										})
									end)
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end)
			end
		end
	end)

	local pickLog = {}

	local function talkStep()
		local frame = dialogueFrame()
		if not frame then return end
		if purchasePromptOpen() then
			setStatus("Purchase prompt open - auto talk paused")
			return
		end
		local bad, why = suspiciousDialogue(frame)
		if bad then
			setStatus("Skipped suspicious dialogue (" .. tostring(why) .. ")")
			closeSuspicious(frame)
			return
		end
		local list = frame:FindFirstChild("optionsList", true)

		local opts = {}
		if list then
			local scroller = list:FindFirstChild("scroller", true) or list
			for _, d in ipairs(scroller:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("GuiButton") and d.Visible then table.insert(opts, d) end
			end
			table.sort(opts, function(a, b) return a.AbsolutePosition.Y < b.AbsolutePosition.Y end)
		end

		if #opts > 0 then
			local want = tostring(_G.TalkChoice or "")
			local pick, exitOpt
			for _, o in ipairs(opts) do
				local txt = guiText(o)
				if isExit(txt) then
					exitOpt = exitOpt or o
				elseif not pick and (want == "" or want == "First Option" or txt:lower():find(want:lower(), 1, true)) then
					pick = o
				end
			end
			pick = specialPick(opts) or pick or exitOpt or opts[1]

			local title = ""
			pcall(function()
				local tf = frame:FindFirstChild("dialogueTitleFrame", true)
				title = tf and guiText(tf) or ""
			end)
			local key = title .. "|" .. guiText(pick)
			local now = tick()
			local fresh = {}
			for _, t in ipairs(pickLog[key] or {}) do if now - t < 25 then table.insert(fresh, t) end end
			if #fresh >= 3 and exitOpt then
				pick = exitOpt
				fresh = {}
			end
			table.insert(fresh, now)
			pickLog[key] = fresh

			if guiText(pick):lower():find("free roll", 1, true) then startRollWatch() end
			setStatus("Talking: " .. guiText(pick))
			pressOption(pick)
		else
			setStatus("Talking...")
			advanceDialogue(frame)
		end
	end

	spawn(function()
		while task.wait(0.15) do
			if _G.AutoTalkNPC and (_G.AutoTrickTreat or _G.AutoHalloweenBoss or _G.AutoTalkAll) then
				pcall(function()
					if dialogueOpen() then talkStep() end
				end)
			end
		end
	end)

	local function acceptRewards()
		pcall(function()
			local ev = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes", 3):WaitForChild("HalloweenEvent", 3)
			ev:FireServer("AcceptReward", "Death King")
			ev:FireServer("AcceptReward")
			ev:FireServer("AcceptReward", "Celestial")
		end)
	end

	local function findEnemy(test, maxDist, root)
		local enemies = workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
		if not enemies then return nil end
		local best, bd = nil, maxDist or math.huge
		for _, e in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
			if e:IsA("Model") then
				local h, r = e:FindFirstChild("Humanoid"), e:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if h and r and h.Health > 0 and test(e, h) then
					local d = (r.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
					if d < bd then best, bd = e, d end
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	local function findVampire(root)
		return findEnemy(function(e) return e.Name == "Vampire" end, 600, root)
	end
	local function findBoss(root)
		return findEnemy(function(e, h)
			return e.Name == "Unbound Werewolf" or tostring(h.DisplayName):find("Raid Boss") ~= nil
		end, math.huge, root)
	end
	local function findJack(root)
		return findEnemy(function(e) return e.Name == "Jack o' Lantern" end, math.huge, root)
	end

	local skipMob = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local function findNearbyMob(root)
		return findEnemy(function(e)
			return not (skipMob[e] and tick() < skipMob[e])
		end, 90, root)
	end
	local function farmingDoors()
		return _G.AutoTrickTreat or _G.AutoHalloweenBoss
	end

	local function nearestPumpkin(root)
		local ph = workspace:FindFirstChild("PumpkinHunt")
		if not ph then return nil end
		local best, bd = nil, math.huge
		for _, m in ipairs(ph:GetChildren()) do
			if m.Name == "Pumpkin" then
				for _, p in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do
					if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Parent and not (skipPumpkin[p] and tick() < skipPumpkin[p]) then
						local d = (p.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
						if d < bd then best, bd = p, d end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		return best
	end

	local function hitPumpkins(root)
		local net = RS:FindFirstChild("Modules") and RS.Modules:FindFirstChild("Net")
		local reHit = net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/RegisterHit")
		local reAtk = net and net:FindFirstChild("RE/RegisterAttack")
		if not (reHit and reAtk) then return end
		pcall(function() reAtk:FireServer(0.4000000059604645, 1) end)
		local ph = workspace:FindFirstChild("PumpkinHunt")
		if not ph then return end
		for _, m in ipairs(ph:GetChildren()) do
			if m.Name == "Pumpkin" then
				for _, p in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do
					if p:IsA("BasePart") and (p.Position - root.Position).Magnitude <= 60 then
						pcall(function() reHit:FireServer(p) end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function combatPending(root)
		if not root then return false end
		if _G.AutoHalloweenBoss and findBoss(root) then return true end
		if (_G.AutoTrickTreat or _G.AutoHalloweenBoss) and findVampire(root) then return true end
		if _G.AutoPumpkinEvent and findJack(root) then return true end
		if farmingDoors() and findNearbyMob(root) then return true end
		return false
	end

	local function killMob(mob, text, active, maxTime)
		local t0 = tick()
		local limit = maxTime or 300
		while active() and tick() - t0 < limit do
			local h = mob.Parent and mob:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
			if not h or h.Health <= 0 or not mob:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then break end
			setStatus(text)
			pcall(t9.Kill, mob, true)
			task.wait()
		end
		if maxTime and mob.Parent then skipMob[mob] = tick() + 60 end
		local mh = mob.Parent and mob:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
		if not mh or mh.Health <= 0 then ZHD.dropWin = math.max(ZHD.dropWin, tick() + 15) end
	end

	local function flyTo(pos, near, timeout, active)
		_tp(CFrame.new(pos))
		local t0 = tick()
		while tick() - t0 < timeout do
			local root = getRoot()
			if not root or not active() then return false end
			if (root.Position - pos).Magnitude <= near then return true end
			if combatPending(root) then return false end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		return false
	end

	local function stepCombat(root)
		if _G.AutoHalloweenBoss then
			local boss = findBoss(root)
			if boss then
				ZHD.sceneUntil = tick() + 300
				killMob(boss, "Attack Boss", function() return _G.AutoHalloweenBoss end)
				local bh = boss.Parent and boss:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
				if not bh or bh.Health <= 0 then
					-- boss is dead: grab the drops, then leave through the exit door
					ZHD.bossDoneAt = tick()
					ZHD.sceneUntil = tick() + 120
					ZHD.dropWin = tick() + 25
				end
				return true
			end
		end
		if _G.AutoTrickTreat or _G.AutoHalloweenBoss then
			local v = findVampire(root)
			if v then
				killMob(v, "Attack Vampire", function() return _G.AutoTrickTreat or _G.AutoHalloweenBoss end)
				return true
			end
		end
		if _G.AutoPumpkinEvent then
			local j = findJack(root)
			if j then
				killMob(j, "Attack Jack o' Lantern", function() return _G.AutoPumpkinEvent end)
				return true
			end
		end
		if farmingDoors() then
			local m = findNearbyMob(root)
			if m then
				killMob(m, "Attack Monster", farmingDoors, 45)
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function stepBossDoor(root)
		if not _G.AutoHalloweenBoss or tick() < bossDoorNext or tick() < ZHD.sceneUntil then return false end
		local door = bossDoor(root)
		if not door then return false end
		bossDoorNext = tick() + 25

		local sw = door:FindFirstChild("SceneWindow")
		local target = (sw and sw:IsA("BasePart") and sw.Position) or doorPos(door)
		setStatus("Fly To Boss Door")
		EquipWeapon(_G.SelectWeapon)
		if flyTo(target, 8, 90, function() return _G.AutoHalloweenBoss end) then
			setStatus("Open Door")
			local prompt = doorPrompt(door)
			local t1 = tick()
			while _G.AutoHalloweenBoss and tick() - t1 < 8 do
				local r = getRoot()
				if not r or findBoss(r) or ZHD.busyAt >= t1 then break end
				knockDoor(door)
				pressE(prompt)
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
			acceptRewards()
		end
		return true
	end

	local doorFail = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local trickLastRun, trickDone, lastDoorDone = 0, 0, tick()

	local function resetDoors()
		ZHD.cool = {}
		for _, d in ipairs(scanDoors()) do
			visited[d] = nil
			doorFail[d] = nil
		end
	end

	local function pressPrompt(prompt, withKey)
		pcall(function()
			if fireproximityprompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
		end)
		if withKey or not fireproximityprompt then
			pcall(function()
				local key = prompt.KeyboardKeyCode
				if key == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then key = Enum.KeyCode.E end
				VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, key, false, game)
				task.wait()
				VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, key, false, game)
			end)
		end
	end

	local function backoff(door, base)
		local n = (doorFail[door] or 0) + 1
		doorFail[door] = n
		visited[door] = tick() + math.min(base * 2 ^ (n - 1), 300)
	end

	-- v5: when no door is loaded/available, visit remembered doors, then every island of this Sea
	local function roamStep(root, allowLap)
		if _G.ZH_Roam == false then return false end
		local sea = ZHD.sea()
		local list = sea and ZHD.roam[sea]
		if not list then return false end
		local now = tick()
		if now < ZHD.idleUntil then
			setStatus("No door opened on a full lap - waiting before next lap")
			return false
		end

		local tpos, label, tkey
		local bd = math.huge
		for k, info in pairs(ZHD.known) do
			if info.hadPrompt and not info.live and not info.arena and not (ZHD.cool[k] and now < ZHD.cool[k]) then
				local d = (info.pos - root.Position).Magnitude
				if d < bd then bd, tpos, label, tkey = d, info.pos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), "remembered door", k end
			end
		end
		if not tpos then
			if not allowLap then return false end
			if ZHD.wp > #list then
				ZHD.wp = 1
				if ZHD.opened == ZHD.lapOpened then
					ZHD.idleUntil = now + 45
					return false
				end
				ZHD.lapOpened = ZHD.opened
			end
			local w = list[ZHD.wp]
			ZHD.wp = ZHD.wp + 1
			label, tpos = w[1], w[2] + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
		end

		setStatus("Roam: " .. tostring(label))
		_tp(CFrame.new(tpos))
		local t0 = tick()
		while _G.AutoTrickTreat and tick() - t0 < 90 do
			local r = getRoot()
			if not r then return true end
			if nextDoor(r) then return true end
			if (r.Position - tpos).Magnitude <= 150 then
				local t1 = tick()
				while _G.AutoTrickTreat and tick() - t1 < 2.5 do
					local r2 = getRoot()
					if not r2 or nextDoor(r2) then return true end
					task.wait(0.25)
				end
				if tkey then ZHD.cool[tkey] = tick() + 60 end
				return true
			end
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
		if tkey then ZHD.cool[tkey] = tick() + 60 end
		return true
	end

	local function stepTrick(root)
		if not _G.AutoTrickTreat then return false end

		if tick() - trickLastRun > 15 then
			resetDoors()
			trickDone, lastDoorDone = 0, tick()
		end
		trickLastRun = tick()

		local door, pos, prompt = nextDoor(root)
		if not door then
			if tick() - lastDoorDone > 90 then
				resetDoors()
				lastDoorDone = tick()
			end
			if workspace:GetAttribute("HalloweenEventActive") == false then
				setStatus("Halloween event is not active")
				return false
			end
			local live = scanDoors()
			if roamStep(root, #live == 0) then return true end
			if #live > 0 then
				local soon = math.huge
				for _, d in ipairs(live) do
					local w = ZHD.wait(d)
					if w < soon then soon = w end
				end
				if soon > 0 and soon < math.huge then
					setStatus(string.format("All doors cooling down (next in ~%ds)", math.ceil(soon)))
				else
					setStatus("No door available")
				end
			else
				setStatus("No Halloween doors loaded in this Sea")
			end
			return false
		end

		setStatus("Fly To Door (opened " .. trickDone .. ")")
		EquipWeapon(_G.SelectWeapon)
		local reach = math.clamp((prompt.MaxActivationDistance or 10) * 0.6, 3, 8)
		if not flyTo(pos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), reach, 60, function() return _G.AutoTrickTreat end) then
			local r = getRoot()
			if _G.AutoTrickTreat and r and not combatPending(r) then backoff(door, 15) end
			return true
		end

		setStatus("Open Door")
		local ready, tries, t0 = false, 0, tick()
		local openLimit = 2.5 + ZHD.ping() * 2
		while _G.AutoTrickTreat and tick() - t0 < openLimit do
			local r0 = getRoot()
			if not r0 then break end
			if ZHD.busyAt >= t0 then break end
			if findNearbyMob(r0) or dialogueOpen() or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled or ZHD.ownOpen >= t0 then
				ready = true
				break
			end
			tries = tries + 1
			knockDoor(door)
			pressPrompt(prompt, tries > 4)
			task.wait(0.08)
		end
		if not ready then
			if _G.AutoTrickTreat then backoff(door, 15) end
			return true
		end

		doorFail[door] = nil
		ZHD.dropWin = tick() + 30
		visited[door] = tick() + ZHD.revisit()
		trickDone = trickDone + 1
		ZHD.opened = ZHD.opened + 1
		ZHD.mark(door, 120)
		lastDoorDone = tick()

		local t3 = tick()
		while _G.AutoTrickTreat and tick() - t3 < 1.2 + ZHD.ping() do
			local r1 = getRoot()
			if not r1 then return true end
			if findNearbyMob(r1) then return true end
			if dialogueOpen() then break end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end

		if _G.AutoTalkNPC then
			local t2 = tick()
			while _G.AutoTrickTreat and dialogueOpen() and tick() - t2 < 20 do
				local r2 = getRoot()
				if r2 and findNearbyMob(r2) then return true end
				task.wait(0.15)
			end
		end
		acceptRewards()
		ZHD.dropWin = tick() + 20
		visited[door] = tick() + ZHD.revisit()
		task.wait(0.1)
		return true
	end

	local npcCache, npcCacheAt = {}, 0
	local function scanNPCs()
		if tick() - npcCacheAt < 20 then return npcCache end
		npcCacheAt = tick()
		local list = {}
		local function add(model, prompt, click)
			local part = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if part then table.insert(list, { model = model, part = part, prompt = prompt, click = click }) end
		end
		local npcs = workspace:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
		if npcs then
			for _, m in ipairs(npcs:GetChildren()) do
				if m:IsA("Model") then
					add(m, m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true), m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector", true))
				end
			end
		end
		local hotel = getHotel()
		if hotel then
			for _, d in ipairs(hotel:GetDescendants()) do
				if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
					local m = d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
					local isDoor = false
					local x = d
					while x and x ~= hotel do
						if x.Name:sub(1, 13) == "HalloweenDoor" then isDoor = true break end
						x = x.Parent
					end
					if m and m ~= hotel and not isDoor then add(m, d, nil) end
				end
			end
		end
		npcCache = list
		return list
	end

	local function stepTalkAll(root)
		if not _G.AutoTalkAll then return false end
		local best, bd
		for _, n in ipairs(scanNPCs()) do
			if n.part.Parent and not (visited[n.model] and tick() < visited[n.model]) then
				if n.prompt == nil or n.prompt.Enabled then
					local d = (n.part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
					if not bd or d < bd then best, bd = n, d end
				end
			end
		end
		if not best then return false end

		setStatus("Fly To NPC: " .. best.model.Name)
		visited[best.model] = tick() + 120
		if flyTo(best.part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), 8, 90, function() return _G.AutoTalkAll end) then
			setStatus("Talk To " .. best.model.Name)
			local t1 = tick()
			while _G.AutoTalkAll and tick() - t1 < 2.5 and not dialogueOpen() do
				if best.prompt then pressE(best.prompt) end
				if best.click and fireclickdetector then pcall(fireclickdetector, best.click) end
				task.wait(0.15)
			end
			local t2 = tick()
			while _G.AutoTalkAll and dialogueOpen() and tick() - t2 < 40 do
				task.wait(0.3)
			end
		end
		return true
	end

	local function stepPumpkin(root)
		if not _G.AutoPumpkinEvent then return false end
		local pumpkin = nearestPumpkin(root)
		if not pumpkin then return false end

		setStatus("Fly To Pumpkin")
		EquipWeapon(_G.SelectWeapon)
		local arrived = flyTo(pumpkin.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), 15, 180, function()
			return _G.AutoPumpkinEvent and pumpkin.Parent ~= nil
		end)
		if not arrived then return true end

		local t1 = tick()
		while _G.AutoPumpkinEvent and pumpkin.Parent and tick() - t1 < 8 do
			local r = getRoot()
			if not r or combatPending(r) then return true end
			if (r.Position - pumpkin.Position).Magnitude > 20 then
				_tp(CFrame.new(pumpkin.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
			end
			if _G.AutoAttackPumpkin then
				setStatus("Attack Pumpkin")
				hitPumpkins(r)
			end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		if pumpkin.Parent then
			skipPumpkin[pumpkin] = tick() + 30
		end
		return true
	end

	local dropList = {}
	local dropSkip = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local dropSeen = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local PlayersSvc = game:GetService("Players")
	ZHD.dropWords = { "candy", "corn", "drop", "loot", "reward", "pickup", "pick_up", "collect", "fruit", "gift", "orb", "soul", "coin", "chest", "treasure", "token", "ticket", "essence", "sack" }
	ZHD.actionWords = { "collect", "pick", "take", "grab", "claim", "loot", "เก็บ", "หยิบ" }
	ZHD.lastSweep = 0
	_G.ZH_DebugDrops = _G.ZH_DebugDrops or false

	function ZHD.dbg(...)
		if not _G.ZH_DebugDrops then return end
		local parts = {}
		for _, v in ipairs({ ... }) do table.insert(parts, tostring(v)) end
		local msg = table.concat(parts, " ")
		pcall(print, "[AcademyHub]", msg)
		if tick() - (ZHD.toastAt or 0) > 1.5 then
			ZHD.toastAt = tick()
			pcall(function() UI:Notify({ Title = "ZH debug", Content = msg:sub(1, 140), Duration = 4 }) end)
		end
	end

	-- v5.3: drops are collected for BOTH Trick-or-Treat and Boss farming (before it only worked with Trick-or-Treat on)
	function ZHD.dropsOn()
		return _G.AutoCollectDrops and (_G.AutoTrickTreat or _G.AutoHalloweenBoss)
	end

	function ZHD.looksLikeDrop(inst)
		if inst:IsA("Tool") then return true end
		if inst:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and (ZHD.hasWord(inst.ActionText, ZHD.actionWords) or ZHD.hasWord(inst.ObjectText, ZHD.dropWords)) then
			return true
		end
		local x, n = inst, 0
		while x and x ~= workspace and n < 3 do
			if ZHD.hasWord(x.Name, ZHD.dropWords) then return true end
			x, n = x.Parent, n + 1
		end
		return false
	end

	function ZHD.insideDoor(inst)
		local x = inst
		while x and x ~= workspace do
			if (x:IsA("Model") or x:IsA("BasePart")) and ZHD.isName(x.Name) then return true end
			x = x.Parent
		end
		return false
	end

	function ZHD.isNpcLike(inst)
		local x = inst.Parent
		while x and x ~= workspace do
			if x:IsA("Model") and x:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return true end
			x = x.Parent
		end
		return false
	end
	local function dropPart(inst)
		if inst:IsA("Tool") then
			return inst:FindFirstChild("Handle") or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		end
		if inst:IsA("BasePart") then return inst end
		if inst:IsA("Model") then
			return inst.PrimaryPart or inst:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		end
		local p = inst.Parent
		if not p then return nil end
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then return p end
		if p:IsA("Attachment") then
			local pp = p.Parent
			return pp and pp:IsA("BasePart") and pp or nil
		end
		if p:IsA("Model") then
			return p.PrimaryPart or p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function dropIgnored(inst, strict)
		for _, name in ipairs({ "Enemies", "NPCs", "PumpkinHunt", "Boats", "_WorldOrigin" }) do
			local f = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
			if f and inst:IsDescendantOf(f) then return true end
		end
		for _, pl in ipairs(PlayersSvc:GetPlayers()) do
			local c = pl.Character
			if c and inst:IsDescendantOf(c) then return true end
		end
		-- NPC talk prompts / mobs are never drops
		if ZHD.isNpcLike(inst) then return true end
		-- the door's own prompt is not a drop
		if ZHD.insideDoor(inst) and not ZHD.looksLikeDrop(inst) then return true end
		-- v5.3: the Map used to be ignored completely, but the doors (and so their drops) live inside the Map.
		-- Inside the Map only accept drop-looking things that appeared shortly after a door / boss event.
		local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
		if map and inst:IsDescendantOf(map) then
			if tick() > ZHD.dropWin then return true end
		-- things found by the area sweep (not freshly created) must look like a drop; fresh ones inside the window are accepted
		if strict and not ZHD.looksLikeDrop(inst) then return true end
		if not (inst:IsA("ProximityPrompt") or inst:IsA("ClickDetector") or inst:IsA("Tool")) then
			if not (ZHD.looksLikeDrop(inst) or (inst:IsA("BasePart") and not inst.Anchored)) then return true end
		end
		end
		return false
	end

	local function addDrop(inst, strict)
		if dropSeen[inst] then return end
		task.defer(function()
			pcall(function()
				if dropSeen[inst] or not inst.Parent or dropIgnored(inst, strict) then return end
				local part = dropPart(inst)
				if not part then return end
				local root = getRoot()
				if root and (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude > 300 then return end
				dropSeen[inst] = true
				table.insert(dropList, {
					part = part,
					prompt = inst:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and inst or nil,
					click = inst:IsA("ClickDetector") and inst or nil,
					exp = tick() + 60,
				})
				ZHD.dbg("drop:", inst.ClassName, inst:GetFullName())
			end)
		end)
	end

	if _G.ZH_DropConn then pcall(function() _G.ZH_DropConn:Disconnect() end) end
	_G.ZH_DropConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
		if not ZHD.dropsOn() then return end
		local c = inst.ClassName
		if c == "ProximityPrompt" or c == "Tool" or c == "ClickDetector" then
			addDrop(inst)
		elseif tick() < ZHD.dropWin and (inst:IsA("BasePart") or inst:IsA("Model")) and ZHD.hasWord(inst.Name, ZHD.dropWords) then
			addDrop(inst)
		end
	end)

	-- v5.3: also scan around the player for a short time after a door opens / the boss dies,
	-- so drops that were created before we could see them (or while streamed out) still get picked up.
	local function sweepDrops(root)
		if tick() - ZHD.lastSweep < 1 then return end
		ZHD.lastSweep = tick()
		local ok, parts = pcall(function() return workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(root.Position, 90) end)
		if not (ok and parts) then return end
		for i, p in ipairs(parts) do
			if i > 300 then break end
			local c = p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or p:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector", true)
			if c then
				addDrop(c, true)
			elseif ZHD.hasWord(p.Name, ZHD.dropWords)
				or (p:FindFirstChildOfClass("TouchTransmitter") and not p.Anchored and p.Size.Magnitude < 10) then
				addDrop(p, true)
			end
		end
	end
	local function stepDrops(root)
		if not ZHD.dropsOn() then return false end
		if tick() < ZHD.dropWin then sweepDrops(root) end
		local now = tick()
		local best, bd
		for i = #dropList, 1, -1 do
			local d = dropList[i]
			if now > d.exp or not d.part.Parent or (d.prompt and not d.prompt.Parent) then
				table.remove(dropList, i)
			elseif not (dropSkip[d.part] and now < dropSkip[d.part]) and not (d.prompt and not d.prompt.Enabled) then
				local dist = (d.part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
				if not bd or dist < bd then best, bd = d, dist end
			end
		end
		if not best then return false end

		local part, prompt, click = best.part, best.prompt, best.click
		local function alive()
			return ZHD.dropsOn() and part.Parent ~= nil
		end

		setStatus("Fly To Drop: " .. tostring(part.Name))
		local reach = prompt and math.clamp((prompt.MaxActivationDistance or 10) * 0.6, 3, 8) or 5
		if not flyTo(part.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), reach, 30, alive) then
			local r = getRoot()
			if r and alive() and not combatPending(r) then dropSkip[part] = tick() + 20 end
			return true
		end

		setStatus("Collect Drop")
		local t0 = tick()
		while alive() and tick() - t0 < 2 do
			local r = getRoot()
			if not r then break end
			if prompt then
				if not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled then break end
				pcall(function() prompt.HoldDuration = 0 end)
				pressPrompt(prompt, true)
			end
			if click and fireclickdetector then pcall(fireclickdetector, click) end
			if firetouchinterest then
				pcall(firetouchinterest, r, part, 0)
				pcall(firetouchinterest, r, part, 1)
			end
			task.wait(0.1)
		end
		if part.Parent and not (prompt and (not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Enabled)) then
			dropSkip[part] = tick() + 30
		end
		return true
	end

	-- ===== v5.3: exit door =====
	function ZHD.findExit(root)
		-- 1) the scene's own door (HalloweenDoor next to Boundary / Collapse / PillarTemplates)
		local bestD, bd
		for _, d in ipairs(scanDoors()) do
			if d.Parent and ZHD.isArena(d) then
				local dist = (doorPos(d) - root.Position).Magnitude
				if not bd or dist < bd then bestD, bd = d, dist end
			end
		end
		if bestD then
			return { door = bestD, prompt = doorPrompt(bestD), pos = doorPos(bestD), label = "scene door" }
		end
		-- 2) fallback: any enabled prompt called exit / leave near us (throttled - walks the whole workspace)
		if tick() - (ZHD.exitAt or 0) < 8 then return ZHD.exitCache end
		ZHD.exitAt, ZHD.exitCache = tick(), nil
		local best, bd2, n = nil, 600, 0
		for _, inst in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			n = n + 1
			if n % 4000 == 0 then task.wait() end
			if inst:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and inst.Enabled then
				local par = inst.Parent
				local gp = par and par.Parent
				if ZHD.nameHasExit(inst.ActionText) or ZHD.nameHasExit(inst.ObjectText)
					or (par and ZHD.nameHasExit(par.Name)) or (gp and ZHD.nameHasExit(gp.Name)) then
					local pos = ZHD.promptPos(inst)
					if pos then
						local dist = (pos - root.Position).Magnitude
						if dist < bd2 then
							bd2 = dist
							best = { prompt = inst, pos = pos, label = tostring(par and par.Name) }
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		ZHD.exitCache = best
		return best
	end

	function ZHD.stepExit(root)
		if not _G.AutoExitDoor or not (_G.AutoHalloweenBoss or _G.AutoTrickTreat) then return false end
		local now = tick()
		local busyRecent = now - ZHD.busyAt < 6
		local sceneOn = now < ZHD.sceneUntil
		local arenaNear = false
		if now - ZHD.exitDoneAt > 60 then
			for _, d in ipairs(scanDoors()) do
				if d.Parent and ZHD.isArena(d) and (doorPos(d) - root.Position).Magnitude < 350 then
					arenaNear = true
					break
				end
			end
		end
		if not (busyRecent or sceneOn or arenaNear) then
			ZHD.exitTries = 0
			return false
		end
		if combatPending(root) then return false end
		if _G.AutoTalkNPC and dialogueOpen() then
			setStatus("Waiting for dialogue to finish")
			return true
		end
		if now < ZHD.exitNext then return busyRecent end

		local ex = ZHD.findExit(root)
		if not ex then
			if sceneOn and ZHD.bossDoneAt > 0 and now - ZHD.bossDoneAt > 25 then
				-- boss is dead and there is nothing to press: stop waiting so the farm can continue
				ZHD.sceneUntil, ZHD.bossDoneAt = 0, 0
			end
			if busyRecent then
				setStatus("Busy with a door - waiting")
				return true
			end
			return false
		end

		ZHD.exitTries = ZHD.exitTries + 1
		if ZHD.exitTries > 5 then
			ZHD.exitTries, ZHD.sceneUntil, ZHD.busyAt = 0, 0, 0
			ZHD.exitNext = now + 30
			return false
		end

		ZHD.dbg("exit door:", ex.label, tostring(ex.pos), "try", ZHD.exitTries)
		local function want() return _G.AutoExitDoor and (_G.AutoHalloweenBoss or _G.AutoTrickTreat) end
		setStatus("Fly To Exit Door")
		local reach = ex.prompt and math.clamp((ex.prompt.MaxActivationDistance or 10) * 0.6, 3, 8) or 6
		if not flyTo(ex.pos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0), reach, 45, want) then
			ZHD.exitNext = tick() + 2
			return true
		end

		setStatus("Open Exit Door")
		local r0 = getRoot()
		local start = r0 and r0.Position or ex.pos
		local t0, presses = tick(), 0
		while want() and tick() - t0 < 6 do
			local r = getRoot()
			if not r then break end
			if (r.Position - start).Magnitude > 80 then break end
			presses = presses + 1
			if ex.door and ex.door.Parent then knockDoor(ex.door) end
			if ex.prompt and ex.prompt.Parent then pressPrompt(ex.prompt, presses > 3) end
			task.wait(0.12)
		end
		acceptRewards()

		local r1 = getRoot()
		if r1 and (r1.Position - start).Magnitude > 80 then
			-- we got out of the scene
			ZHD.exitTries, ZHD.sceneUntil, ZHD.busyAt, ZHD.bossDoneAt = 0, 0, 0, 0
			ZHD.exitDoneAt = tick()
			bossDoorNext = tick() + 10
		end
		ZHD.exitNext = tick() + 3
		return true
	end
	-- v5.3.1: one-tap report of everything interactive near the player (copied to clipboard + printed)
	function ZHD.report()
		local root = getRoot()
		if not root then return end
		local lines = {
			string.format("AcademyHub report | sea=%s | busyAgo=%.0f | scene=%s | tracked=%d",
				tostring(ZHD.sea()), tick() - ZHD.busyAt, tostring(tick() < ZHD.sceneUntil), #dropList),
		}
		local seen, n = {}, 0
		local function add(cls, path, dist, extra)
			if seen[path] or n >= 70 then return end
			seen[path] = true
			n = n + 1
			table.insert(lines, string.format("%s | %s | %dst | %s", cls, path, dist, extra))
		end
		local ok, parts = pcall(function() return workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(root.Position, 80) end)
		for _, p in ipairs(ok and parts or {}) do
			local kinds = {}
			for _, c in ipairs(p:GetChildren()) do
				if c:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
					table.insert(kinds, string.format("Prompt[%s/%s/en=%s/hold=%s]", c.ActionText, c.ObjectText, tostring(c.Enabled), tostring(c.HoldDuration)))
				elseif c:IsA("ClickDetector") then
					table.insert(kinds, "Click")
				elseif c.ClassName == "TouchTransmitter" then
					table.insert(kinds, "Touch")
				end
			end
			if #kinds > 0 or p.Parent:IsA("Tool") or ZHD.hasWord(p.Name, ZHD.dropWords) then
				add(p.ClassName, p:GetFullName(), (p.Position - root.Position).Magnitude, table.concat(kinds, ",") .. (p.Anchored and " anchored" or " loose"))
			end
		end
		for _, t in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
			if t:IsA("Tool") then add("Tool", t:GetFullName(), 0, "in workspace") end
		end
		local text = table.concat(lines, "\n")
		pcall(print, text)
		local copied = false
		pcall(function()
			if setclipboard then setclipboard(text) copied = true
			elseif toclipboard then toclipboard(text) copied = true end
		end)
		pcall(function()
			UI:Notify({ Title = "Academy Hub", Content = copied and ("Copied " .. n .. " items to clipboard - paste it in chat") or ("Printed " .. n .. " items to the console (clipboard not supported)"), Duration = 5 })
		end)
	end
	spawn(function()
		while task.wait(0.2) do
			if not anyFarm() then
				task.wait(0.5)
			else
				pcall(function()
					local root = getRoot()
					local hum = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					if not root or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

					if stepCombat(root) then return end
					if stepDrops(root) then return end
					if ZHD.stepExit(root) then return end
					if stepBossDoor(root) then return end
					if stepTrick(root) then return end
					if stepTalkAll(root) then return end
					if stepPumpkin(root) then return end
					task.wait(1)
				end)
			end
		end
	end)

	spawn(function()
		while task.wait(0.5) do
			if _G.AutoHalloweenGacha then
				pcall(function()
					local net = RS:WaitForChild("Modules", 3):WaitForChild("Net", 3)
					net:WaitForChild("RF/GachaNetworkRF", 3):InvokeServer({
						Context = "Purchase",
						BoxName = "Halloween26Gacha"
					})
				end)
			end
		end
	end)

	spawn(function()
		while task.wait(5) do
			pcall(function()
				local on = getHotel() ~= nil or #scanDoors() > 0
				pcall(function()
					HwDoors:SetText(string.format("Sea %s | doors %d | opened %d | event %s | ping %dms",
						tostring(ZHD.sea() or "?"), #scanDoors(), ZHD.opened,
						tostring(workspace:GetAttribute("HalloweenEventActive")), math.floor(ZHD.ping() * 1000)))
				end)
				HwActive:SetText(on and "🎃 Event arrived yet?  🟢 YES, arrived!" or "🎃 Event arrived yet?  🔴 NOT YET")
			end)
		end
	end)

	local function mkHighlight(model, color, name)
		local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hl.Name = name
		hl.Adornee = model
		hl.FillColor = color
		hl.OutlineColor = color
		hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
		hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
		hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		hl.Parent = model
		return hl
	end

	local ESPObjs = { boss = {}, vamp = {}, door = {} }
	local function espClear(cat)
		for k, hl in pairs(ESPObjs[cat]) do
			pcall(function() hl:Destroy() end)
			ESPObjs[cat][k] = nil
		end
	end
	local function espSync(cat, wanted)
		local keep = {}
		for _, w in ipairs(wanted) do
			keep[w.model] = true
			local hl = ESPObjs[cat][w.model]
			if not hl or not hl.Parent then
				ESPObjs[cat][w.model] = mkHighlight(w.model, w.color, "ZH_HWESPBox")
			end
		end
		for model, hl in pairs(ESPObjs[cat]) do
			if not keep[model] then
				pcall(function() hl:Destroy() end)
				ESPObjs[cat][model] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	spawn(function()
		local pumpkinWasOn = false
		while task.wait(0.5) do
			pcall(function()
				local root = getRoot()

				local ph = workspace:FindFirstChild("PumpkinHunt")
				if _G.PumpkinESP then
					pumpkinWasOn = true
					if ph then
						for _, m in ipairs(ph:GetChildren()) do
							if m.Name == "Pumpkin" and not m:FindFirstChild("ZH_PumpkinESP_HL") then
								mkHighlight(m, Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0), "ZH_PumpkinESP_HL")
							end
						end
					end
				elseif pumpkinWasOn then
					pumpkinWasOn = false
					if ph then
						for _, m in ipairs(ph:GetChildren()) do
							local hl = m:FindFirstChild("ZH_PumpkinESP_HL")
							if hl then hl:Destroy() end
						end
					end
				end

				if not root then return end

				if _G.ESPBossDoor then
					local list = {}
					local d = bossDoor(root)
					if d then table.insert(list, { model = d, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60) }) end
					espSync("boss", list)
				else
					espClear("boss")
				end

				if _G.ESPVampire then
					local list = {}
					local enemies = workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")
					if enemies then
						for _, e in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
							if e:IsA("Model") and e.Name == "Vampire" then
								local h = e:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
								if h and h.Health > 0 then
									table.insert(list, { model = e, color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 90, 255) })
								end
							end
						end
					end
					espSync("vamp", list)
				else
					espClear("vamp")
				end

				if _G.ESPTrickDoor then
					local list = {}
					for _, d in ipairs(scanDoors()) do
						local pr = doorPrompt(d)
						if pr and pr.Enabled then
							table.insert(list, { model = d, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0) })
						end
					end
					espSync("door", list)
				else
					espClear("door")
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
end

	local t30 = {

	}
	local t31 = {}

	local function v649(p127)
		if not p127 then
			return
		end

		if p127:IsA("BasePart") then
			return p127.Position
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return p127:GetPivot()
		end)
		local Position = ok and typeof(result) == "CFrame" and result.Position or nil

		return Position
	end
	local function v653(p128)
		local Locations = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin") and workspace._WorldOrigin:FindFirstChild("Locations")

		if not Locations then
			return "unknown"
		end

		local Name
		local v656

		for _, child in ipairs(Locations:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("BasePart") then
				local Magnitude = (child.Position - p128).Magnitude

				if not Name or Magnitude < v656 then
					Name = child.Name
					v656 = Magnitude
				end
			end
		end

		return Name and string.lower(Name) or "unknown"
	end
	local function v660(p129, p130)
		local v661 = string.lower(tostring(p130 or ""))
		local v662 = string.lower(tostring(p129.Name or ""))
		local v663 = string.lower(tostring(p129:GetAttribute("DisplayName") or ""))
		local v664 = v662 .. " " .. v663

		if t30[v661] or v661:find("fishman", 1, true) or v661:find("underwater", 1, true) or v661:find("sewer", 1, true) or v664:find("boss", 1, true) then
			return true
		end

		return t31[v662] or t31[v663]
	end
	local function v665()
		local t32 = {}
		local t33 = {}
		local _WorldOrigin = workspace:FindFirstChild("_WorldOrigin")
		local EnemySpawns = _WorldOrigin and _WorldOrigin:FindFirstChild("EnemySpawns")

		if not EnemySpawns then
			return t32
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(EnemySpawns:GetChildren()) do
			local v672 = v649(child)

			if v672 then
				local v673 = v653(v672)
				local v674 = tostring(child:GetAttribute("DisplayName") or child.Name or "")

				if v674 ~= "" and not v660(child, v673) then
					t33[v673] = t33[v673] or {}
					t33[v673][v674] = t33[v673][v674] or {}
					t33[v673][v674][#t33[v673][v674] + 1] = v672
				end
			end
		end

		local t34 = {}

		for k in pairs(t33) do
			t34[#t34 + 1] = k
		end

		table.sort(t34)

		for _, v1 in ipairs(t34) do
			local v679 = t33[v1]
			local t35 = {}
			local v681, v682, v683 = pairs(v679)

			for k in v681, v682, v683 do
				t35[#t35 + 1] = k
			end

			table.sort(t35)

			local Position
			local Locations = _WorldOrigin and _WorldOrigin:FindFirstChild("Locations")

			if Locations then
				local v687, v688, v689 = ipairs(Locations:GetChildren())
				local v690 = geniter(v687, v688, v689)

				while true do
					local v691 = table.pack(v690())

					if not v691[1] then
						break
					end

					local v692 = v691[3]

					if v692:IsA("BasePart") and string.lower(v692.Name) == v1 then
						Position = v692.Position

						break
					end
				end
			end

			local v693, v694, v695 = ipairs(t35)

			for _, v2 in v693, v694, v695 do
				local v698 = v679[v2][1]

				if #t35 > 1 then
					t32[#t32 + 1] = {
						Island = v1,
						Name = v2,
						CFrame = CFrame.new(v698 + Vector3.new(0, 40, 0))
					}
				else
					local vector3 = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)

					if Position then
						local vector32 = Vector3.new(v698.X - Position.X, 0, v698.Z - Position.Z)

						if vector32.Magnitude > 0.01 then
							vector3 = vector32.Unit
						end
					end

					t32[#t32 + 1] = {
						Island = v1,
						Name = v2,
						CFrame = CFrame.new(v698 + vector3 * 60 + Vector3.new(0, 40, 0))
					}
					t32[#t32 + 1] = {
						Island = v1,
						Name = v2,
						CFrame = CFrame.new(v698 - vector3 * 60 + Vector3.new(0, 40, 0))
					}
				end
			end
		end

		return t32
	end
	local function v701()
		local Enemies_ = workspace:FindFirstChild("Enemies")

		if not Enemies_ then
			return
		end

		local Character = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character
		local HumanoidRootPart = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local v705
		local v706

		for _, child in ipairs(Enemies_:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Model") and (child:GetAttribute("MagnetEnemy") == true or string.find(string.lower(child.Name), "magnetized")) and child:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and child.Humanoid.Health > 0 and child:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
				local Magnitude = HumanoidRootPart and (child.HumanoidRootPart.Position - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude or 0

				if not v705 or Magnitude < v706 then
					v705 = child
					v706 = Magnitude
				end
			end
		end

		return v705
	end
	local function v710(p131)
		if not p131 or typeof(p131.CFrame) ~= "CFrame" then
			return false
		end

		local LocalPlayer = game.Players.LocalPlayer
		local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
		local HumanoidRootPart = Character and Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not HumanoidRootPart then
			return false
		end

		v631("Patrolling - " .. tostring(p131.Island))
		pcall(function()
			_tp(p131.CFrame)

		local now = tick()
		local exitTo
		local v716

		while true do
			if not _G.AutoMagnetToken then
				exitTo = 1

				break
			end

			v716 = v701()

			if v716 then

			local Character2 = LocalPlayer.Character
			local HumanoidRootPart2 = Character2 and Character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if HumanoidRootPart2 then

					task.wait(0.1)

					continue
				end

				exitTo = 1

				break
			end

			break
		end

		if exitTo ~= 1 then
			if exitTo == 2 then
				return v716
			end

			return false
		end

		if not _G.AutoMagnetToken then
			return false
		end

		v631("Searching - " .. tostring(p131.Island))

		local now2 = tick()

		while _G.AutoMagnetToken and tick() - now2 < 1 do
			local v720 = v701()

			end

			task.wait(0.05)
		end

		local v721 = v701() or false

		return v721
	end

					magnetEventSpawnIndex += 1

	end)

FishingToggle = GRP_Fish_Fishing:AddToggle("Auto_Fishing", {
	Text = "Auto Fishing",
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(p159)
		_G.AutoFishing = p159
	end
})

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

do
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
	local ReplicatedStorage2 = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
	local FishReplicated = ReplicatedStorage2:WaitForChild("FishReplicated")
	local FishingRequest = FishReplicated:WaitForChild("FishingRequest")
	local Config = require(FishReplicated.FishingClient.Config)
	local GetWaterHeightAtLocation = require(ReplicatedStorage2.Util.GetWaterHeightAtLocation)
	local MaxLaunchDistance = Config.Rod.MaxLaunchDistance

	task.spawn(function()
		while task.wait(0.5) do
			if _G.AutoFishing then
				local exitTo

				repeat
					pcall(function()
						local Character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
						local HumanoidRootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

						if not HumanoidRootPart then
							return
						end

						local Tool = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")

						if _G.SelectedRod and (not Tool or Tool.Name ~= _G.SelectedRod) then
							local _GSelectedRod = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild(_G.SelectedRod)

							if _GSelectedRod then
								Character.Humanoid:EquipTool(_GSelectedRod)
								Tool = _GSelectedRod
							end
						end

						if Tool then
							local v751 = GetWaterHeightAtLocation(HumanoidRootPart.Position)
							local _, v753 = Workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(Ray.new(Character.Head.Position, HumanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector * MaxLaunchDistance), {
								Character,
								Workspace.Characters,
								Workspace.Enemies
							})
							local vector3 = v753 and Vector3.new(v753.X, math.max(v753.Y, v751), v753.Z)
							local attribute = Tool:GetAttribute("State")
							local attribute2 = Tool:GetAttribute("ServerState")

							if vector3 and (attribute == "ReeledIn" or attribute2 == "ReeledIn") then
								FishingRequest:InvokeServer("StartCasting")
								task.wait()
								FishingRequest:InvokeServer("CastLineAtLocation", vector3, 100, true)
							elseif attribute2 == "Biting" then
								FishingRequest:InvokeServer("Catching", true)
								task.wait(0.1)
								FishingRequest:InvokeServer("Catch", 1)
							end
						end
					end)
					exitTo = nil

					while task.wait(0.5) do
						if _G.AutoFishing then
							exitTo = 1

							break
						end
					end
				until exitTo ~= 1

				return
			end
		end
	end)
end

								if CheckEnemiesBoat() or CheckTerrorShark() or CheckPirateGrandBrigade() then
									_tp(CFrame.new(-10000000, 150, 37016.25))

									_tp(CFrame.new(-10000000, 31, 37016.25))

								if _G.FindMirage and not ((cFrame.Position - plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude <= 10) then

								end

						end

do
